row.name: One-armed robber
row.detailed_description: Experience the challenge of robbing banks, but now with only one arm! Grab a friend and you'll have two arms in total. Unlock and buy new guns, which can be customized to fit your playstyle. If you are trying to go stealth, the optimal choice might be a suppressor, but if you're going loud, damage and bullets is all that matters, so put on an extended mag and get going! Each heist is suited for any playstyle, whether you want to sneak in and take out guards quietly, or you go in guns blazing shooting everthing in your sight until you reach the vault, the choice is yours. As you become a more experienced robber new tools will be unlocked, which will make it easier for you to complete the heists. Each tool has a special purpose, and unique tools make it possible to complete heists in new ways you couldn't do before. Whether you go loud or stealth, once you are in the vault, the objective is the same: Gather as much loot as possible, and get out alive! If you can't fit all the loot in the vault in your duffel bag, you can either run back to the truck and get a new one, or get your friends to help you carry out everything!
row.short_description: One-armed robber is a chaotic first-person heist game that centers around a uniquely challenging premise. Players take the role of a determined robber equipped with only one arm, tasked with pulling off daring heists on banks, shops, and various establishments.

row.name: The Balls
row.detailed_description: Probably the SIMPLEST but HARDEST FPS in history. This is a simple, free game that you can play at school during computer science class , at work when the boss isn't looking , or when you just want to warm up your mind instead of morning coffee. 'The Balls' is not just another PVP FPS (Battle Royale) game. It redefines the freedom of movement in a virtual world. Breaking the boundaries of usual running and flying, we offer players complete freedom as geometric spheres, unrestricted by gravity or centrifugal forces. Unlimited Freedom of Movement Imagine a world where you can instantly reach any location without physical limitations. This dynamic changes everything you know about strategies and tactics in Battle Royale games. Community and Communication In 'The Balls', community is our priority. A simple and transparent communication system allows for easy connection with other players. Create lobbies, join matches, and invite friends with the press of a single button. Family-Friendly Graphics Our game is free from blood and explicit violence. Instead, players compete by attacking abstract, geometric shapes. Perfect for players of all ages. Ranking System An advanced ranking system tracks your daily, monthly, and overall results. Get ready for the introduction of clan duels and periodic tournaments, offering a new level of competition. Key Features: MULTIPLAYER Deathmatch and Battle Royale. The most dynamic movement mechanism. Global rankings and achievements. Vibrant, cartoon-style graphics. Simple communication system. Strategic build-and-destroy mechanics. Unique arenas for various battle strategies. Upcoming Features Clan Creation: Organize and manage your own clan in 'The Balls'. Monthly Tournaments: Compete for prizes in regular tournaments. Map Creation Mode: Design and share your own maps, offering extraordinary creativity to players. Join the 'The Balls' community today and experience unparalleled freedom of movement and exciting competition!
row.short_description: The game 'The Balls' is perfect if you're stuck in comp sci class, killing time at work when the boss isn't watching, or even just to get your brain fired up. But dude, make sure to play it with friends, 'cause playing solo is kinda lame...

row.name: KILLFISH
row.detailed_description: Welcome to KILLFISH , an immersive gaming experience that will take you on a journey like no other. In this Action/FPS game, you'll dive into a captivating world where robots have taken control on a factory. Embark on an epic adventure filled with a unique hook mechanic that will give you freedom to explore and kill in flashy ways. Key Features · Fast-pace movement mechanics: Immerse yourself in a fast-pace world in which you will have to use the hook and move fast in order to kill all enemies. · Stunning Visuals: Dive into a visually stunning world where every detail is meticulously crafted to bring KILLFISH's universe to life. From breathtaking illumination to intricately designed characters, prepare to be amazed. · Customization Options: Tailor your gameplay to your liking with an array of customization options. Express your personal gameplay style as you explore KILLFISH's levels. · Unique Style Meter: Kill in flashy ways to improve your score and buy the upgrades such as the explosive sniper.
row.short_description: Welcome to KILLFISH. In this Action/FPS game, you'll dive into a captivating world where robots have taken control on a factory. Embark on an epic adventure filled with a unique hook mechanic that will give you freedom to explore and kill in flashy ways.

row.name: Tricky Doors
row.detailed_description: Tricky doors is a captivating game that offers a variety of puzzles. Find a creative way to get out of each room. Tricky doors is a point-and-click game in the 'escape the room' genre with plenty of mini-games and complicated quests. You can open a lot of different doors. Behind each door, you will find hostile and friendly worlds, as well as familiar and exotic landscapes. Your task is always the same - you need to leave the place where the game sent you this time through a portal to move forward. Solve puzzles and find hidden objects. Many of them will be familiar to you. Some of them you'll see for the first time. Can you use all of them to find a way out? Challenge your quick-wittedness! Fantastic locations and beautiful graphics Unique escape stories Exciting search for hidden objects Challenging mini-games Will be interesting for both beginners and experienced players
row.short_description: Tricky doors is a captivating game that offers a variety of puzzles. Find a creative way to get out of each room. Tricky doors is a point-and-click game in the 'escape the room' genre with plenty of mini-games and complicated quests.

row.name: CIPHER-8
row.detailed_description: 🎊 CELEBRATING 8 YEARS SINCE THE RELEASE OF THE VIRTUAL FANTASY CONSOLE PICO-8, THIS TITLE IS RELEASED AS A FREE GAME! 🎊 You just couldn't let go of your dream to become some sort of cyberpunk Robin Hood, so you invented a device that connects your brain to the inner world of a high-security safe’s digital lock. Somewhat irritated, the safe suggests you play a game to make up for your intrusion. Lose and be locked in forever, or win to attain unimaginable wealth (to redistribute among those in need of course). Can you crack the cipher? CIPHER-8 is a brain-twisting game where you push numbers into a grid. Well, numbers or all kinds of manipulatory tricks (also known as 'special abilities' ). Or bombs apparently. Anyways, after all it’s about making the total value of each column match its goal value. However, changing one column affects the others as well. Oh and by the way, bonus points if you manage to plan ahead a few turns to keep your cipher streak going in the process! There are two game modes: ⚡️ BLITZ asks you to reach a target score in just 90 seconds, so you better get that brain juice flowing fast! 🧩 PUZZLE mode on the other hand is all about planning since there’s no timer, but you lose energy if you go without scoring for too many turns. Both modes track your skill and become more challenging every time you beat them . Note: This game is made using the virtual fantasy console PICO-8 (digipad + 2 buttons), but controls just fine via keyboard (arrows + X and C) or pretty much any controller. 💻 Design & Code: Fabian Fischer (@Ludokultur) 🎶 Dynamic music: @muse_energy
row.short_description: CIPHER-8 is a brain-twisting minimalist arcade puzzler where you push numbers into a grid and manipulate them with randomly drawn special abilities! Play blitz mode for frantic combo streaks, or analyze every move in puzzle mode. Both scale infinitely in their difficulty. How far can you go?
row.reviews: “It's the Dark Souls of puzzle games!” A player trying to beat 100 points in blitz mode... “I mean, how hard can it be?” Streamer Esty8nine before failing to reach 10 points for half an hour “I feel like a genius! [...] That's a lot of fun!” Esty8nine after playing for about an hour

row.name: Ocean Protector
row.detailed_description: Overview Ocean Protector is a free educational game that teaches students about the impacts of ocean acidification and how they can take action to prevent it. Through a series of interactive decisions and evaluations, students will learn about the causes and effects of ocean acidification and evaluate solutions that can help reduce its impact on marine ecosystems and people. This decision-driven experience helps students construct explanations, reason effectively, and become self-directed learners involving marine science and ocean literacy. Option to play in browser If you would prefer to play the game in your browser, feel free to go to the Outreach Games website by clicking the ' Visit the website ' button on the External Links section of the page. For educators Note for educators: lesson plans, guides to Next Generation Science Standards, and examples of module integration are also provided at the Outreach Games website.
row.short_description: Ocean Protector is a free online educational game that teaches students about the impacts of ocean acidification and how they can take action to prevent it.

row.name: Shadow Overlord: The Beginning
row.detailed_description: Shadow Overlord: The Beginning Become the Lord of Shadows in our exciting indie strategy game! Engage in challenging medieval battles as you command an army of the undead on your quest for domination. Lead your dark creatures in the conquest of towns and castles, all while immersing yourself in a captivating fantasy world. Experience the thrill of real-time strategy as you take control of your army and plunge into epic battles. The side camera puts you in the center of the action, allowing you to watch your every move on the battlefield. Become the essence of a dark entity and make crucial decisions to upgrade and evolve your units, preparing them for the ultimate challenge. Develop your army of the undead as you collect magical essence from the places you ravage and conquer. Use this energy to summon the great Dark Lord, an entity of unimaginable power that will turn the tide of battle in your favor. Discover the satisfaction of strategizing and seeing your tactics unfold on the battlefield. With a polygon graphic style that adds a unique touch to the game, you will be immersed in a dark and captivating world. Do you have what it takes to lead your dark hosts to victory? Master the strategy, evolve your units and make the medieval kingdoms tremble under your power. Get ready for an intense and exciting strategy experience in our indie game, where the fate of your undead army and the quest for ultimate power rest in your hands!
row.short_description: As a player, you will have to lead your armies of undead and magical creatures to expand Your empire and defeat your enemies. With an exciting plot and a challenging gameplay, this game will take you through epic and dangerous adventure battles while you become the most powerful ruler.

row.name: Mad Viking Games: VR Experience
row.detailed_description: Introducing the Mad Viking Games: VR Experience . Immerse yourself in an all-round experience of the Viking life. Not only will you be able to grab any sort of weapon or shield, but you will also have the ability to roam the hall of the races . The hall will offer the player the ability to visualize the future characters of the Mad Viking Games universe, starting out with the Humans and the Trolls . Enter each room and get a highly detailed version of every character, you can also interact with a smaller version of each character. Not only will you have the ability to visualize every character, but we have also added essential activities for you to enjoy the Viking lifestyle. The first and most important of all: fire . Get ready to use your torch to light your way around the hall . Remember that some braziers can light up the fire from your torch ! Of course, the last activity was lying. DRINKING is the most important part of the Norse experience . Enjoy some mead alongside the shields of the Mad Viking Games world. Beer stations will be available for you to fill your pint infinitely, exactly how the Gods intended it! Grab a weapon and destroy your enemies! You will have the ability to wield the Mjolnir , the hammer from the son of Odin . Use it to smash rocks and transform them into little pieces. Smashing not your style? No worries, we have Surtr's sword ! Slash your dummies with ease and transform each piece into molten lava. Fancy a little competition? Take some axes and throw them at the target! Compete with your friends to see how many you can stick to the highlighted sections. Remember to check your windows ! There might be a little peek into the unknown...
row.short_description: Introducing the Mad Viking Games: VR Experience. Immerse yourself in an all-round experience of the Viking life. Not only will you be able to grab any sort of weapon or shield, but you will also have the ability to roam the hall of the races.

row.name: Mission: Space
row.detailed_description: After the Earth exploded, the fate of the Earth is in your hands. By creatively building your own spaceship, you'll fight your way through space against pirates. On your journey you will meet many different life forms, some with good, others with bad intentions. After the Earth exploded, the pirates collected the last remnants to generate energy. As one of the last survivors, it is your task to explore the planets. These play an important role in the fight against the pirates, because on them you can mine various materials, as well as trade with the inhabitants to create more components for your rather small spaceship. On your journey through space, it will happen more often that pirates attack you. To progress further, you'll have to defeat them to get money to trade with. When you have enough equipment, you can face different bosses that will test your combat experience. Once you have defeated them, you will receive very special rewards. Shape your spaceship: As you progress through the game, you will unlock more and more different components, whether through trade or crafting. You can use these to upgrade your ship and make it stronger. In a construction menu, you can build the spaceship as it suits your play style to wipe out the pirates. Materials: Ores and important materials can be mined on planets and exchanged for money to buy other materials or objects, or you can keep it for yourself and collect more materials to upgrade your spaceship without having to buy stuff extra. Pirates: After a short explanation and briefing from your on-board computer, you'll have to prove yourself in a first battle, but be on your guard. There are different types of enemy ships and each one has special properties as a result, which can quickly make you stagger. Story: The goal is to expand your spaceship more and more, defeat all the pirates, and in doing so you will encounter different challenges that you must overcome. If you have upgraded your spaceship well enough, you can face various bosses that deliver a completely different combat experience. If you defeat the boss, you not only get special rewards, but you also recapture the stolen parts of Earth from the pirates until you have collected them all. Once you've captured all the pieces of the Earth, you'll be able to patch them back together.
row.short_description: After the Earth exploded, the fate of the Earth is in your hands. By creatively building your own spaceship, you'll fight your way through space against pirates. On your journey you will meet many different life forms, some with good, others with bad intentions.

row.name: Egyptian Ratslap - Card Game
row.detailed_description: As you enter the game, you will be welcomed with the smooth jazz music and the main menu screen. From there you can configure settings, look at a detailed instructions on the rules of the card game, or go right ahead and play the game! The aim of the game is to make the player use short term memorization skills to beat 3 bots who are all trying to have the most cards to win the game. And don't forget that anyone in the game can slap back in once they have lost all of their cards so make sure you keep track of what cards have been placed or you might be in trouble. Once a player has reached 52 cards, they have won Egyptian Ratslap!
row.short_description: Enjoy a laid-back session of your new favorite card game that mixes the rules of slap jack and more!

Set in the digital realm, you are the Firewall tasked with stopping a computer virus from infecting all programs. Equipped with an array of weapons and your wits, you will have to fight hordes of infected programs, explore vibrant digital environments and solve puzzles in order to progress. Are you the savior the Server needs?
row.short_description: Stylized sci-fi FPS shooter

row.name: Birds Aren't Real: The Game
row.detailed_description: Birds Aren’t Real is a 3D sandbox game with a comic twist. Based on the real-life satirical conspiracy theory, play as a government surveillance pigeon drone, using sneaky maneuvers and creative thinking to manipulate the citizens and dispel their suspicions about the government's avian task force. Fly around to explore and surveil your surroundings! Sabotage the conspiracists working against your organization! Deploy your poop in order to undermine your political detractors! Birds Aren’t Real aims to find some humor in a time of misinformation and distrust. It's a game for anyone that may need a brief escape from what at times can seem like an overwhelming and deeply pessimistic world. We invite anyone and everyone to give our game a try!

row.name: King of Avalon
row.detailed_description: King Arthur fell in battle, a victim of the betrayal of his nephew Mordred. Now, his body lies in a fortress on the sacred Isle of Avalon next to his powerful sword, Excalibur. It is only when Excalibur is raised again that a new king again will be crowned and the kingdom will be unified. The whole empire has been split into cities fighting each other. Many desire the power and magic of Excalibur but there is only room for one in the king's throne... King of Avalon is set in a fantasy medieval England bringing back the legend of King Arthur and the Knights of the Round Table. Build a mighty city, raise a greater army, master war strategy skills for an intelligent strategy to go to battle, train your magic dragon and wage war against your medieval enemy! Join a multiplayer alliance to survive every enemy assault and increase your chances of succeeding! The great war between kings is about to begin! Build the most powerful empire ever! Raise your dragon and build your army in the PvP quest to lift Excalibur and become King. Taste power and victory while making friends and enemies along the way. Chat, help, trade, and wage war with players around the globe in a multiplayer adventure. King Arthur’s death has left an empty throne... Get ready to get medieval! The epic battle to conquer the kingdom with your dragon has started! ◆ War! Everywhere. You and your army allies need to be prepared. Build up and upgrade your bases and bulk up epic armies with a war strategy - you're not the only ones with your eyes on the throne of the Empire! ◆ Multiplayer kingdom war alliances! No man is an island. Whether you’re rallying against a GvE Barbarian Leader or marching at a PvP bully, you’ll need allies that you can trust. ◆ Send a spy to your enemies with your troops before waging war against the enemy castle! ◆ Dragons! A legendary weapon of mass destruction. How will you train a legendary dragon to battle in your fantasy army? ◆ Chat & play! Easy-translation feature brings thousands of players from around the world together in this real-time multiplayer war. ◆ Strategy! Research and master army attack and defense skills to ensure that you have the edge over your magic enemies. Know when to be invisible and when to order an invasion in this PvP adventure! ◆ Building! Build the foundations of an Empire strong enough to survive in a dragon-fire war zone! ◆ Experience a realist gameplay in every mission. Manage and produce resources to build your army, conquer the kingdom, and win the throne! ◆ Epic free MMO fantasy adventure! The Legend of Camelot lives. Awesome monsters and dragons! Make strategy your ally and build the greatest army of all time in this multiplayer RTS! Be one of the heroes of King of Avalon and become a myth of the dragon-fire war!
row.short_description: Summon your Dragon and be the King of Frost and Flame in Avalon!

row.name: Conquistadorio: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Special Offer About the Game The conquistador, who has faced many trials in his life, decided to retire and become a hermit. Just lying in his solitary cave away from people. But it seems that fate itself throws new challenges at you even in such a simple matter. The coffin in which you like to sleep has disappeared. You need to embark on a search and solve a multitude of puzzles until you find it. This is how its story begins. There are 4 levels in which you will understand the backstory of the Conquistador and get the answer to why he went on the quest. Plot: You are about to embark on a search for the missing item and find it. Puzzles: Inventive and challenging puzzles will help you spend many hours solving captivating logical riddles. Graphics: A distinctive hand-drawn artistic style will allow you to enjoy a unique and charming aesthetic. Sound: Ambient sounds, background music, and character-specific sound effects will further immerse you in the game. Dialogues: Conquistador relies on non-verbal storytelling. So, no long and boring dialogues - only expressive animation of characters and the surrounding environment.

row.name: Stormshot

Enjoy the fun with a storm of bullets and become the most skilled shooter on Skull Isle! Beneath your feet lies the lost treasure island filled with danger and mysteries. To survive this unforgiving world, you must wield your greatest weapons: your unmatched wit, flawless aiming and absolute focus to fend off whatever evil may come! Game Features ◆ Never the same levels 300 challenging levels await you, use your wisdom and find the fastest way to solve every puzzle. Here’s some free advice: being a top challenger requires more than making the right choice, it is being able to plan ahead, capture the right timing and most importantly, precise execution. ◆ Explore the mists and experience various strategic gameplay. The Treasure Island is covered with mist, use your adventure instinct to find the lost treasures, defeat mysterious ghosts and the terrifying Sea Monster! ◆ Collect treasures to renovate ancient relics and decrypt the mysteries even words can’t describe. ◆ Reinforce your Stronghold and forge a strong alliance with others on the Treasure Isle, they will be your biggest support through the challenges and the best treasure you’ll ever find on this journey!

row.name: Too Shroom!
row.detailed_description: Too Shroom! is a Slash 'em up meets Roguelite game where the upgrades you choose are vital. Master the simple yet satisfying combat system, and find synergies and builds to clear as many waves as possible. You need to survive the hoards of hellish shrooms and kill each wave before time runs out. Collect seeds each run to unlock new characters and permanent upgrades.
row.short_description: Slash your way through hoards of hellish shrooms, defending your once peaceful land! Choose upgrades that synergize with your build to survive as long as possible against the infinitely scaling waves of monsters attempting to overwhelm you!

row.name: Celebrities Hacked
row.detailed_description: Celebrities Hacked takes you on a mesmerizing journey that pairs the familiar excitement of classic Qix and Xonix games with an innovative, bold twist. Here, your skills and reflexes are rewarded with a gallery of art that peels back the curtain on some of the most alluring celebrities. As you navigate the game landscape, strategically deploy power-ups, and overcome ticking clock challenges, you unlock the enthralling, unseen layers of the stars' private lives. Brace yourself for an adrenaline-pumped voyage into the clandestine world of celebrities. Remember to be discreet, as the insights you'll gain are spiced up with intrigue and not intended for the public eye! Stay alert for the hindrances that can derail your journey - while you do have a few tries, be mindful that the opportunities to retry are limited! Begin your journey with access to the hidden worlds of two celebrities for free, challenge your dexterity, and see if you can reveal their personal enigmas. Awaiting your arrival are 12 different celebrities, each holding a unique challenge for the worthy contender who dares to discover their hidden lives. 12 different celebrities await a challenger to hack their photos. [2 in base version of the game, and additional 10 in DLC's!] Explore different settings serving as a background for the phenomenal beauty of girls Expose the covered areas of the pictures and, eventually, reveal the whole picture Unlock the door to the secretive contents of girls' photos - make sure that no one is looking above your shoulder as these pics are saucy and not safe for work! Pay attention to the obstacles that will get in your way – you may have a few chances but be wary as the number of attempts is limited!
row.short_description: Celebrities Hacked takes you on a mesmerizing journey that pairs the familiar excitement of classic Qix and Xonix games with an innovative, bold twist. Here, your skills and reflexes are rewarded with a gallery of art that peels back the curtain on some of the most alluring celebrities.

row.name: Beacon Patrol: First Horizons
row.detailed_description: WISHLIST THE FULL GAME About the Game Beacon Patrol: First Horizons is a relaxing strategy game with endless possiblities. Steer your Coast Guard ship and build your own coastal map one tile at a time. Get more tiles by exploring and keep building indefinitely as long as you can keep scoring. Start with your ship at the Coast Guard HQ and you build your map from there. On your turn you place up to three tiles, connecting to the tile your ship currently occupies. Tiles must not be rotated and all their edges have to match. After placing a tile you immediately move your ship onto it. By spending one of your tokens you can take an additional movement to a connected tile. You score points for each tile that is connected to other tiles on all four sides. For scored points you receive new tiles to continue your journey. The game ends after allavaialble tiles have been played. Beacon Patrol: First Horizons combines the look and feel of a board game with the endless posibilities of a digital experience. Experience this cozy and strategic game at any time. The clear and cute art style lets you enjoy the coast and the sea from where ever you are.
row.short_description: Beacon Patrol: First Horizons is a relaxing strategy game with endless possiblities. Steer your Coast Guard ship and build your own coastal map one tile at a time. Get more tiles by exploring and keep building indefinitely as long as you can keep scoring.

I made this little game for myself and for you guys, sometimes I just want to beat something up. You can also switch the color of the character, the color of the blood, the background and the foreground at will during the game. About the Developer I'm Liujiajun , this is my seventh game on Steam, I hope you like my work and thanks for playing.
