row.name: Rot In A Porcelain Dream Playtest
Charon's Crossing
row.detailed_description: Journey Through The Underworld In Charon's Crossing, you play as the mythic ferryman, Charon. Your task is to safely ferry the souls of the departed through the treacherous rivers of the Underworld. As you maneuver through each of the five rivers—Lethe, Acheron, Cocytus, Phlegethon, and Styx—you'll confront a variety of obstacles and menacing foes that aim to obstruct your path. Power-Ups & Strategy With each completed stage, Hermes offers you a brief respite. Visit his shop to purchase vital power-ups that can make your journey smoother. From bolstering your health to manipulating the very fabric of time, choose the enhancements that align best with your strategy to ensure the safe passage of souls. Pixel-Art Arcade Action Experience a blend of strategy and skill in this Game & Watch-inspired title. Charon's Crossing presents players with a nostalgic trip featuring minimalist pixel-art graphics combined with classic 8-bit soundscapes. Will you successfully navigate the rivers and deliver all the souls, or will the Underworld's perils prove too challenging? Features Traverse five distinct rivers, each with its unique challenges. Battle and evade various foes and obstacles that aim to hinder your journey. Utilize strategic power-ups from Hermes' shop to aid in your travels. Engage in a visually captivating pixel-art world complemented by 8-bit tunes. Test your reflexes and decision-making skills in this arcade-style experience.
row.short_description: A mythological arcade-style game where you navigate Charon through the rivers of the Underworld. Dodge obstacles, confront adversaries, and strategize with Hermes' power-ups. Delve into a pixel-art world inspired by ancient legends.

row.name: Russian Warship
row.detailed_description: This game is a comic relief in the otherwise tragic war in Ukraine. It uses multiple popular jokes, starting with the famous phrase about the russian warship. It's a top-down shoot 'em up game with tower defense elements. You start at Zmiinyi Island (Snake Island) in the midst of the Black Sea where you find yourself attacked by multiple waves of enemy ships. You need to defend the island, gradually growing your arsenal with new weapons, turrets and upgrades. If you succeed to defend Zmiinyi you can proceed to free other territories and try to win the war.
row.short_description: This game is a comic relief in the otherwise tragic war in Ukraine. Based on many popular jokes, it mixes shoot 'em up and tower defense genres to create an action-filled top-down shooting experience which requires tactical thinking and smart resource management

row.name: Century of Anticipation
row.detailed_description: You are locked at home, eagerly anticipating the moment to step outside again. Only it's.... . . . . ...taking really long. In this tiny world filled with surprising interactions awaiting to be discovered, you must find ways to pass the time by engaging with various activities around the house, as you deal with the only company you have in this adventure: yourself. AS THE CLOCK TICKS AWAY... Deal with the slow passage of time in a short, visually striking adventure developed by musician and game designer Gools Explore the confines of your home and reach up to four different endings. Experience a unique soundtrack composed by artists from Recife, Brazil. Find and take part in a variety of activities around the house to make time pass! Try your hand at poetry... and send it to us! Or keep it to yourself, it's your choice! Play an instrument. Maybe get better at it? Explore your bedroom, take a nap, make a snack... ...AND ENTER THE REALMS OF YOUR OWN THOUGHTS.
row.short_description: Locked away at home, time slows to a crawl. Enjoy our gift to you, this delightful adventure with an unforgettable soundtrack by Brazilian artists.

row.name: 一梦封神
row.detailed_description: 本游戏以封神演义为背景，创造出真实虚拟梦幻般的玩家在线游戏（回合制）。本游戏以清新亮丽的q版风格为游戏画面，以商周两国之间的冲突为游戏基调，强调游戏主线剧情，在通关剧情后、鼓励玩家之间的交流、对抗，实现以玩家为游戏真正创造者的目的。 本游戏暂设定两大类内容：第一个内容以剧情为主的、第二个内容是以关卡设计为核心 1、游戏背景是封神演义为背景讲述姜子牙通过进行关卡的闯荡、进行修炼，结识新的伙伴，推翻纣王为首的邪恶势力，在过程中玩家可以通过闯关逐渐了解到人妖仙之间发生的故事，其中有妖的邪恶、有人的忠义双全、有背叛、也有悲伤离合。 2、设计理念将引导玩家进入一个封神的世界，将以关卡为主体，强调的是游戏回合的策略性、技能的结合，体现法宝的多种玩法，去迎战关卡的各类游戏Boss。 官方Q群：102305652
row.short_description: 《一梦封神》是一款基于封神演义为背景的回合制战斗游戏，以姜子牙的视角游历封神演义中著名的经典战役！并且玩家可获得各种知名英雄，养成自己最强大的队伍。

row.name: Astral Quester
row.detailed_description: First of all！This is a Space Waifu game... 'Astral Quester' is a unique space strategy card game that seamlessly blends the uncertain thrill of a road trip adventure with the strategic planning of a card game. Step into the shoes of an interstellar explorer and embark on an awe-inspiring journey into the unknown cosmos with a captivating group of space companions. The game features a card-based mechanism where each space companion, or 'waifu,' is a distinctive Star Maiden with unique skills and characteristics. Through recruiting, training, and assembling your card deck, you'll craft your own squadron of stellar ladies.
row.short_description: The game features a card-based mechanism where each space companion, or 'waifu,' is a distinctive Star Maiden with unique skills and characteristics. Through recruiting, training, and assembling your card deck, you'll craft your own squadron of stellar ladies.

row.name: 骰子模拟器
row.detailed_description: A dice throwing simulator. Click the corresponding button to roll several dice that are common in TRPGs and get the result. Drag the mouse to rotate the viewing angle freely, and the scroll wheel zooms in on the screen size.
row.short_description: A dice throwing simulator. Click the corresponding button to roll several dice that are common in TRPGs and get the result. Drag the mouse to rotate the viewing angle freely, and the scroll wheel zooms in on the screen size.

row.name: Minute
row.detailed_description: Embark on an action pack steampunk journey like no other! Plunge into a mesmerizing fantasy world where gears spin, steam hisses, and brass contraptions come to life! Minute is a 3D action platformer where you'll play as a brave wind-up toy named Tink, a magical steampunk automaton toy crafted by a skilled tinkerer who embarks on a perilous journey in his creator's workshop. Experience a whimsical tale of courage, discovery, and self growth as you venture through the maze of whirling cogs and ticking clocks. Hone your combat skills as you challenge mischievous adversaries who get in your way. Master your abilities to overcome an abundance of expected obstacles and unlock hidden routes as you uncover the mysteries behind this clockwork world. Beat up gangster bugs, avoid nasty falls and scale the heights of a workshed. Embrace a heartfelt and soul-stirring story where narrative and gameplay weave into a uniquely metaphorical experience. Custom Combat Experience : Experiment with attack patterns as you fight through the workshop. Explore A Open Clockwork World : Dash, jump and bounce with your trusty key. Uncover the mysteries : What is your purpose? Who created you? Where are they now? This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: A 3D action platformer where you play as a wind-up toy in a Tinkerer's workshop set in the Victorian Age. As a small wind-up toy, you must rely on your wind-up key to embark on an arduous journey. Defeat enemies and uncover a dark secret within the rooms.

row.name: 哈希绿洲 Hash Oasis
row.detailed_description: Hash Oasis is a 3D social application designed specifically for gamers. Here, we offer a unique virtual lover experience to fulfill your daily emotional companionship needs: Virtual Lover, Emotional Support:  When you feel empty and lonely, but can't find someone to talk to, there's always someone waiting to be with you and keep you company. Immersive Experience, Enjoy Dating:  Go on dates, sing songs, watch movies, play games, and experience the thrill of romance with your virtual lover. Supported by VR glasses and enhanced with motion capture and immersive visual effects, you'll enjoy a dating experience as real as those offline. A picturesque beach party A bar party with dazzling light and shadow A shared cinema that spans time and space An immersive tower defense game A dreamy and illusory self home
row.short_description: Virtual Lover, Emotional Support，Hash Oasis is a 3D social app, offering a unique virtual lover for emotional companionship. Feel supported anytime you're lonely. Enjoy immersive dating, singing, movies, and games with VR-enhanced realism. Experience romance as tangible as in real life.
row.notes: This game contains content that may not be suitable for all ages, or should not be accessed at work: disguised sexual nudity, common adult content

row.name: The Intruder
row.detailed_description: Important Note:  This game was made free because it doesn't meet JoyTree Studios standards Thank you to all the people who have bought the game while it was a paid product and supported us. This game was our first product on steam therefore it has great sentimental value so we don't want to remove it but we also don't want to keep charging people for an inferior product.  Embark on a Heart-Stopping Journey in 'The Intruder' - a spine-chilling 3D Horror Adventure game. As the protagonist sets out to meet his girlfriend, a fateful turn leaves him stranded with an empty gas tank. Desperate for help, he seeks refuge in an ominous mansion, unaware of the nightmare that lurks within. Discover the true meaning of terror as you navigate the dark corridors of the mansion, encountering unimaginable horrors and an insidious monster determined to claim your life. Every step you take is filled with tension, as you unravel the dark secrets hidden within the walls. Immerse yourself in a meticulously designed environment, complete with atmospheric soundscapes and bone-chilling visuals that will leave you trembling with fear. Solve intricate puzzles, outsmart the relentless pursuer, and unveil the mystery that binds you to this haunting place. With 'The Intruder,' prepare to face your deepest fears and fight for survival in an interactive horror experience like no other. Will you escape the clutches of the mansion's malevolent entity, or will you become just another victim trapped within its sinister grasp? Dare to confront the unknown, experience the terror of 'The Intruder' and test your nerves in a game that will haunt your dreams long after you've played.
row.short_description: Uncover the chilling secrets of 'The Intruder.' Navigate a haunted mansion, solve puzzles, and evade the lurking darkness. A suspenseful horror-adventure that tests your survival instincts.

row.name: Glitchers: Hack 'em Up
row.detailed_description: Fight and Hack enemies in this casual beat ‘em up fantasy game with a puzzle twist. Kick medieval asses through out the Ruled Earth: - Enter the Hack Mode to solve puzzles and spread your attacks. - Connect to your buddy Ada to perform powerful combos - Defeat evil bugs to prevent them from turning the enemies into stronger zombies
row.short_description: Fight and Hack enemies in this casual beat ‘em up fantasy game with a puzzle twist.

row.name: Together Synergy
row.detailed_description: Together Synergy is a 2 player local co-op game where one player controls the left wheel and the other player controls the right wheel. Drive With A Friend! You take the left wheel and your friend takes the right wheel! Turning will be difficult! The players must coordinate with each other to turn Right wheel goes backward and left wheel goes forward to turn right! Left wheel goes backward and right wheel goes forward to turn right! Choose your character! The game features many characters you can choose from! Clear the levels Together Synergy is a 3D platform game! Test you and your friends synergy together!
row.short_description: Together Synergy is a 2 player local co-op game where one player controls the left wheel and the other player controls the right wheel. The two players must work together to complete the levels without falling off the platforms.

row.name: Cellosseum
row.detailed_description: Cellosseum is a bullet heaven following the progress of a lone cell as it battles a variety of enemies on its quest to guide the evolutionary process of life itself. From upgrading your attacks, shields, health, and speed, to understanding your role in the creation of life on the planet of Ceres Prime—will you create life from nothing, or will you be lost to the cold indifference of the galaxy. The Lone Cell: Play as a cell on its quest to become the leader of evolution on Ceres Prime. Choose from a range of unique attack types that evolve the range, power, and type of projectile as you blast your way through enemies. The Enemies: Life for a cell isn’t just about peacefully floating through the primordial soup—prepare yourself and your reflexes as you face off against challenging and unique enemies with varied attack characteristics such as: Edgelord, Snowflake, and Snuggle Bear. Content: This game’s content includes a wealth of watercolor artwork, characters, and music that is completely scratch made. Float your way across beautifully stylized cellular landscapes while engaging with memorable hand-drawn characters. Features: This game features an ability upgrade system for your character. Choose the evolutionary traits that you want to keep that suit your gameplay style.
row.short_description: Cellosseum is a bullet heaven following the progress of a lone cell as it battles a variety of enemies on its quest to guide the evolutionary process of life itself. Upgrade your attacks, shields, health, and speed to understand your role in the creation of life on the planet of Ceres Prime.

row.name: Intergalactic
row.detailed_description: Intergalactic is a VR game centered in the setting of space. You can explore a range of levels with big enemy ships, black holes, asteroid fields, and more! You fly through space in a ship with a fully interactable, working futuristic HUD. Fly through the levels and destroy randomly spawning ships, minibosses, and asteroids. This game features a semi realistic graphics design with low poly models. Defeating these ships will sometimes spawn gears that you can collect and use at the shop in the main menu to upgrade and improve your ship. There is also a 5-mission campaign where you raid a huge enemy ship and destroy it. The game comes with many QOL features such as a standing mode and setting to make the game more comfortable for players who may experience VR sickness.
row.short_description: Destroy Asteroids and Ships, Explore Space!

row.name: Floating Life Record
row.detailed_description: Introduction: One morning, I woke up and was about to go to work, but upon leaving, I found myself in a strange place filled with dangerous monsters, You must find a way to escape here and return to the real world, but before that, you need to collect materials, food, and weapons to ensure that you can survive here. Gameplay: The game is a 3D horror survival game, where you need to collect food to ensure you don't starve to death and also face dangerous monsters. In the game, you will play the role of a person who accidentally enters a strange world, using W, A, S, D to move, and the mouse to control the perspective. You are not the first person to come here. There are many notes left by predecessors on the map, and reading more notes can provide more clues. In the game, some enemies cannot be killed, and you need to avoid these special enemies. This game includes mild horror, survival, shooting, and more. Features: First person horror survival game, thrilling exploration, clever survival. A small sandbox map for you to explore. You need to follow some strange rules in the game, otherwise you will be punished. Exciting and tense gaming experience. Support for Windows
row.short_description: I found myself in a strange place filled with dangerous monsters, You must find a way to escape here and return to the real world, but before that, you need to collect materials, food, and weapons to ensure that you can survive here.

row.name: Clash of the Elements
row.detailed_description: Wield the elements to compose the music in real time by battling your friends! Choose among the proposed maps, unite and combine the elements to create your unique mix, reflecting the process of fierce battle in abstract 2D space. You can move up and down, and capture the nearby elements. Captured elements will deliver their sound, and by combining elements from both players (air, water, fire, earth) a unique musical blend is created. With capturing two elements, the spells become available depening on the elments pairing: air+water, air+fire, water+earth, fire+earth. Hitting enemy with the spells reduces their hit points, while captured elements increase hit points. When the music ends, the player with most hit points wins the match. Play multiplayer against other people or locally vs AI: W,S - movement, E - capturing, Z,X,C,V - spells. P.S. The mobile version is planned soon.
row.short_description: Wield the elements to compose the music in real time by battling your friends! Choose among the proposed maps, unite and combine the elements to create your unique mix, reflecting the process of fierce battle in abstract 2D space.

row.name: Warlock The Bounty Hunter
row.detailed_description: Warlock the bounty hunter is a roguelike fast paced game where you play as a warlock taking on as many bounties as you can before your eventual death. There are 6 bounties and 4 areas, each with different pros and cons. More bounties you complete, stronger you get, more skills you unlock to help you with increased difficulty. It is an endless run where enemies outpace you and you start again. How far can you go?
row.short_description: A fast paced short byte-sized roguelike game where you play as a warlock taking bounties.

row.name: AG Legacy Builder
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Arcade Galaxy, a classic kart racing universe full of fun and games. Inspired by gaming classics like Rollercoaster Tycoon and Super Mario Kart, players can join in on an intergalactic adventure full of high-speed joyrides. And for those that seek even more challenges - players can enjoy a fusion of party gaming and user-generated modes, making for nearly endless possibilities! In Arcade Galaxy, players can seamlessly drop into matches with friends and share their creations. Create your own Cub avatar with a vast array of cosmetics and abilities. This rich customization system lets players craft truly unique identities to set them apart from the competition. Beyond pure gameplay, the game also offers a robust level editor. With this tool, you can create and customize almost every element within the game, from racetracks, obstacles, to the behavior of objects in each world. The editor includes accessible level design tools and a visual, esay-to-use logic editor, all boasting unique features which highlight player creativity. Once crafted, players can publish their creations with friends and even race on custom tracks. Through the logic editor, you can harness the power of a visual programming language to transform the gameplay experience. From setting traps, designing hurdles, to establishing your game rules – everything is within your grasp. Embark on this intergalactic racing adventure, share your passion and imagination with players worldwide, and dive into the endless joys that Arcade Galaxy has to offer! - Complete custom racing challenges using unique power-ups and skills. - Create custom racetracks, obstacles, and game rules with an intuitive level editor. - Share and race on user-generated tracks globally. - Customize your Cub avatar with a galaxy of cosmetics and abilities.
row.short_description: Welcome to Arcade Galaxy! Challenge players worldwide in a universe of classic kart racing fun! Use skills like lightning strikes and super jumps, customize your avatar’s appearance and abilities, and even design your own game modes. Unleash your racing dreams in a colorful, nostalgia-fueled galaxy!

row.name: Go Go Zombies
row.detailed_description: Rage and rampage as a fast zombie mob! First, they killed you. Then, they brought you back. Now you're loose and it's time for some sweet, sweet, blood-soaked payback! Kill 'em, baby! Kill 'em all! Just click where you want the zombies to go, and the ones in range will attack nearby enemies automatically. 03/29/24 Added hotkeys 1-5 for easy weapon selection 3-5 hour game. FLASHING LIGHTS WARNING: This game contains flashing lights and trippy audio visualizations. THESE EFFECTS ARE ON BY DEFAULT ON THE START SCREEN and can be toggled on or off from the SETTINGS menu or the PAUSE menu at any time. If you are sensitive to flashing lights you should turn them off immediately. Slammin' soundtrack includes The Gobs, Citric Dummies, GEE TEE, Thee Windom Earles, Redshift, Dope Sweater, Checkpoint, BEEF, Prison Affair, The Zombie Dandies, Voodoo Puppets, Untimely Dosage, Sovran, The Hydeouts, Punk Rock Opera, Sept, No Brains, Safety Pins, Bass Feens, Hawt Denim, Los Pecadores, Vampire Death, and more!
row.short_description: Sweet raging fast zombie revenge!
row.notes: There's blood. Lots of blood. Splishy splashy bloodiness everywhere. And sometimes heads pop off. And shoot up in the air. With blood. Which is really more funny than it is gory, but yeah. Blood.

row.name: Adventures in Anglonia
row.detailed_description: Created for a master's thesis on learning games, engagement, and language instruction, Adventures in Anglonia is a text-based RPG created in RPGMakerMZ meant to be played in local groups of four students (though it can be played singleplayer) in the first-year Japanese university classroom. Play as one of four unique adventurers sent into the dangerous and mysterious land of Anglonia to search for a mystical wish-granting Artifact, the Heart of the Word. Engage in narratively driven battles that test your listening comprehension about the story of the game, solve dialogue puzzles, and negotiate deals. Make impactful narrative decisions that shape the future of your adventure, Anglonia, and the world. In battle, harness the power of language to use impactful skills by associating TOEIC vocabulary, and constructing sentences. Please be aware that the game features blood, fantasy violence, and language (the bad kind). It features themes of colonialism and native exploitation, and these themes feature heavily in the choices that players are asked to make throughout the game. When incorporated in the classroom, Adventures in Anglonia took 6 weekly classes (roughly 9 hours). The game is divided into five 'weeks' but oftentimes (particularly for week two) groups took multiple classes to complete them. If playing singleplayer, these divisions can be safely ignored. Originally, the game experience contained supplemental materials such as readings, but those have been incorporated into the game as scrolling text and items. It should work. It was a truly rewarding experience to build and then play this game with my students, and the results of the research should be published somewhere online at some point in the future following the completion of my thesis.
row.short_description: A language learning game created for a master's thesis -- play as one of four unique adventurers in the mysterious land of Anglonia, searching for the wish-granting artifact, the Heart of the Word. Practice listening comprehension, TOEIC vocabulary, and problem-solving.
row.notes: Some blood and gore, occasional offensive language.

row.name: The Backrooms: Unbounded
row.detailed_description: The Backrooms: Unbounded is a Free Simple Linear first person body camera horror game based on the backrooms. You take the role of a police officer who noclips out of reality while on duty. Can you survive all of the 8 main levels? LEVELS The game will have the 8 main levels and more based on the backrooms wiki. Each level will have it's own unique puzzles and design. But be careful, something might be lurking. FEATURES The game will feauture no UI to keep it as immersive as possible. The game will feature entities. PLAY TIME 10-20 minutes ROADMAP My goal is to fix bugs that occur and add any fixes. This is my first game so my apologies if the game is a bit buggy :].
row.short_description: The Backrooms: Unbounded is a Free Simple Linear single player first person body camera horror game based on the backrooms. You take the role of a police officer who noclips out of reality while on duty. Will you make it out alive?
row.notes: May not be appropriate for all ages. Gore and Violence that could be disturbing for certain players

row.name: The Backrooms Deluxe
row.detailed_description: UPDATE 2.0 Update 2.0 is finally out and it introduces many changes, fixes and overall improvements the community has been asking for! About the Game Discover various levels of danger while trying to escape the eerily familiar backrooms based on popular creepypasta lore. New and Unique Levels Traverse through 20+ unique levels based on the Backrooms lore. Regular content updates will add even more levels. Each level features a different way to escape, with various dangers along the way. Scary Entities In The Backrooms Deluxe, there are many entities blocking your way of finally exiting the backrooms. Each of the entities has its own appearance and mechanics Join the official Discord Server for updates about it! (updates will still be posted on Steam but the discord server has sneak peeks about it)
row.short_description: A new, immersive Backrooms game featuring many entities and many levels.
row.notes: This game contains some pretty scary topics, monsters and music. Some levels may also contain stuff such as blood on the walls.

row.name: Totality
row.detailed_description: If you can’t travel to a total solar eclipse, bring the eclipse to you! Experience a complete total solar eclipse from start to finish. Feeling impatient? Speed up time or jump ahead. You can even pause time for extended totality! Want to stare at the sun without going blind? You can do that here. Just don’t do that with the real sun! You can also view the eclipse through a pane of #14 welding glass or a pinhole projector. Beyond the eclipse itself, the environment is designed to be very relaxing. Watch the day pass from sunrise to sunset and overnight under a clear, cloudless sky. Listen to the wind dynamically blow through the trees on top of a low mountain. Breathe, relax, and enjoy your time here.
row.short_description: A simulation of a total solar eclipse, complete with time control, a pane of #14 welding glass, and a pinhole projector.

row.name: True Dice Roller
row.detailed_description: Perfect for tabletop RPGs and board games alike. True Dice Roller offers the best of two worlds: it combines the convenience and automated math of a digital dice roller with the fun and realistic feel of rolling actual dice. Basic Features Better than Real Dice. Dice results are based on actual physics and not computer generated numbers, which never feel as trustworthy as physical dice. Unlike real dice, TDR dice are mathematically perfectly balanced, no salt water testing required! Fast and Intuitive. TDR is designed to be extremely fast as well as user friendly. It’s at least as fast and intuitive as rolling real dice in a real dice tray. Auto Math. Automatically adds dice results and additional modifiers are a button press away. Enjoy rolling physical dice without the mental math (unless you like the mental math). True Materials and Sounds. Realistic, hand recorded sound effects and altered physics based on material, such as glass, plastic or metal. Widely Compatible. Show the sum of all rolled dice or show each dice result separately based on your needs, making TDR compatible with any tabletop game that uses standard dice (d20s, d6s, d10s, percentile dice, etc). This includes classics like D&D as well as newer games like Candela Obscura or Blades in the Dark. 60+ Dice Sets. A vast array of dice sets from colored plastic to polished obsidian to solid gold. Place and roll unlimited copies of dice you own. Four dice sets are included for free, others can be purchased for significantly less than dice sets in real life. Be a dice goblin on the cheap! Advanced Features Custom Dice Templates. Arrange and save the placement and configuration of your dice inside your virtual dice tray, making it easy to use different templates for different occasions, or to quickly reset and reorganize your dice with the push of a button. Fast Dice Calculator. An advanced tool for GMs. For maximum speed, use a digital-only dice calculator that can roll and add huge numbers of dice (if you need 100d6 damage, for example), or roll up to 50 checks against a target number at once (in case of needlessly large numbers of enemies or attacks). Numpad inputs make for extremely fluid usage. Also, you can roll nonstandard dice types, such as a d3 or a d500, useful for funky dice or large rollable charts. Dice Analytics. See if a specific die really is only rolling low or high. Display graphs and averages data for any die you’ve placed in your dice tray. Useful as an educational tool or to learn which dice have really betrayed you.
row.short_description: A physics based dice roller that keeps the fast, intuitive fun of rolling real dice while automating the math. Hand recorded sounds and fine-tuned physics bring 60+ dice sets to life with materials like glass, plastic and metal. Use advanced features like Dice Analytics or the Dice Calculator

row.name: Defend Earth: Xenos Survivors - Prelude
row.detailed_description: PURCHASE THE FULL GAME NOW DISCLAIMER: If you decide to purchase the game and continue playing, your save game will be fully compatible with the full version of the game. This is the PRELUDE for 'Defend Earth: Xenos Survivors'. In 'Defend Earth: Xenos Survivors - PRELUDE', you will experience: Thrilling auto-firing bullet hell action Rich character progression with multiple agents to unlock and upgrade Deep customization with a vast arsenal of weapons, modules, and ultimate abilities Intense, fast-paced runs lasting between 10 to 20 minutes Global warfare with levels modeled after real-world locations Flexible difficulty with various game modes offering increased rewards Use your Ultimate ability to annihilate vast numbers of Xenos! In the tumultuous year of 2058, Earth faces its darkest hour. An alien invasion, known as the Xenos, threatens the survival of humanity. Our regular forces crumble, overwhelmed by the otherworldly onslaught. Amidst the chaos, a beacon of hope emerges - an elite group of warriors: DEFCON: Xenos. Your mission? Repel the alien invasion and secure humanity's future! As a member of this prestigious unit, you will traverse the war-ravaged cities and desolate landscapes of our beloved home planet, Earth. You will face an evolving enemy, growing more intelligent and ferocious with each encounter. Brace yourself for an escalating challenge that will test your mettle and push your strategic prowess to the limit. Carve your way through hordes of aliens with your powerful arsenal! Explore endless combinations of agents, skills, ultimate abilities, and augmentations to forge your path to victory! Each run, carve through the alien hordes, leveraging your ultimate ability to decimate vast swaths of Xenos, and try different agent and ability combinations to keep the enemy guessing. In the face of oblivion, will you stand as Earth's last line of defense? Join the fight in 'Defend Earth: Xenos Survivors'. Try different combinations of Agents, Skills, Ultimate abilities and Augmentations!
row.short_description: You are Earth's last line of defense in a relentless alien invasion. Experience intense 3D top-down roguelite action. Outsmart, outgun and survive smarter, increasingly menacing foes with a versatile arsenal in diverse landscapes. Every run escalates the challenge - adapt, evolve, dominate!

row.name: The Local
row.detailed_description: Key Features Mechanically rich and satisfying movement, loosely inspired by Surf and B-Hop 5 gamemodes Multiplayer A large, playground-like world Rail Grinding Sliding , Wall Running and Climbing Air Strafing and Bunny Hopping Timed - 15+ time trials Orders - Complete orders and go for the highscore Zen - Relax and practice ...and 2 multiplayer gamemodes Capture - A capture the flag-esque gamemode Infection - Infect, or avoid becoming infected Timed and Zen are also supported Proximity chat Public server browser Create levels for Timed, Capture, Infection, and Zen Play by yourself, or online
row.short_description: A fast-paced movement game, loosely inspired by Surf and B-Hop. Featuring 5 gamemodes, multiplayer, and a large, playground-like world. Master the movement, and conquer the leaderboards.

row.name: Roles & Dice
row.detailed_description: Roles & Dice is a meticulously crafted online virtual tabletop game, where imaginations run wild, and epic adventures await! Tailored for fans of tabletop RPGs, this game enables you to load any image file to construct immersive maps and draw your friends into exciting worlds, all from the comfort of your home! Features: 🗺 Versatile Map Integration: Load any image file as a map, allowing boundless possibilities to explore and create intricate worlds, designed by your imagination. 🎮 Distinctive Game Modes: Engage in the Exploration mode where players control their characters in real-time, uncovering the realms set by the Game Master, or dive into riveting turn-based battles, strategizing every move. 💼 Dynamic Role-Playing: One player takes on the role of the Game Master, orchestrating the universe's destiny, while others immerse themselves as characters in the unfolding tale. 🧙 Character & Group Creation: Game Masters can forge characters, assemble groups, and craft maps, which can be saved and swiftly loaded to streamline gameplay during campaigns. 👥 Multiplayer Interaction: Play with friends and experience collaborative storytelling, all while forging memories and facing challenges together. 🎢 User-Friendly Interface: Designed with players in mind, Roles & Dice provides an intuitive and seamless experience, allowing easy navigation and game setup. 📜 Campaign Saving: Save your meticulously created characters, maps, and groups for quick load and play, ensuring smooth transitions between sessions. Engage in Unparalleled Adventure: Whether you're exploring uncharted territories, battling formidable foes, or immersing yourself in stories untold, Roles & Dice provides the ultimate virtual tabletop experience, allowing you and your friends to create and live out your fantastical tales. Embark on your journey in Roles & Dice and unravel the realms of endless possibilities! 🌌
row.short_description: Roles & Dice is a dynamic online virtual tabletop RPG! Dive into worlds you create, assume roles, and strategize in turn-based battles. Real-time exploration and imaginative map creation await. Ideal for Game Masters and players seeking dynamic, interactive adventures!

row.name: EGG DROP
row.detailed_description: Wanna support EGG DROP? Wanna get some costumes? Download EGG DROP Steam edition! BATTLE ROYALE ACTION Be the last hen standing in the world's first all-female (nonhuman) Battle Royale! ESCAPE THE EGG BULLET HELL Survive hundreds of eggs as they're rained down on you from above! DOOM YOUR OPPONENTS TO AN EGGY FATE Collect corn and powerups to help you produce your own eggs to send to the unlucky souls below! EGG DROP? MORE LIKE EGG DRIP After winning so many games, show off your costumes to the lesser fowl Join the EGGTAD discord!!!
row.short_description: Flutter around to dodge falling eggs from chickens above, and collect corn and power ups to drop eggs on the unlucky fowl below!

row.name: Der Geistermeister
row.detailed_description: In diesem Textbasierten Rollenspiel erleben sie interaktive Geschichten und Abenteuer. Mit jedem neuen Abenteuer Sammeln sie mehr Erfahrung und neue Gegenstände um so immer mehr Möglichkeiten ausprobieren zu können. Für die neu Einsteiger in dieser Thematik: Hier spielt man eine Interaktive Geschichte die sich jedes mal wenn eine Entscheidung getroffen wird verändert. Für Alte Hasen: Sie spielen ein klassisches Solo Abenteuer im Stiel von alten Abenteuerbüchern (z.B. Der Einsame Wolf, etc...) Das besondere an diesem Spiel ist die Möglichkeit eigene Geschichten mit dem Integrierten Creator zu verfassen und diese dann den anderen Spielern zur Verfügung zu stellen. Auf diese weise werden immer neue und unbekannte Abenteuer auf einen warten und es kommt keine Langeweile aus. Auch sind schon abgeschlossene Geschichten weiter interessant da es immer mehrere Wege gibt die zum Ziel führen. Abgerundet wird der Spielspaß durch die verschiedenen Gegenstände und Fertigkeiten die es erlauben seinen eigenen Charakter frei nach Vorlieben zu gestallten.
row.short_description: Textbasiertes Rollenspiel mit Creator für eigene Abenteuer!

row.name: Dung Beetle Adventure
row.detailed_description: Once upon a time there was a small dung beetle, and like most dung beetles it was hungry. Mushroom season was coming to an end, but there were still rosetops to be found, a favourite in the beetle community. When morning came purple dung beetles flocked out of their homes dead-set on getting their tiny insect hands on the much sought-after treat. In the end, only one single beetle remained, and it just so happens to be the hero of our story. With its broken wings everything seemed doomed... But maybe there is hope left for a hurt, hungry, but inventive dung beetle? Features: Meet a whole cast of insects (and spiders) in a mildly challenging short adventure Listen to a lot of insects, all bathed in the soundscape of a lovely sunny day Meet one of natures unsung heroes: The dung beetle Dance to an original soundtrack, composed for bugs and humans alike Collect eight simple (and two fairly simple) achievements
row.short_description: A short (and free) adventure game, where you are tasked with helping a hurt, hungry, but inventive dung beetle on its journey to find something to eat near the end of the mushroom season.

row.name: Stellar Bewitching (Remastered)
row.detailed_description: In the Galaxy of Xerxes, Year 212 A.XW. (After Xerian War), parallel to the events of 'Rave Heart.' A teenage farian girl named Elya Seres residing in Crasper City, Planet Kardel, is troubled for Venusia's Day, the day of love and romance. The pressure of her friends asking her why she's still single all this time has pushed her to ask for her slime familiar's help to get her a boyfriend. Her familiar Floryn, however, has different ideas on how they can get Elya her boyfriend for Venusia's Day. A roller coaster ride of an adventure to the Limbo Realm. Will Elya be able to find a guy to show off for Venusia's day to her friends, will she forever live in the reality that she will remain a single loser in front of her friends for Venusia's day? Fast-paced turn-based battles Secret boss fight Fun-filled adventure Remastered Art by Berry B Side View Battle System that uses the Order Turn Combat Style. Taking extra actions or manipulating them using agility manipulation. Inspired by Octopath Traveler, you can reduce an enemy's shield points by inflicting weaknesses on enemies. Once the enemy's shield points reach nihil, you can inflict stun to the enemy for two whole turns. Bonus: Tv tropes page by Bugfragged:
row.short_description: Find your destiny and your boyfriend in the Limbo Realm. Play as a teenage farian witch named Elya Seres, looking for a boyfriend for Venusia's day so she can remain one of the cool kids. Venture into the Limbo Realm with her slime-familiar Floryn in this turn-based Sci-Fi RPG.
row.notes: General mature themes of fantasy battles, using weapons to defeat enemies.

row.name: Envoy
row.detailed_description: Envoy is a short physics based spaceflight game where you have been created by a monolith for the sole purpose of retrieving 'force crystals' to it. Evade increasingly aggressive locals, utilize special abilities, all to complete your mission. Your mission is to retrieve five force crystals to the monolith. Your sole and only purpose is to deliver force crystals back to a monolith. Weave and dodge around asteroids by utilizing realistic space physics, and have your flight somewhat regulated by a slight drag force applied when going too fast. Locals have noticed your presence and will get more aggressive over time. You are not alone on your mission, and not in a good way. For some reason, locals don't want you to complete your mission and will do their best to stop you. The further you progress and longer you take, the more aggressive ships they'll send, ranging from police ships to military battleships. Utilize various abilities to keep yourself safe from the locals. As you retrieve force crystals, you will unlock new abilities to utilize to make your mission easier. You can use them to outwit the locals, avoid an asteroid collision, or just accelerate the speed of your mission. Survive as long as possible after completing your mission. Once the mission is complete, you have only one objective: survive. Utilize abilities and the skills you have learned to fight even more aggressive locals, as they throw their most powerful forces your way. Why is Envoy a free game? Envoy was made for the summer flowjam 2023 game jam, and is a free game available on the web. Additionally, it is being listed on Steam for free because it lacks the following: Precise volume (game can be muted) , graphics, resolution, and keybinding settings. A pause menu. More than 30 minutes of gameplay. Support for controllers or users without a computer mouse. Please be aware of these when downloading the game!!
row.short_description: You have been created by a mysterious monolith with a single goal: to retrieve five force crystals back to it as quickly as possible. Deal with the plights of space physics, evade the locals, and complete your mission as soon as possible.

row.name: Carball 360 (beta)
row.detailed_description: *Carball360 is in test_hover Welcome to Carball 360, a game of skill, experience, and a bit of luck. Carball 360 is a simple game. There are no skins to buy, there are no glitches to exploit. There’s an arena, a ball, 2 players, two optional AI and 60 seconds. There are no assigned goals. The team that touches the ball last before it scores, scores the goal regardless of what goal they scored on. This last-touch scoring blurs the line between offensive and defensive roles creating an exciting and different playing experience. We capped the frames per second (fps) at 90 fps to promote a gameplay of skill. Who’s the better player, not who has the better computer. There are no settings to change. Everyone is playing the EXACT same game. Same camera angle, same perspective, same everything. The cars are exactly the same. Same hitbox, same top-speed available, same everything. Wins are wins. Losses are losses. Ties are meaningless. Find your play style, find your stance, find your strategy and beat the player in front of you. Join the beta and let us know what you love and what you hate as we strive to make the best game possible.
row.short_description: A game of carball where the last team to touch the ball scores the goal. An AI named Vicky is there to fill the void when friends are unavailable. Light, simple, competitive.

row.name: Suspicious Shuffle: Free For All
row.detailed_description: Liked it? Support it! Tickled your pickle? Show support by leaving a review, and wishlisting or purchasing: Thank you in advance, I'm glad Shuffle brought you some enjoyment! Search ' Suspicious Shuffle ' on Steam. About the Game This is the free version of Suspicious Shuffle , it's the full game with no features held back, drag your friends in for a romping good time! Imagine if Mario Party was Co-Op, or if you're kinda old (feels bad man): Pyramid Escape from Warcraft 3. Mario Party meets Geometry Wars in this minigame adventure for 1-6 players! Play through a 1-6 player solo/co-op campaign (approx. 4-5 hours) utilizing a diverse set of skills in a ever-Shuffling 29 minigame fiesta! In the process, enjoy a light-hearted story involving the Suspicious Dealer and restoring balance to the universe. The stakes have never been lower! Is an adventure really complete without hats? Clearing the campaign rewards you with priceless Stars which can be used to unlock customisation options and get fancy! Sometimes we all need a break from helping one other to show off and find out who really is the very best. It'll be you, obviously. Prove it over 18 PvP minigames. Mix and match your favorite minigames with modifiable settings to play them the way you like them, no judgement.
row.short_description: 37 Unique Minigames playable for free, online CoOp/PvP for 1-6 players!

row.name: Farm Garden Simulator
row.detailed_description: Farm Garden Simulator is a farm simulator game where you can grow a lot of crops and raise animals. - Grow a variety of crops You can get coins by growing crops, raising animals, harvesting, and selling them in the market. You can use the coins you collect to purchase seeds for other crops, and as you level up, the types of crops you can grow will increase, and the farmland you can unlock will expand. Increases the number of animals you can keep. ・Use coins and jewelry Collected coins and jewelry can be used to obtain various farm tools and tractors. Farm tools and tractors allow you to efficiently plow many farms at once. In this game, after planting crops, when the game is started after some time has passed, the crops are completed and can be harvested. ・Types of crops that can be grown 　Apples, apricots, asparagus, bananas, beans, beets, broccoli, cabbage, carrots, cherries, corn, cucumbers, eggplants, hemp, lemons, lettuce, onions, oranges, peaches, pears, pepper, plum, potato, pumpkin, Italian pumpkin, white pumpkin, Squash Butternut, Squash Delicator, Strawberry, Sunflower, Tomato, Watermelon, Wheat, etc. ・Types of animals that can be kept 'Cats, dogs, pigs, cows, chickens, horses, etc.
row.short_description: Farm Garden Simulator is a farm simulator game where you can grow a lot of crops and raise animals.

row.name: Steampunk Jigsaw Puzzles
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the enchanting world of Steampunk Jigsaw Puzzles! Immerse yourself in a captivating realm of Victorian aesthetics and intricate machinery as you embark on your puzzle-solving adventure. Assemble a wide variety of fascinating scenes, from opulent airships to ornate clockwork contraptions and much more. Enjoy a selection of 24 steampunk puzzles, expandable to over 200 with DLC. With its intuitive gameplay, Steampunk Jigsaw Puzzles is accessible to both newcomers and puzzle enthusiasts alike. Play the game your way, with a wide variety of puzzle sizes and piece shapes. Enjoy a leisurely experience, or face a mind-bending test of your puzzling prowess! Solve jigsaw puzzles to earn Steam achievements and unlock hidden bonus puzzles. The gears are in motion. Begin your steampunk puzzle adventure!
row.short_description: Dive into a world of Victorian elegance and mechanical marvels. Discover steam-powered wonders while testing the limits of your puzzle-solving skills.

row.name: Rainbow
row.detailed_description: Who are you. Where is this place. Find the secret in a rainbow-colored, monochrome world. Maybe this is all someone's dream. About the game This game is a 2d exploratory adventure game. Move through the various monochromatic worlds and solve many puzzles and quizzes. At the end of it you will know all the secrets! Characteristics of the game Solve several puzzles in a monochrome world. A game made up of pixel art only. A simple game with only basic moves and investigations (conversations). Get various items from various NPCs while playing the game. Game save is 'only once'. It's like our lives, right?
row.short_description: Who are you. Where is this place. Find the secret in a rainbow-colored, monochrome world. Maybe this is all someone's dream.

row.name: Scarlet Thread
row.detailed_description: Scarlet Thread is a deck building game , you could build up your deck with your own card and fight with other players at rank game. Players could build up your deck with Hero cards, Equipments , Spells and Followers.In the action phase, both sides will deploy cards simultaneously, deploying them in different areas. After the turn ends, the cards of both sides will automatically fight. Players who win in different areas will receive more resources or cause damage to the enemy. We also provide a PVE mode based on the same battle structure.You could start up with a random deck or build your own deck for your own journey. PVE mode would generate dungeons randomly, so you will always facing unknown dungeons. Onece you finish the PVE fight , you could get more cards which you could build into your deck.
row.short_description: Scalet Thread is a deck building game. Our core game is based on PVP ranked game .More postion strategy, More resource management ,Fight at winning blocks and get more resource at 'Jungle'.PVE Mode provided is a roguelike deck building game. you could pick up random cards during the PVE sessions .
row.notes: Contains slight nudity Some card designs have violent implications or acts of violence.

row.name: Sort It!
row.detailed_description: 'Sort It!' is a Virtual Reality psychology experiment developed by University of Oxford researchers. It is a one-time game, with 6 levels and takes 45-60 minutes to complete in total. Your task is to copy a set of objects depicted in a model display onto a workspace table by picking-up a series of objects from a resource table. You are free to look around the virtual room and pick up/place objects using the grabber tool. Be quick - You only have 60s to complete each display. The game was developed by researchers in the Adaptive Behaviour & Cognition Laboratory at the University of Oxford. We are interested in understanding in how humans solve complex tasks and how psychologists can use VR studies remotely to investigate this. Everyone is free to play this game. However, only if you've been in contact with us beforehand will your performance in the game be analysed as part of our research. If you would like to participate, please contact us with the email address provided. Key Features: Fully immersive, interactive VR gameplay. Compatibility with all steam compatible VR headset devices.
row.short_description: A Virtual Reality psychology experiment developed by University of Oxford researchers.
developers: Adaptive Behaviour and Cognition Laboratory, University of Oxford
publishers: Adaptive Behaviour and Cognition Laboratory, University of Oxford

row.name: Argo
row.detailed_description: Argo is a unique roguelite action strategy game in a minimalist style! Use combos to use abilities, dodge enemy attacks and defeat the Void, Hell and Pestilence bosses. You don't have to do it alone either, because you can play the entire game in online co-op mode! - Unlock different abilities during the game and explore new combinations again and again. - Play with a total of three different characters, each with their own stats and special abilities. - Survive together with a friend via the online co-op mode. - Find runes in the game that grant you permanent upgrades. - Discover crafting recipes to create unique equipment for the next run. - Fill the bestiary and learn the most effective ways to avoid enemies' abilities.
row.short_description: Argo is a unique roguelite action strategy game in a minimalist style. Use combos to use abilities, dodge enemy attacks and defeat the Void, Hell and Pestilence bosses. You don't have to do it alone either, because you can play the entire game in online co-op mode!

row.name: ENFYNYTY
row.detailed_description: O ENFYNYTY SANDBOX é uma plataforma PC e MOBILE que permite voce criar servidores com varios modos de jogo, incluindo um editor de mapa para voce montar um lindo cenário para jogar com os amigos. Os servidores suportam até 50 jogadores, você também pode montar uma sala privada e convidar outros players. O modo editor conta com mais de 500 objetos, voce tem liberdade para movimenta, girar ou aumentar o tamanho dos objetos, também é possivel associar texturas online.
row.short_description: O ENFYNYTY SANDBOX, é uma plataforma PC e MOBILE que permite voce criar servidores com varios modos de jogo, incluindo um editor de mapa para voce montar varios cenários. Roleplay, Sobrevivência, PVP livre, Defesa de território e outros.

row.name: DONG WU: ODYSSEY
row.detailed_description: This is one of the four continents and one of the Nine Kingdoms where a web of political conficts go on. On this land of Dragon, the war to awaken the power of Dragon bloodline is back. Once again, the Land of Azure falls into chaos. Miasma that once shrouded the continent for hundreds of years is coming back, posing another threat besides the fights orchestrated around the throne. The Nine Kingdoms join into three forces, vying for the throne of the land. Every one is just the epitome of the Beast Era, no matter your nationalities or identies. Travel across the land of Nine Kingdoms where danger and adventures await. Your journey becomes more danger as you don't know who your enemies are. It's up to you whether to accept the challenges. Some of the Dong Wu will company you along the journey. They will bring you fortune, good luck or bad luck. You only live once. So as Dong Wu. As Miasma builds up, you will fade away. Fight or flee? Transcend or corrupt? It's all on a whim. You'll fight against 40+ enemies of different mechanism and 20+ challenging bosses. Each enemy has their own mechanism. You will conquer the land once you know your enemies. You can unlock 120+ items in the game. Keep moving. Keep fighting. Each item has their own use. Each item has their own fate. Use them wisely and face the unknown! Each Dong Wu has their own history. Their secrets are unveiled throughout your trip. You'll experience the chaos of this world in the POV of four main characters, starting with Crown of Fusia. Follow Dong Wu on our social media and get ready for your adventure!
row.short_description: DONG WU: ODYSSEY is a challenging RPG about legendary beasts. You will form a 4-person party and fight a battle of succession to claim the throne. In this thousand-year war, your enemy could be the noble or Miasma. Your fate depends on your strategy, luck and courage. Good luck!

row.name: Sky Conquest
row.detailed_description: JOIN OUR DISCORD About the Game ⭐ Sky Conquest is a fun 3D platformer game designed to be played with friends. In this game, you play as colorful and cute characters who must jump, run, and avoid obstacles to be the first to reach the finish line. 🌟 Sky Bomber 🌟 Blast your enemies in this thrilling Bomberman-like mode! Strategy, speed, and precision are your best allies as you place bombs to destroy obstacles and defeat your opponents. Navigate through complex mazes, collect power-ups, and become the master of explosive skies! 🌟 Adventure Mode 🌟 Get ready for a colorful and challenging epic! Inspired by Mario classics, this adventure mode transports you into a 3D and 2D universe where every jump counts. Traverse varied levels filled with platforms, puzzles, and dangers. Master the art of jumping, discover hidden secrets, and face formidable enemies to restore peace in the celestial kingdom. 🌟 Search and Find 🌟 Rick has lost valuable items in his sky house and he needs your help to find them! This mode plunges you into a hidden objects game where every room holds concealed treasures. Explore detailed environments, use your observation skills, and solve puzzles to find Rick's lost items. the Game's Features Colorful and cute graphics that will appeal to players of all ages. Simple and intuitive controls that allow players to focus on the fun of playing. Fun cosmetics that will make the gameplay even more exciting. Varied and challenging levels that will test players' skills. 🏆 Sky Conquest Features 🏆 Dazzling Graphics: Stunning high-definition environments that bring the skies to life. Varied Gameplay: Three unique game modes for a diverse and captivating experience. Get ready to conquer the skies and discover a world of mysteries and explosions with Sky Conquest! Download it now and let the adventure begin!
row.short_description: In summary, Sky Conquest is a fun and enjoyable platform game to play with friends! 🌟 With cute graphics and entertaining gameplay, it's the perfect combo. Download it for free now on Steam and get ready to jump and have fun! 🚀🎮

row.name: Kwark
row.detailed_description: Kwark is a single-player game in which you are a character named Kwark ! Your main task is to complete all levels, but it's not as easy as it seems! A lot of levels available for passing, character customization, in-game currency and qualitatively made menu will not let you get bored. In Kwark there is a large functionality of settings, such as: full screen mode, game graphics selection, sound settings and much more! Kwark can run, jump, crouch, walk in a crouch and jump in a crouch, in general, everything you need for a comfortable game! The game has a menu with a large number of buttons such as, mechanics, good design and elaborate interface! And localization between Russian, English and Polish will allow you to play as you feel comfortable. Also frequent updates won't let you get bored! Can you pass all the levels?
row.short_description: Kwark is a single player game about a creature that has to go through levels and then something impossible happens at the end! The game can be both from 1 person and from 3!

row.name: Survivors
row.detailed_description: You are the commander of the Time Tank, a formidable vehicle that ensures the fight is never truly over, stranded on an alien planet with nothing but your wits, heavy weaponry, and the allies you rescue along the way. Battle through hordes of eldritch monsters to rescue your friends, upgrade your arsenal, and claw your way into the future. Through rescuing your allies and completing their quests, you unlock their tower, a bastion of defense or offense that aids you in all future battles. Through further quests, you unlock unique weapons, such as the railgun and deadly mist, in addition to your tank's trusty automatic turret system. If you're brave enough and give a valiant effort, you may be able to escape this alien planet and venture back home. Don't worry, if the zombies get you, your trust Time Tank has the ability to travel back in time whenever it is put in grave danger; You will simply travel back to the last know safe timeline.
row.short_description: Travel through an unknown alien world, collecting new weapons to fight alien monsters and upgrading the Time Tank to withstand hordes of unknown monsters.

row.name: Star Farmer: Prologue
row.detailed_description: Wishlist the full game! About the Game This is the free version of Star Farmer: Warlock of the Universe . As a Warlock, fund your expedition to discover rare and powerful flora through your participation in the lucrative profession of star farming. Build the ultimate space farm as you explore the galaxy and stumble onto the mystery of a dead planet. Cultivate exotic plant life, trade your harvests for credits, and customize your runs with unique powers in this roguelite adventure. Star Farmer: Prologue Features Star Farmer: Prologue is a part of the full version of the upcoming game, Star Farmer: Warlock of the Universe . It includes: 2 acts from the full version of the game (from a total of 5) Over 100 powers to take advantage of on your runs Cutscenes and story moments covering the early portion of the game 3 unlockable Warlock Powers Herbarium 6 audio logs to collect Full farming gameplay for 6 different plant types A save file that is shared with the full version of the game Collectable furniture for your ship An upgradeable character and ship to a fifth of the power of the maximum in the full version of the game Harvest the Cosmos Venture into uncharted territories and gather an array of seeds and rare materials. Cultivate Your Bounty Onboard your trusty spaceship, transform your harvested resources into flourishing crops. Create the ultimate interstellar farm. Warlock Life On your travels, find rare and powerful flora you can bring back to your den. These plants can then be utilised to give you powerful boons on your runs. Trade Among the Stars Encounter wandering traders during your galactic escapades and strike deals to sell your produce for credits. Decorate Your Ship Find furniture on your expeditions and bring them back to spice up your farm. Upgrade Your Cosmic Expedition Spend your hard-earned credits to enhance yourself and your spaceship. Unravel the Secrets Immerse yourself in a story that unravels the mysteries of a long-dead planet. The fate of this forgotten world lies in your hands. Features Auto-firing weapons Fast runs (under 15 minutes) Over 150 unique powers available to customise your runs Find furniture and cuddly companions on your runs to take back to your ship Expand your farm, recruit drones to aid you in the busy work, and use your profits to increase the power of your character Each run takes you to many different planets, survive waves lasting 20-40 seconds and harvest as much as you can in that time
row.short_description: In this bullet heaven, farming adventure, play as a powerful Warlock who has a side hustle harvesting plants in space.

row.name: Dream #46
row.detailed_description: Dream #46 is a contemplative ride game in an idyllic world that could come out of a dream. You control a small sailboat in a tiny world made up of 6 areas where each of them has its own color palette, its inhabitants. Navigate wherever you want among what is on offer. The idea is that you have a good time. Scrolls are scattered across the dream. Collect one and a positive affirmation will present itself to motivate you...about you. Like any dream, this one has an end. To do this, you must collect petals in order to reconstitute flowers and create a bouquet of flowers to finally give it as an offering... Have a nice dream.

row.name: School: The Hardest RPG in Your Life
row.detailed_description: The Story Eli hasn’t always been the brightest crayon in the box, mainly because he ate those ones back in kindergarten. It’s almost summer break and he is ready for it, he has made multiple plans with his best friend, Joey. However, there is only one thing that is in his way, HIS GRADES. The government has just passed a law where if a student has a failing overall grade they will have to go to Summer School for the entire break. Determined to change his fate of an entire summer break spent at school Eli has hatched a plan for his final day of school. He is going to challenge all of his teachers and peers to an RPG battle for his GRADE. On the last day of school, Eli gets ready to challenge every single person in his school and to challenge everything we knew about High School. The Team Austin McKinney Thomas Watson III Martin Margolin Andrew McFall Tobie Allen Jared Laing Music Credit to: Kevin MacLeod Inspired By Final Fantasy Kindergarten Highschool (Trauma)

row.name: Frontline 1942: Battles of the World War 2
row.detailed_description: Frontline 1942 World War 2 is an exciting online shooter that takes you into the thick of the battles of the Second World War. In this epic game, you will become a real hero, being on the front line as the best soldier. Accept the challenge and embark on a journey through destroyed cities, burning fields and dangerous jungles. You will fight in first-person mode, feeling the adrenaline and tension of each battle. The graphic execution of the online game will simply amaze you with its quality. Every texture in this shooter, every effect is created with love of detail so that you can fully immerse yourself in the atmosphere of the Second World War. The soundtrack recreates the sounds of shots, explosions and commands, making the game even more realistic. You will have to fight in various theaters of military operations, including city streets, trenches, snow-covered plateaus and other dangerous locations. Each place has its own characteristics and strategic advantages, which you should skillfully use in your actions. Weapons will be your faithful companion in battles. You will be able to choose from a diverse arsenal, including rifles, pistols, machine guns and grenades. Each weapon has its own characteristics and capabilities, and you have to use them according to the current situation on the battlefield. Your teammates will be your friends or other players who also strive to win. Cooperation and coordination with the team will be important elements of success. Team tactics, communication and interaction - all this will help you overcome obstacles and win. Fight in exciting game modes, including team battles, assaults and holding positions. In each mode, you will have to use your skills and strategic thinking to achieve goals and win. The game features the intersection of several game genres such as: shooter, action, strategy, world war, race and pvp. You won't be bored! Frontline 1942 World War 2 will allow you to plunge into the historical atmosphere of the Second World War, feel a real spiritual connection with the heroes of the past and experience large-scale battles full of tension and dynamics. Be brave, be heroes and prove your strength on the battlefield!
row.short_description: Immerse yourself in the times of the Second World War II and become a real hero! Shoot, capture, win – the path to glory is paved with shells!

row.name: Why God?
row.detailed_description: Ask GOD why he has made you so horrible On an ordinary morning at the foot of the Tower of Babel, our protagonist, an amalgam, was sleeping very peacefully, when suddenly, a piece of mirror falls from the sky and hits him on the head, causing him to wake up. The amalgam looks in all directions and realizes when looking at the ground the cause of its awakening. Picking up one of the mirror fragments, the amalgam realizes that there is something moving in it. It took her a little while to realize that it was herself, after all, it was the first time she had seen her reflection. The amalgam could not believe that God had given it such a horrendous appearance. At that moment she, indignant and angry with God's decision, decides to look at the top of the Tower of Babel and shout 'Why God?!'. Since she doesn't respond, she decides to climb to the top of the tower to ask him face to face the reason for her ugliness. Beauty Of The World We are in a world with unique art, handmade and with very striking colors that will make you enjoy each statue or any element, because in this world everything is full of small details. All in a 2D world and with a Cartoon and animated style in which you can get to know the particular and crazy personalities of the enemies while you enjoy the environment where they develop The world and the lines that surround the universe of 'Why God?' They stand out for the personality they have where it will be difficult for you to find something similar anywhere else If you like adventures with fast yet relaxed gameplay, if you feel like laughing a little while enjoying the simple and deep story. You'll enjoy 'Why God?' Fast Mechanics Tired of having to gain inertia when swinging? here it is not necessary, take advantage of the instant impulses to have the possibility of Run only forward while avoiding all enemies or eliminating them along the way. With a kit of skills that grow as you play, giving more play to passing levels in more creative ways.
row.short_description: Climb high up the Tower of Babel by swinging and dodging all the children of the Lord to be able to ask GOD in one once and for all because he has made you so horrible in a world 2D cartoony. Explore in the most frenetic way the sad but exciting story of our little Amalgama.

Play with a partner to navigate two intertwining times. You and your partner must choose between two paths. row.name: Animus Toil
row.detailed_description: 'Ahead of you lies the temple of my creation.' Welcome to Animus Toil , the debut video game from Mindset Makers! The Temple Of The Herring was a legend to the people of Thera, said to be cursed by an evil wizard known only as Somnus. Two explorers find their way into the illusive temple, finding themselves trapped in a dynamic, yet parallel path towards their own fates. Who exactly is Somnus? Why is the temple cursed? What is the secret behind the mysterious artifacts? And how does this tale all tie into the future of our humanity? Animus Toil is an experimental puzzle-adventure game, featuring two playable characters and randomized room sequences, giving each player different experiences. While each puzzle can be solved on their own, it is encouraged for players to exchange solutions and reach the game's end together. Each playthrough has an estimated completion time of 1-2 hours, and there are 4 possible endings to discover. 'Proceed with curiosity.' Play the PC port for FREE! This native Windows version is the original Game Boy ROM running on GB Studio's built-in emulator and exported to an executable. This version allows for easy windows/screen-resizing, as well as plug-and-play support for controllers (such as the newer Xbox controllers, which have been tested and working). The controls are as follows: Arrow Keys = move player Z = A/select/interact X = B/back Receive the transmission in your own world. Donate to gain access to all bonus content! This includes access to the Game Boy ROM itself, as well as an exported version for Analogue Pocket, allowing you to experience the game natively through hardware or emulation. Also included is the official soundtrack, enhanced and exported to both FLAC and MP3 formats, as well as assets to create your own physical copy. Physical DVD-ROM copies are also available to order via the official Mindset Makers website (found on the side of this game page). These DRM-free discs include the full game and all bonus content. Animus Toil has been tested and working on most Game Boy emulators, although please be mindful when saving is implemented. VisualBoyAdvance is recommended. For the most authentic experience, as the creator intended, play on Game Boy Color hardware using a burned cartridge (requires battery for saving) or flashcart of your choice with stereo headphones. Thank you for playing. Good luck, explorers! Credits: Story, graphics, gameplay, and music all created by Hunter Gerace . GB Studio engine created by Chris Maltby . *STEAM DECK DISCLAIMER: Unfortunately, Animus Toil has been tested on every version of Proton and currently fails to launch. Until a solution is found, we recommend using the Game Boy ROM.
row.short_description: The legend speaks of an illusive temple cursed by the evil wizard Somnus. In this experimental puzzle-adventure game, two explorers uncover the temple and dive deep into its depths, only to find connections to our own future. Will they survive the madness, or will their psyches break them first?
row.notes: In order to fully realize the creator's vision, this experience contains intense and disturbing scenes, including those with various visual effects that may be dangerous to anyone with photosensitive epilepsy.

row.name: 真修世界（Fairy Land）
row.detailed_description: 'Fairy Land' is a massively multi-user role-playing game (MMORPG). The game is based on the oriental fantasy fairy cultivating story, providing players with a virtual reality game environment. In this virtual world, the main game behaviors of players include cultivating immortals, upgrading levels, obtaining good equipment, PK, trading, chatting and making friends, and so on. At the same time the game provides different activities for players to entertain. Players' game fun mainly comes from the improvement of character abilities (including obtaining good equipment, levels, skills), community behavior (including making friends, marriage, trading, PK, guilds, etc.) and participating in various activities. Various items, props and currency are provided in the game. Players can obtain these items, props and money through different channels to form a complete and balanced virtual economic system. The whole game is a very adventurous online game full of magic and oriental color. The game provides players with a lot of different props. Different props can bring players to different levels of ability improvement, so the pursuit of high-level (or top-quality) equipment has become one of the most important goals of players in the game.

row.name: Crunky's Fun Rager
row.detailed_description: In Crunky's Fun Rager , you play as Crunky , a bouncy energetic bunny seeking revenge against the mischievous Crunko Pops . Your goal? Keep Crunky hopping, dodge obstacles, and defeat enemies. Jump on Crunko Pops to squash them or collect power-ups that grant Crunky unique abilities. Aim for high scores in order to top the Daily Leaderboard , complete Achievements for a completionist experience, and track your Stats along the way! Navigate trampolines , leverage knives , guns , and vehicles to take down enemies, collect red coins and protecting balloons . Each challenge completed earns Crunky a letter , and collecting 2 letters brings you to the next area. Crunky’s adventure starts in the sunny Crunkopolis Plains . Collecting the first 2 letters will bring you to the Crumpy Desert , where things start to heat up a bit. After collecting 2 more letters you will find yourself in the Cropular Underground before 2 more letters brings you to the forgotten Frunky Fields ... Strategize and unleash your arcane powers to decimate the opposition. Stunning 3D Arenas: Fight across intricately designed battlefields, each boasting its own challenges and opportunities. Forge alliances, challenge foes, and climb the leaderboards to prove your supremacy. Prepare your strategies, sharpen your skills, and step into the arena. In 'Reptile Chronicles', only the fiercest will survive. Are you ready for the challenge?
