row.name: メガロサミア -木星絶対防衛圏- Heaven's Fall
row.detailed_description: Megalothymia - Jupiter's Absolute Defense Sphere - Heaven's Fall' is a space war 3D shooting game set in the solar system of the near future. As the commander of the War Monger, an independent fleet of the Unity, you take on the fleet of the space exploration conglomerate Lumberyard in a battle for control of the planet. You command your own fleet and aim for victory in a complex battlefield of many-to-many battleships, attacks, and explosions. In addition to attacking from your own ships, you must also be strategic in directing your fleet in order to gain the upper hand in the war. The game combines FPS and tactical elements to create a new kind of space warfare experience. Players can enjoy a variety of stages such as Asteroids, Jupiter, Earth, Sun, and Mars, as well as different missions such as retreat lines, defensive battles, and sieges. Your mission is to thwart Lumberyard's plot, which will be revealed as the battle progresses, and lead Unity to victory. Will you be able to fight through this war and chart the future?
row.short_description: This is a space fleet shooting game that can be easily enjoyed with FPS-like controls.

row.name: Interstellar Shore VR: I LIVE
row.detailed_description: Interstellar Shore: Synopsis and Art Illustration The Interstellar Shore Program | ILIVE: The Illuminating Life-Intelligence Venture Engine The project was initiated as an Art-Tech-Philosophical Transdisciplinary Experiment collaborated by students from MIT. Subsequently, young creators from universities and colleges around the world joined in this collaborative transdisciplinary experiment. This timely avant-garde transdisciplinary work pioneers the concept of 'life intelligence' with a metaphysical space odyssey. Surging atop the AI explosion of 2022, it elevates discourse and provokes thoughts on human-machine relations, even arrays alternative futures. Via the Bridge of Myth and the legend of Interstellar Shore, Tabman and Shawn(you) set off to find new cosmic frontiers. You explore, climb, play, age, sicken, create, forget, pursue, and examine identity and existential question. Echoing Heidegger, our essence lies in living 'the question'. Like art, this visionary work 'brings the truth of Being to shine forth' — a digital-age satori unveiling reality as infinite self-discovery. Challenging Cartesian duality, it collapses inner/outer onto a Möbius strip threading through all infinitudes. Proposing technology as portal to awakening, this work generates insight into consciousness creating worlds anew with inter-enabling technology and humanity. Destined to shape the zeitgeist of generations to come. The work invites people to examine ego, id, superego - and beyond. The solid story, ample details and tripartite metaphorical allusions make the experience profoundly provoking. Hey, think about Tabman the name - anything new you are feeling now?
row.short_description: This timely avant-garde transdisciplinary work pioneers the concept of 'life intelligence' with a metaphysical space odyssey. Surging atop the AI explosion of 2022, it elevates discourse and provokes thoughts on human-machine relations, even arrays alternative futures.

row.name: Ultimate Match 3D
row.detailed_description: Ultimate Match 3D is one of the most exciting puzzle games in which you combine a variety of fun and cute elements. The puzzles are easy to understand and are fun for everyone, regardless of age. If you like cool games with colorful puzzles, Ultimate Match 3D is for you! - Free to Play - More than 1000 Level - Changing game modes - Various boosters that help you progress - Fortuna Wheel an Lucky Chest
row.short_description: Exciting puzzle game for all ages.

row.name: 孤高之人
row.detailed_description: · 这是一款的3D横版平台跳跃、跑酷类型的游戏，将您带入一个充满活力和创意的游戏世界。游戏包含多做风格的地形，从树林到村庄、山巅，甚至是宇宙空间，每一步都是不一样的挑战。游戏的幽默风格将为您的冒险增添趣味，而眼花缭乱的各种陷阱和机关将不断考验您的反应。 · 你是探险界著名的专业冒险者之一，曾征服无数险境。但在一次危险度极高的登山探险中，你不慎伤到大脑，造成了不知名脑疾，导致手脚经常不受控制的随意挥舞。 · 即使身体残疾，您也未曾退缩，仍然不断的去挑战各种险地。这段时间里，你的知名度快速攀升，因为一些不可明说的原因，在探险界内，您的粉丝戏称您为“傲慢的演奏家”。 · 随着年纪增长，同时身为一名探险家，你决定在退休前在冒一次险，前往探险界最为著名的险地，神秘的“孤高”，并尝试着征服这个无人区。 游戏难度将随着进度逐渐变高。 · 纯正的3D横版平台跑酷 冲冲冲！主打跑酷跳跃，但也融入了战斗元素。 挥舞 你的拳头，让您体验不一样的战斗方式。跳跃的同时，击溃前方的障碍吧。 · 幽默且有趣的游戏风格 你的手经常会不受控制，随意挥舞。就像在演奏乐曲。每一步都伴随着欢乐滑稽的角色动作，突出您“傲慢演奏家”的身份。 · 多种冒险地形 这里有树林、村庄、山洞、山峰，甚至是宇宙空间。您将从营地出发，越过禁地，突破重重障碍，登上山峰。这一过程中将会面临各式各样的陷阱与机关，每一个都需要您的反应和技巧躲避。 · 是真男人就一命通关 真正的冒险者，往往都会注意自己的人身安全。能安然无恙的征服一切，才是真正的英雄。 · 后续会推出其他地图 · 正试图寻找修复bug · 本作是独立开发，后续更新或许会稍慢，请玩家见谅 · 当局者迷，您的反馈对我来说至关重要，您的游玩乐趣是我不断提升进步的动力。 交流联系 B站（ID:哲学丿家）
row.short_description: 这是一款3D横版平台跳跃、跑酷类休闲、冒险游戏。您将扮演一位专业的冒险家，前往征服探险界内最为著名的险地“孤高”。尝试克服道路上各种各样的陷阱，不畏挫折，征服你脚下所走过的所有土地，直到攀上顶峰。

row.name: homebound
row.detailed_description: Tasked with finding humanity a new home, a lonely astronaut braves a desolate planet, making a fluffy friend along the way. homebound is a short 2D puzzle platformer that explores the feeling of home. Play as the astronaut and the cat as they make their way through an abandoned planet. Prepare yourself to explore a mysteriously barren planet and find out why its inhabitants are all missing except for a lonesome cat, while delving into what feeling of home is. Features Cute Pixel Graphics: Featuring original hand-drawn pixel graphics, homebound creates a cozy and nostalgic atmosphere with its sweet and simple aesthetic. Retro Puzzle Platformer: Solve puzzles by manipulating the environment and utilizing the unique qualities of both the astronaut and the cat. Featuring 5 distinct levels, homebound keeps you on your toes by introducing new mechanics and puzzles of increasing complexity. Atmospheric Narrative: Explore the mystery of the abandoned planet, its inhabitants, and why they left. As you navigate deserted buildings and arid wasteland, discover the essence of home and what it means to leave home and to find a new one. What will you uncover about the missing civilization and the legacy they left behind? Original Soundtrack: Become immersed in the original soundtrack by William Watson as you explore and solve puzzles with your feline friend. homebound is intended to be a short 30-90 minute immersive experience.
row.short_description: Tasked with finding humanity a new home, a lonely astronaut braves a desolate planet while making a fluffy friend along the way. homebound is a short 2D puzzle platformer that explores the feeling of home.

row.name: The Hardest Game Ever
row.detailed_description: Pot ventured deep underground to find the most exotic flower he could, but now he's lost and needs to find the way out. Help Pot find his way through this precision platformer by conquering jumps and puzzles. Hours of difficult precision platforming & puzzles 3 different biomes Beautiful art with immersive sounds and soundtrack Mushrooms The game features unique abilities that are used in unique ways and can be mastered over time: jumping, coyote time, and wall climbing. Find phoenix feathers to guard your progress and set your respawn point. Find keys to unlock doors, take shortcuts, and explore new paths.
row.short_description: An insanely difficult precision platformer

row.name: Dark Moon Deities
row.detailed_description: Dark Moon Deities is a PvP auto battler with an emphasis on strategy as well as dynamic spells and effects. Units are able to specialize upon ranking up, allowing you to tech into countering your opponents or create insanely powerful combinations. Many abilities in the game apply Force, which may send enemies flying off the board and into the abyss... Ascending the Auto Battler Knock Out! Go beyond the chess board with powerful spells and abilities that may send enemies flying off the grid. Items: Units are able to attune to different items that allow them to bridge the gap between Devotions, creating powerful combinations that you may not think to be possible. Make your Warriors into Assassins, your Beasts into Undeads, your Archers into Elementals... the possibilities are endless! Specialization: Heighten the power of your unit's Devotions when ranking up. They are granted one specialization point to allocate as you see fit. Use this in order to shore up weaknesses in your draft, or go all out and acquire an effect that combines with your other effects in some unspeakable way. Graphics: This game takes full advantage of Unreal Engine 5's lighting and VFX to provide an immersive, next-gen experience. Online Ranking System: Coming soon! Chaos Garden: Coming soon!
row.short_description: Dark Moon Deities is a deeply strategic auto battler that can be played online vs. other players or offline against bots. Go beyond the grid with forceful spells. Subjugate the Old Gods in order to make their power your own. Bring forth nascent dark moon deities by stealing fragments of their power.

row.short_description: 《王侯将相》是一款三国题材的Q版卡牌收集养成游戏。游戏主角在神秘的三国世界闯荡，会遭遇一系列的神秘关卡和各种强大的敌人。本作包含激情炫酷的战斗，个性鲜明的三国名将，史诗感炸裂的三国城池攻防战，横扫千军的武将战技以及造型各异的绝世神兵和各种奇珍异兽等。随着在不断探索深入，主角终会终会拼杀出属于自己的道路，最终带领自己组建的部队登临顶峰。

row.name: Tiny Candy Guardian 御菓子島の魔法使い
row.detailed_description: ☆An easy-to-play VR game. ★Players do not need to move, use the left and right hand respective magic weapons to meet the enemies coming from everywhere. ☆Use randomly dropped items during the battle to constantly strengthen and replace your weapons. ★Shake your body to avoid enemy bullets. ☆Have the final battle with the huge boss.
row.short_description: A cute and exciting VR shooting game. Become a wizard guarding Candy Island, use candy magic to feed various mouthy fantasy creatures and repel them all.

row.name: MLB Rivals
row.detailed_description: Enjoy an Officially Licensed MLB Baseball Game Anytime, Anywhere Experience the fully integrated 2025 MLB schedule, and take on the World Series with 2025 Live Cards! The game now features baseball legends from the National Baseball Hall of Fame—available as brand-new cards! The game chosen by 2-time National League MVP Bryce Harper, MLB Rivals! ■ MLB Rivals Game Features [NEW] # New Development Transfer System: Transfer development to new cards of the same position! # New League Difficulty: Push your limits and take on a tougher challenge! # Locker Room: Unlock Clubhouse Leader and boost your leader’s stats! # The television voices for the Los Angeles Dodgers Joe Davis (play-by-play) and Orel Hershiser (commentary) [REAL] # 2025 MLB season schedule, stadiums, and uniforms fully featured! # 2025 Live Cards that reflect real-time performance! # Realistic player motions captured with cutting-edge technology! # Relive the most thrilling moments with the Replay system! [PLAY] # [Quick Play, Spotlight Batting, or Full Play]: Choose how you want to enjoy the game! # Ranked Slugger: Become the true Home Run King! # Live Match: Face off against rivals from around the world in real time! # Club Battle: Join forces with your Club members to challenge the top clubs! [EASY] # No more complicated controls! Enjoy simple one-touch play. # Speed through games with Quick Play and play speed settings! # Grow your players with ease! Improved Consecutive Upgrade feature! Feel the thrill of baseball action with MLB Rivals!
row.short_description: Take your rivalries to the next level in MLB RIVALS!

row.name: Naturpark Lillebælt VR
row.detailed_description: Dive into an extraordinary adventure with Naturpark Lillebælt's immersive VR game, where the ocean's wonders come to life! Explore the beauty of Denmark's Lillebælt as you embark on a thrilling journey through diverse marine biotopes, blending fun, education, and sustainability into one unforgettable experience. Embark on a series of captivating missions in Lillebælt's restoration and conservation efforts. Plant new eelgrass and witness the return of marine life to the area. Become a marine photographer, capturing elusive species living within the Stone Reef. Clean up trash from the seabed. Use a robotic arm to capture fish species. Don a diving suit to harvest clamps in the Ocean Gardens. This VR game serves an educational purpose, created in collaboration with Naturpark Lillebælt to spread knowledge about the region's biodiversity and sustainability. By providing an interactive encounter with Lillebælt's marine life, players gain a profound understanding of the importance of conservation and their role in preserving this precious ecosystem. Don your virtual snorkel and dive into an unparalleled adventure that seamlessly blends education and entertainment. Experience the thrill of VR as you become an ocean steward, contributing to the restoration of Lillebælt's rich biodiversity. Naturpark Lillebælt's VR game is your ticket to an awe-inspiring journey, connecting you with the magic and marvels of the ocean like never before.
row.short_description: Dive into VR missions at Naturpark Lillebælt. Plant eelgrass, catch fish, clean trash, and learn about biodiversity. Restore the ocean's balance in this educational adventure!

row.name: FLIGHTMARE
row.detailed_description: Embark on a thrilling journey in our exciting horror game set on a doomed, aerial nightmare; you're trapped on a hijacked plane where an eerie terror lurks in the shadows. With all the other passengers mysteriously dead, your only hope is to unravel the creepy mysteries of the aircraft and avoid the threat . Will you be able to escape the impending disaster or become another victim in this harrowing race against time?
row.short_description: Indie horror game that will take your adrenaline to another level.
row.notes: This Game may contain content not suitable for all ages: Blood, Violence, General Mature Content

row.name: Interballistic Symphony
row.detailed_description: Interballistic Symphony is a musical, fast-paced indie game all about speed and swift thinking. Easy to learn, hard to master, interballistic features several levels set in galactic and cold, unforgiving environments. Navigate through various obstacles and see how far you can make it. Featuring a normal mode and a marathon mode for more casual gameplay and endless mode with highscore lists for competitive players. Several EDM soundtracks. Normal mode. Go from point A to point B. Marathon mode. Multiple levels put together and speed being a more important factor than normal mode. Endless mode. See how far you can make it, while the speed increase over time. Powerups such as slowmotion, low gravity and score boosts to help you through tricky obstacles and reach new heights. Set and save public highscores in endless mode. Discover collectibles, unlock a bunch of achievements and push your skills to the limit.
row.short_description: A musical, fast-paced indie game all about speed and swift thinking. Navigate through tricky environments, use powerups to your advantage, push your skills to the limit and become the next interballistic master.

row.name: Tiki Tandems
row.detailed_description: Tiki Tandems is an online and local, fast-paced multiplayer game! The genre of the game is a Fighting game, although it doesn't really fall into 1 category. The best way to classify Tiki Tandems is a fun party game to play with your friends! But you can also queue up against anyone in the world and fight for the number 1 rank. The fighting style is somewhere in between Brawl Stars and Super Smash Bros but with 1 key difference. The players do not have health or knock-back bar and you can fight each other as much as you want So what is the main goal and how do you win then? Both Tikis fight over the grace of the Totem. In the middle of the 2 players, there is a big Totem which decides who wins the match. The Totem can be turned by both players all the time by hitting one of its 2 wings. Depending on the angle and distance between the players and the Totem, the totem rotates in the appropriate direction with the appropriate amount. The first Tiki to successfully turn the Totem by 180 degrees wins the match! There is also a second functionality to the Totem. If you were to turn the Fists of the totem you increase your Dedication to the Totem. The more dedication you have, the more powerful your attacks become Tiki Tandems is a fast-paced game. The game is meant to be very straightforward and easy to play for anyone. There isn't a huge skill cap but you definitely need practice to be the best at the game. We wanted to make the game accessible to as much of a wider audience as we can, so whether you are playing at home with your friends or grinding against players worldwide you can always compete with everyone. The matches last 3 minutes, so that you can play many rounds without being stuck playing against 1 person. Or if you are playing a local tournament on one machine, everybody can play without having to wait a long time, similar to Tekken-style rounds
row.short_description: Tiki Tandems is an online and local multiplayer PvP game. With fast-paced gameplay and easy-to-learn mechanics and combat it's a great game to play with your friends or grind against anyone worldwide!

row.name: JAPP: Just Another Precise Platformer
row.detailed_description: JAPP: Just Another Precise Platformer is a mouse based 2D precision platformer that is quite challenging. But when you have the physics of the game in your fingers, it's a pure bliss. Climb to the top the fastest possible way is your mission on this game! You can (for now) play 2 characters, the Square & the Circle . Both have their advantages and disadvantages, but you can climb to the top as fast with both. I hope you will enjoy this as much as I enjoyed making this game. Have fun :)
row.short_description: A mouse only 2D precise plateformer who will challenge you.

row.name: The Attic
row.detailed_description: --- Enter the First Person Survival Horror Mystery Explorer --- 'There are some places you should never go... even for those you love...' Have your sanity tested while you search for your son and find a way home. - Explore an interactive environment filled with shadows and mystery - Interact with doors, furniture, electronics and more - Manage your character's stamina, flashlight battery and thirst - Avoid the menace that hunts you at all costs - Experience rich audio landscapes with original music, artwork and sound effects - Crafted classic survival horror style ambience Designed by a small development team with a passion for 'Slow Burn' horror. - All music and audio designed and produced in Austin, Texas - Free demo available - Soundtrack available - Made in Unreal 5 All rights reserved Copyright 2023
row.short_description: Explore a strange and mysterious complex to find your missing son. Can you sneak through the depths of loss and survive the horrors that stalk you in The Attic? A first person cinematic experience with a haunting soundtrack.
row.notes: Blood and gore. Horror elements with themes of death and loss. Mentions of missing persons and illegal activities.

row.name: Dave's Fun Algebra Class: Remastered
row.detailed_description: Dave's Fun Algebra Class: Remastered is a strategy-based indie game inspired by Baldi's Basics, featuring chaotic and intense gameplay mixed with an old-school psychedelic artstyle. Meet Dave, a math teacher in a motorized wheelchair. You need to grab your friend's art contest drawings, but Dave wants to do some math with you! Solve some math with Dave and get all of your friend's missing papers. Make sure you don't make mistakes, Dave doesn't like mistakes. If you do happen to make a mistake, don't worry! There are many different kinds of items lying around the school that you can use to your advantage. Dave knows what you're doing though and just to make it even, he's brought his friends to help him out. Can you get all 8 missing papers (and solve some math here and there) and escape? Hey there! Welcome to my school! Return to Dave's school in this brand new version of Dave's Fun Algebra Class! Solve math problems, navigate the halls, and uncover the secrets of Dave's school. It contains everything from the original mod, but with a brand new coat of paint! Many new features have been added to the game, and many features from the original have been brought back and improved upon. Some of these features include gameplay improvements, visual improvements, and more! New ways to twist up the game! Dave's Fun Algebra Class: Remastered brings new ways to change up the game! If you think you have the hang of the normal game, try out 'Hard Mode' where the math is harder and the characters are faster! If you're feeling wacky, try out Modified mode, which contains a selection of modifiers that change up the game in different ways when activated. There are also some secret gamemodes you can discover by doing certain things in the game!
row.short_description: Dave's Fun Algebra Class: Remastered is a strategy-based indie game inspired by Baldi's Basics, featuring chaotic and intense gameplay mixed with an old-school psychedelic artstyle. Solve math problems, meet Dave's friends, and uncover the secrets of Dave's school.

row.name: Solomon's Link
row.detailed_description: This game is a result of 6-month long challenge during which three people tried to create a short but complete game. Unfortunately, due to personal life issues, we couldn't finish the story in time. We're releasing the game as a short demo for archiving purposes but please keep in mind that the game will not be expanded on any further . FREEDOM IN CHAINS Solomon's Link is a short (~15 minutes), story-driven, point-and-click demo , in which you serve unseen as both witness and guide to a pair of fugitives living out their first night of freedom after years behind bars. With two vastly different minds and two specialized sets of hands to work with, lead the escaped convicts through an industrial maze of fuse boxes and factory lines by leveraging each prisoner’s strengths to offset their partner’s mental and physical limits - not to mention, the limited reach of the chain that binds them together. PRISONERS’ DILEMMA In the process of their escape, jailbirds L.T. and R.T. broke free from their chain gang, but not from each other, leaving each of them bound to a criminal they hardly know, guilty of crimes they’d never learned. With no choice but to work together, yet no clue of each others’ intentions, each is left to weigh their mutual dependence for survival against the looming threat of betrayal, and balance the trust needed to move forward against the deceit necessary to stay safe. For better, or for worse - every word that is spoken, and every thought that goes unsaid, holds a chance to tip the scales. FLY ON THE WALL Justice is blind; you are more fortunate. Watch the world from above through the countless eyes of the factory’s security system, and hear the whispers of the concrete jungle with environmental sounds packed full of custom-made foley. Independently control R.T. and L.T. in both movement and conversations through simple, intuitive UI, stay immersed with menus designed to help you settle into the role of an investigative observer, and indulge in a fully-fledged original soundtrack to score it all. SOURCE CODE The source code for the game, together with all the assets, is available at .
row.short_description: In Solomon's Link, catch a glimpse of two lives on the lam: A pair of fugitives, raiding an abandoned factory to survive. Piece together their pasts, and watch over their fragile partnership as it grows - or crumbles - around the shackles that serve as their only unquestionable bond.
row.notes: The game contains instances of criminal behavior, coercion, and verbal abuse.

row.name: 20 Small Mazes
row.detailed_description: This is a puzzle game with twenty small mazes. If you solve the mazes, you beat the game. It's about 1-2 hours long, maybe. You need a keyboard and mouse to play it on PC. There is some basic controller support, but at one point in the game you have to type something. If you're playing it on the Steam Deck, the game is Steam Deck verified and the keyboard will automatically pop up. A few puzzles require knowledge of English. No puzzle requires sound or audio to solve it. No puzzle requires being able to recognize different colors. I hope you enjoy it.
row.short_description: This is a puzzle game with twenty small mazes. They're good mazes, though.

row.name: Idle Space Navy
row.detailed_description: Your home world’s been raided one too many times. Perhaps there’s some resources the raiders want, or they just needed something to fight. Either way, you’ve had enough. You purchase an old, small command ship and take to the stars, buying whatever equipment you can get on the way. Your goal? To conquer and pacify the stars. Idle Space Navy is an idle/incremental game currently in active development by Phoenix Aura, developed as a spiritual successor to Idle Space Raider and Transport Defender by Yaroslav ‘IDNoise’ Nikityshev with their permission. Assume command of your ship, patrol space, defeat enemies, collect resources, and increase your power by upgrading and purchasing ships, weapons, and more. As of version 0.10.7, Idle Space Navy currently includes the following: Purchase and position your ships on the map grid, then outfit your ships with your choice of weapons. 7 ship types currently implemented. 10 weapons in 3 types currently implemented. Use credits to upgrade the power of your ships, boosting their damage output. Refine scrap fragments into metal ingots in the Foundry, and upgrade even further or buy new items in the Shipyard. Reset to earn Calibration Chips, then use them to unlock and upgrade item types and boost your fleet through the Laboratory. Fit your ships with Modules to boost their performance over a short period. Automate boosting your active ships’ levels as well as that of your Shipyard upgrades. When you advance far enough, collect Artifact Fragments to trade with alien powers and boost your fleet even more! Earn daily rewards just for playing the game! Earn progress to keep your fleet advancing even when you're offline!
row.short_description: A sci-fi idler. Upgrade your ships, get new items, and conquer the stars.

row.name: Ys X: Nordics
row.detailed_description: Experience the latest action RPG featuring Adol Christin, a legendary adventurer who left behind over a hundred adventure journals for posterity, now on Steam! Who are the immortal beings known as Griegers appearing around Obelia Bay? Take control of Adol and Karja to engage in fast-paced battles, utilizing steps and dashes to defeat your foes! 【Featured Characters】 ■Adol Christin He's the main character of the story, a vibrant adventurer with fiery red hair and eyes full of curiosity. Adol left his first adventure land, Esteria, at age 17 and was believed to have set off for Celceta. However, according to one of the adventure logs found in his family home, it's revealed that he had visited Obelia Bay with the former thief Dogi before heading to Celceta. ■Karja Balta The sole daughter of Grimmson, the leader of the Baltan Navy. Karja leads the rough seafarers in piracy with confidence, earning her the moniker 'Pirate Princess' among the people of Karnack who have seen her in action. While she possesses elegant features, she is armed with a hatchet and a round shield, displaying a ruthless, Norman fighting style. 【Major Battle System Overhaul!】 The all-new “Cross Action” system allows players to fight in two modes depending on the situation: a speedy solo mode in which the player controls gameplay supported by a partner who attacks automatically; and a dual mode in which two players simultaneously control a series of actions to engage in a turn-based battle against a powerful enemy! ■Enhance Your Skills with Increased Proficiency and Unlock Advanced Skills! Improve your skills by using them frequently, thereby increasing their proficiency and power. Certain skills, when leveled up in proficiency and meeting specific conditions, can unlock even more potent advanced skills. ■Combo Skills Get a Power Surge with Proficiency & Revenge Gauge! By successfully guarding against enemy attacks, your Revenge Gauge fills up. Activating skills in this state boosts their power based on the gauge's multiplier. As skill proficiency enhances the base power of skills, unleashing a combo skill at maximum proficiency and a full Revenge Gauge can deal immensely more damage than regular solo mode skills. ■Teamwork is Crucial! Explore dungeons and interact with Raven Marker Stones to temporarily release the mana bonds linking Adol and Karja. During this time, control Adol and Karja separately. You’ll need to strategically switch between them, coordinating their moves from different positions to overcome challenges effectively. 【All-New “Mana Actions” System】 The game also features the “Mana Actions” system, a special ability that greatly expands the freedom of the player in fields and dungeons. 'Mana String': Use a string of Mana like a pendulum to reach faraway places 'Mana Ride': Allows you to glide on a grimble board 'Mana Burst': A Mana attribute attack released by a charge attack ■Spin the Threads of Fate! Nornir's Spindle: 'Mana String' Harness the power of Mana Strings to swing like a pendulum and reach far-off places with this dynamic mana action! Upgrade your Mana Actions to strengthen the strings, enabling you to manipulate objects and activate switches in dungeons. ■Ride with Style! The Grimble Board: 'Mana Ride' Soar and slide over the ground on the Grimble Board in this thrilling Mana Action! Glide over water, race down Mana Roads at high speed, or launch through the air from wind pockets for a fast-paced experience. ■Unleash the Power of Mana! 'Mana Burst' Release elemental Mana attacks with charged strikes! Adol uses fire and Karja ice to not only damage enemies but also to aid in exploration--burn away obstacles or create icy platforms. ■Enhance Your Perception! 'Mana Sense' Reveal hidden elements of the world with the ancient Druid Monocle. This Mana Action lets you detect enemies, uncover hidden gimmicks, and find buried treasures. As the Druid Monocle gets stronger, your Mana Sense sharpens, allowing you to slow down time and overcome challenges like impassable doors and treacherous walkways. 【Sail a Ship!】 For the first time in the series, Ys X allows players to become a ship’s captain! This adds an exciting new element of challenge to the adventure, such as exploring vast regions of the ocean using nautical charts as guides, and sometimes challenging enemy ships to naval battles! 【Land the Big One on the Open Seas!】 Engage in fishing at designated spots on water surfaces within fields and dungeons, where you can spot the shadows of fish. First, select your bait and fishing spot to begin. Once you get a bite, you'll need to quickly press buttons or manipulate the joystick according to the situation. This will increase the fishing gauge at the top of your screen. When it's completely filled, you've successfully reeled in your catch! 【New Features Exclusive to the Steam Version!】 Supports 21:9 ultra-wide monitors and frame rates exceeding 60fps! Enjoy a wider field of view and smoother gameplay. Preset settings tailored to your gaming environment are also available, ensuring a comfortable experience even on the Steam Deck. 【Engine Powered by DirectX 12】 With improved performance and support for Intel® XeSS, NVIDIA DLSS, and AMD FSR, you can experience the beautiful world of Ys X at higher resolutions and frame rates than ever before. 【About the Game】 The story takes place in the northern sea Obelia Bay, a bay filled with countless islands of all sizes. Adol Christin, a young adventurer who has explored the ancient kingdom of Ys, encounters two factions: the “Normans,” seafaring people known for their powerful warriors, and the “Greegers,” a mysterious group of immortals that threatens the people of Obelia Bay. Ys X: Nordics depicts a brand-new adventure in the northern sea Obelia Bay, featuring the young adventurer, Adol Christin, as its protagonist!
row.short_description: The story takes place in the northern sea Obelia Bay, a bay filled with countless islands of all sizes. Ys X: Nordics depicts a brand-new adventure in the northern sea Obelia Bay, featuring the young adventurer, Adol Christin, as its protagonist!

row.name: S.A.B.A.H. (Sun As Biased As Harmony)
row.detailed_description: Story The Tree of Harmony provided balance. This balance it created expressed a harmony between the Ideal universe and the Reflected universe. However, the Sun disrupted this balance, that's when harmony was lost, and the ideals and its reflections got mixed up... Only the chosen one, who woke up after all this chaos, can restore harmony and eliminate the Bias. The union of the Sun and the Tree of Harmony can be brought back into balance with the chosen one... Description S.A.B.A.H. (Sun As Biased As Harmony) is a Hack and Slash, endless action RPG game. In this game, you are creating a character and killing enemies. Map's pace changes by doing required things and you go upper 'floors'. On each 'floor', enemies become stronger and harder. The strongest one goes to the top! Caution: The game is not exactly endless, it has an ending, but it's almost impossible to reach! Will you manage to make it? Features - Fast Paced Combat - Male and Female Character Options - Warrior and Magician Classes - Level System - Title System - Various Character Stats - Endless Game (Almost Impossible Ending) - Turkish and English Language Support - Controller Support How To Play Keyboard and Mouse WASD for moving. Spacebar to attack. Shift + WASD to sprint. Left click to terrain for moving. Left click to enemy for moving and attacking to enemy. Right click to screen for camera control. Middle click to screen for jumping. Left click to dropped items for collecting them. Drag and drop the item to appropriate equipment slot to equip. Drag and drop the item to screen from inventory to remove it from inventory. Left click to buttons to function. After leveling up, left click to the plus (+) buttons to upgrade associated stats on the stats panel. Gamepad Left joystick to move. Right joystick to camera control. dPadUp to jump. Right bumper to attack. Left trigger + left joystick to sprint.
row.short_description: The bias between the sun and harmony will be shattered by the chosen one...

row.name: 只有向下 Only Down
row.detailed_description: 《Only Down》 is a platform jumping parkour game. It is produced by the independent studio OldCat Digital Studio, with a single person named OldCat.《Only Down》, as the name suggests, means players move from the sky to the ground or below, ultimately obtaining the treasure. In 《Only Down》, players need to jump through layers of obstacles and traps, and also open two gates to continue moving forward. The game has a certain level of difficulty, and I hope players enjoy it. There is drop damage in the game, and it is impossible to take shortcuts.
row.short_description: 《Only Down》 is a platform jumping parkour game. It is produced by the independent studio OldCat Digital Studio, with a single person named OldCat.《Only Down》, as the name suggests, means players move from the sky to the ground or below, ultimately obtaining the treasure.
developers: 老猫数字工作室 OldCat Digital Studio
publishers: 老猫数字工作室 OldCat Digital Studio

row.name: Tiny Balls
row.detailed_description: Tiny Balls is an entertaining party game that can be played with up to 12 players. You might yell. You might even curse. And it's not sure if 'friends' will still be friends afterwards. But in any case, Tiny Balls will offer extremely fun game sessions. Please note: Tiny Balls cannot be played alone! To start one of the game modes, a minimum number of two players is required in the lobby! It is recommended that you buy the game together with at least 2-3 friends. KNOCKOUT MODE: Basically a 'Last Marble Standing' mode where you have to knock your friends off platforms. Do you risk using the boost to push a friend off the edge, even though you could catapult yourself out in the worst case scenario? FREEZE MODE: A 'game of tag' mode where a certain number of players randomly become 'hunters' at the start of the match. The hunters must hit all the non-hunters, causing the non-hunters to be frozen and unable to move. However, frozen ones can be unfrozen by being touched by a friend. If all non-hunters are frozen at the same time, the hunters win. RACE MODE: A heated and fast-paced racing fun where you not only want to be the first to cross the finish line, but also hit your friends as many times as possible along the way to gain a speed boost! GAME HIGHLIGHTS: competitive multiplayer fun for up to 12 players (online & LAN) 3 game modes for each mode there are 4 maps physically correct marbles that you control yourself marble is customizable fast, short sessions easy to understand, hard to master
row.short_description: Tiny Balls is a multiplayer party game in which up to 12 friends can play against each other. In the three modes, players control a marble and must either push their friends off the track in a heated race, play a game of tag, or be the last to survive on a platform by pushing their friends off.

row.name: Free Will
row.detailed_description: THE GAME IS CORRUPTED. DO YOU WISH TO PROCEED? Free Will is a 2D psychological puzzle RPG suffering from corruption. Playing this game means you accept the responsibility of cleansing Corruption from its system. You control Will, a sick little boy who has been bedridden for most of his life, but must now fight against reality-breaking monsters as he struggles to understand the depth of his own autonomy. Dig deeper into the game's very code, creating new functions and passages, and unearthing ̸i̶n̵f̷o̴r̶m̸a̷t̵i̴o̵n̸ ̸t̶h̶a̸t̷ ̶̃̕t̵͓̔h̴̟́e̴͐̌ ̵̈̾i̷̔̚n̷habitants ̵͂̽ô̶͝f̶́ this ̄̈́h̵̐͆ô̴̋u̸̎̅s̸e might b͑͛ȅ̴͊ ̶̂̾b̸̀̑ĕ̷͕t̷̽́t̷̆er off̒ not ̷͋̔k̴̈́̍nowing.̴̆̃ Solve meta-puzzles by playing outside of the game and tweaking system files Replay to get different endings Help Will, please? Content Warning This game contains themes of depression, depicts cartoon blood and violence, and may not be suitable for all audiences. Certain sequences of the game have bright flashing imagery that may cause discomfort and/or seizures for those with photosensitive epilepsy. Viewer discretion is advised. Streaming Disclaimer Certain points in the game may expose private information by accessing your Steam name and file paths. You can enable Streamer Mode after starting the game to protect your information. Notice for Steam Deck This game was not designed for and will not run on Steam Deck.
row.short_description: Free Will is a 2D psychological puzzle RPG where the puzzles happen outside of the game. Dig deep into the system code to fix the corruption, and uncover information that might be better off hidden.
row.reviews: “It may not leave you smiling and effervescent, but Free Will will be an experience you never forget!” 9/10 – Gaming Cypher “如果你对《Free Will》的游戏类型感兴趣，同时喜欢深度思考，那么一定不容错过。” IndieNova

row.name: THE SOUL OF TOO BIRDS GAME
row.detailed_description: THE SOUL OF TOO BIRDS GAME. An interactive experience designed to accompany Melbourne experimental hip hop group Too Birds' 2023 album, The Soul of Too Birds. This interactive multimedia companion piece mutates Too Birds' chaotic, noisy soundscapes and opaque lyrics into otherworldly labrinyths where you are given but one objective: destroy the paintings and ultimately, free the soul. Drawing inspiration from an esoteric mix of influences, Too Birds' brutal and cryptic sound blends elements of harsh noise, hip-hop, and industrial metal to create a relentless auditory deluge. Too Birds personnel Teether, Realname, and Mr. Society concoct a musical experience that pushes the envelope in all directions. Now, you might be wondering, 'what features and content can I expect from this game?'. Well, there are many features and contents within this game. Here is a list of the game's features and contents: - Exist in a world. - Move around, said world. - Look at things. - Destroy paintings with your powerful hands. - Listen to the album The Soul of Too Birds .
row.short_description: Destroy all art. Free the soul.

row.name: Franzen
row.detailed_description: Game Features: Snappy turn-based combat with a unique leveling system, grind free! Fast-paced, short and sweet story. Vibrant world full of diverse enemies and items. The perfect Micro-RPG! Story Synopsis: 'Branzen. The Holy Lands. A world of Light and Dark. Flesh and Metal. The massive city, Akon, created by his holiness, Akanakon. A united, true empire. Or so it would seem...' 'Eighteen years ago, a terrible event happened. 'The Scream', a massive tear from which ceaseless darkness spewed. This darkness corrupts the mind and body, twisting those affected into monsters. 'Daemons', they call them.' Eighteen years since the 'Decade of Darkness', The Scream still stains the skies of Branzen. Franz and Lefsa Dellia, amateur Technomancers, are studying this strange phenomena, in an attempt to prove that it's expanding. Rapidly. 'Now, only one thing is true. The sun is setting on this world.' Uncover the mysteries and dark secrets of Branzen. Tour a vast world of varying cultures. Rise to power as you navigate a web of bureaucracy and corruption. Meet charming party members who will join you on your quest. Read the history of Branzen and its many kings. Explore the true meaning of Empathy.
row.short_description: Franzen is a turn-based RPG set in a dystopian-steampunk world. Explore themes of empathy and politics as Franz and Lefsa Dellia work to uncover the truth of 'The Scream'. Meet a cast of colorful characters and fight bizarre creatures in your journey through the world of Branzen!
row.notes: Franzen explores themes of social degradation, genocide, racism, and depictions of violence against fantasy characters. Some creatures and characters have nude bodies, but are not designed for titillation.

row.name: 启云的世界Qiyun's World
row.detailed_description: What kind of work is this? This is an adventure game with a first person perspective. Qiyun is a device that allows users to enter the spiritual world of others So as to awaken the memory system of the amnesiac The World of Qiyun 'tells the story of the protagonist being invited as an experimenter to participate in the optimization iteration of the Qiyun system The protagonist enters the memory world numbered 127 through 'Qiyun' A series of interesting adventures occur in the process of attempting to awaken 127 memories by entering the spiritual world to find clues. About game pricing? Due to the fact that the game was independently created by myself, there are many incomplete sound material blueprints. We also welcome colleagues to provide more references. This game is permanently free Guo Suixin's work, thank you for reading my story
row.short_description: This is an adventure game with a first person perspective. Qiyun is a device that allows users to enter the spiritual world of others So as to awaken the memory system of the amnesiac A series of interesting adventures occur in the process of attempting to awaken 127 memories .

row.name: Squeaky Squad
row.detailed_description: Squeaky squad is a Roguelite platformer in which you have to defeat an army of rodents plaguing your ship. Explore 5 various areas in any order you want with their unique quirks and ennemies. Upgrade your character with equipment and weapons to find new ways to fight back the Squeakers. The Ship: This gigantic procedurally generated labyrinth is composed of 5 unique areas with their unique traps and enemies. From flooded pipelines to factories and aerial decks it will be your choice to go wherever you want first as you can defeat the Squeaky Squad in any order you want. The Squeakers: These malicious rodents are so well organized they started to become an army equipped with guns, machines and even more... You will have to use any weapon you find to fight back while dodging their traps and surviving wave fights. You may even save some prisoners who will help you out in the ship hub. The Ship hub: The hub is the best place to find new ways to fight the Squeaky Squad. Use currency kept between your attempts to buy new weapons to be found and upgrade your character with the help of the people you will save along the way. The Squeaky Squad: They are the leaders of the Squeaker army. You'll have to take them down one by one in each area to hope finding whoever is behind this organization.
row.short_description: The Squeaky Squad struck again! Fight an army of rodents in this roguelite platformer.

row.name: Beyond Hanwell Teaser: The Royal Hallamshire
row.detailed_description: Beyond Hanwell is currently in very early active development, please report any bugs or preferences via Steam's discussion boards. I'll try to keep the teaser updated as I develop the full game. Thanks! - Nathan Beyond Hanwell: The Royal Hallamshire Head through the gates of The Royal Hallamshire and discover it's secrets. A hospital far beyond the borough of Hanwell, The Royal Hallamshire is a standalone teaser to the upcoming psychological/survival horror Beyond Hanwell . Dual control melee combat system, land each hit and combo with satisfying intensity. Play your own your own way, non linear open gameplay makes for a unique experience. With multiple ways to complete the location. Immersive. All player feedback is displayed in game, with no HUD whatsoever to keep you immersed and the tension high. Explore a dynamic environment. Play through The Royal Hallamshire multiple times and discover new ways to finish the location with their secrets. We're trying to create an effortless control scheme, navigate the environment naturally with minimal tutorial. The Royal Hallamshire is dense, detailed and atmospheric, explore, search, scavenge and survive. Interact with the world in various ways, use the environment to take out enemies or open up new paths to discover. Dual combat system and environmental blocks. Open up different paths based on what you have available at the time.
row.short_description: The Royal Hallamshire is a standalone teaser to the upcoming psychological horror Beyond Hanwell.
row.notes: Contains extreme gore and violent content, high tension and disturbing themes.

row.name: InteriorDay
row.detailed_description: Screenwrite differently! You don't have to be locked with a unique software for screenwriting. What if you could write everywhere, on any devices (computer, ipad, phones...), on any app (Google Doc, Dropbox Paper, Word, Miro, Evernotes, Trello, ...) What if you could stop caring about formatting, upper cases, and almost everything actually? Product features: Write pure plain text, quick and easy. Write on any device, any word processor editor. Generate professionnal paginated PDF. Send screenplay directly in FinalDraft. Live preview. PDF export automatically fixes uppercases, punctuations, spaces,... Outline structure panel. Scene numbering. Companion app available on Android and iOs.
row.short_description: Screenwrite differently!

row.name: ImpossiBowl
row.detailed_description: Do you have what it takes to become the Champion ? Use your Powers in order to Score Higher than your Opponents in Crazy Tracks filled with Obstacles! Roll with Style by Unlocking Unique Balls and Customizing them. Game Features: ● Unlockable Maps, Balls and Special Powers‎‎‎‎‎‎ ● Balls with unique Physical Characteristics‏‏‎ ● Customization in the Ball Editor ‏‏ ● Single-player and Local Multi-player ‏‏‎ ● Easy and Intuitive Controls‏‏‎‏‏‎
row.short_description: ImpossiBowl is a Chaotically Challenging Bowling Game with Platforming mechanics. Explore a variety of Weird Levels, Unlock new Balls and Powers on your journey to become the Champion!

row.name: Olive's Art-Venture
row.detailed_description: UNIQUE CONTROLS ( Although Keyboard + Mouse is still absolutely playable! ) About the Game STORY Olive is a struggling artist in her late 20s who sleeps alone at a government funded art studio that's short on supplies. Receiving a giftcard for UNLIMITED purchases at ' Magi-Art ' art store, how could she not chase up this opportunity? Tricked into entering the wizard's tower, she now must fight off waves of freakazoid art monsters so she can escape and claim her prize! GAMEPLAY Olive's Art-Venture is a spell-slinging arena and mobbing game. Use the paper on the right side of the screen to draw shapes and cast spells, damaging enemies and protecting you. Every level introduces a new enemy as you attempt to make your way to the top floor and kick whoever's butt built this crazy place. If she's extra efficient and collects enough coins, she'll enter FRENZY mode and be able to cast an infinite amount of spells for a short duration. FEATURES Battle through 8 Floors New enemies on every floor A special Boss Battle at the end Takes 20-30 minutes total to playthrough
row.short_description: Olive's Art-Venture is a spell-slinging arena and mobbing game. Use the paper on the right side of the screen to draw shapes which then cast spells, damaging enemies and protecting you.

row.name: Underlevel
row.detailed_description: UNDERLEVEL '...And so it was God's Will for the Gallant Knight to seek CONQUEST , gather RICHES , and SLAY creatures of SIN. This... is YOUR DESTINY!' GAMEPLAY Underlevel is a game where you play as a horde of skeletons while a player is raiding the dungeon, trying to get as much XP as they can so they level up and potentially kill the boss at the end - it's your job to stop that from happening. Try your best to rescue all the skeletons, destroy all the loot and keep the player from levelling up before they make it to the final floor. The Knight will smash vases and skellies alike to earn loot and level up. At the end of the game, all your saved skeletons are unleashed on the Knight! Hopefully you saved enough skeletons and destroyed enough loot to overcome their growing might. FEATURES Smash loot before the Knight reaches it Gather and rescue skeletons before Knight kills them Follow the Knight's action with the Knight Cam (TM) Throw down in a final battle to save the Boss
row.short_description: In Underlevel, you play as hordes of skeletal minions working to stop a hero from raiding the dungeon to level up and kill your boss. And as skeletons, you REALLY can't afford to lose the dental plan they provide!

row.name: Lively Chair Simulator
row.detailed_description: Lively Chair Simulator is a game with freaky controls. In the game, you are moving a chair by controlling each of the legs of the chair individually. Sounds difficult, but walking is not the limit of a chair. They can run and maybe jump. Have a Try, it is free for now. See if you are suitable for being a chair. It is not a WASD system, instead, it is a QWERASDFGH system, four for moving legs forward, four for moving legs backward, and two for abilities. It is important to have a basic understanding of the system. In single mode, there are some levels to let you get good control of the chair. Some chairs may not be suitable for passing all levels. After finishing the levels, you should know how to walk, run, upslope, upstairs, push boxes, and jump. In multiplayer mode, there are six games. 15m Race and Seesaw games can be started with only one player. 15m Race – Just Run Pushing Game – The last one not touching the outside wins. StoneBall – The first team reaches 10000 points wins. – Earning points if public stoneball or your team target stoneball in range of your team pointing stoneball. – Losing points if no team members are in range of your team pointing stoneball or any team stoneballs from the other team in range of your team pointing stoneball. 6036 – The time of the last person who touched the ball will be accumulated. – The game ends when someone's time reaches 60s. – The one with the time closest to 36s wins. Air Hockey – Just like air hockey Seesaw – The game ends if the seesaw hits the ground. – Getting points from pushing away the stone balls. – Losing points if you fall. Features: – 7 different chairs – 12 levels – Multiplayer – Achievements – Simple 3D Graphics
row.short_description: Lively Chair Simulator is an indie multiplayer game with strange controls. Let’s see if you are suitable to be a chair.

row.name: Future Breach: Youngblood
row.detailed_description: What to expect gameplay-wise: This ISN’T a casual run-and gun that you can just pick up for a few minutes. We've made a tactical methodical game with resource gathering, teammate commands, various team classes and squad management. If you like dungeon crawlers you’ll fit right in. Your main priority is to capture workers in a nonlethal manner, though the final decision is up to you. Loot enemy bases for supplies and materials, both for yourself and to build the megaship. Command your squad to breach doors, capture workers, build turrets and heal you. Lore: It is the year 2501. Humanity colonizes space, and the war for Gliese 581C is on. Unbeknownst to both factions, an asteroid is heading their way. However, in the fighting they destroyed all the spaceferring megaships. Now, they must raid each other’s bases to capture workers to build their ship first, before the planet is hit. 3D-Rendered color game that has full XVGA resolution support. - Command a Squad and Breach into buildings! - Destructible walls and doors - Customize your and your squad's loadout - Full control of your squad- tell em what to do! - IS there a story? YES, you'll love it Command to Breach and clear! Be nonlethal when possible...
row.short_description: Future Breach: Youngblood is a prologue chapter of the main game, Future Breach 3D. Breach and Clear areas tactically in a team-based shooter.

row.name: INVERT: The Climb
row.detailed_description: No Updates Unfortunately, I have lost the source code for this project. For that reason, there will be no future updates or content added. It won't be possible to fix any bugs too. About the Game INVERT: The Climb is a rage inducing precision platformer with no checkpoints. Your Goal? To reach the moon! It's as easy as it sounds... ok maybe not. How To Play? You can invert the map to show new paths or... fall down to the start. Your choice I guess... GAMEPLAY High Stakes Platforming: The only way to the moon is up, if you fall then that's on you. Inverting: Invert the map to show new platforms but destroy old ones. Experience All Emotions: The emotions you'll probably experience are happiness, satisfaction, peace, pride, heartbreak, anxiety, stress, confusion, frustration, that one emotion you experience when you throw your controller, a sense of being cheated, pain, and most importantly, rage. FEATURES All your progress is saved, both good and bad. An addictive gameplay loop. Online leaderboards based on fastest time.
row.short_description: Embark on a journey to the moon in this rage inducing precision platformer with no checkpoints! You'll climb, fall, then cry and do it all again.

row.name: DOLL EYE: CHAPTER ONE
row.detailed_description: DOLL EYE: CHAPTER ONE is the first part of a dialogue-based, story-driven psychological horror game made in RPG Maker MZ. 'Where did this all start?' Tomorrow is the anniversary of your son's death, but you can't let that distract you from your everyday life. Your daughter has just sent you a message asking you to pick her up near that one shark dude's bar. Worry not - your guardian angel can keep you company... Wait, who the hell is that? 'I think...' This game features original art/music and is about one hour long. This might depend on your reading speed, how many things you check, your choices, etc. This game has one ending. '...I think I realize it, now.'
row.short_description: DOLL EYE: CHAPTER ONE is the first part of a dialogue-based, story-driven psychological horror game made in RPG Maker MZ.
row.notes: This game contains loud/unsettling sounds and imagery (static, heartbeats, a mild jumpscare), creepy imagery (eyes, distorted figures), themes of loss and death, swearing, crude language, blood, alcohol, and smoking.

row.name: Urchin
row.detailed_description: Urchin (Universal Renderer, Creating Helpful Images for Neuroscience) is a free and open source tool for neuroscientists that supports interactive exploration of large-scale electrophysiology and imaging datasets. Urchin is only the renderer , to control Urchin and display brain regions you need to use the Python API which can be found on our website. Urchin currently supports the Allen CCF mouse atlas and the Waxholm rat atlas. As a community-driven project we hope you will report back about what you find useful and frustrating so that we can make changes in the future. Please use the issues page on Github for this purpose.
row.short_description: Interactive data exploration for neuroscience in an intuitive 3D environment.

row.name: Home
row.detailed_description: Late at night you enter their world. You will inhabit a girl named Abby and influence the world around her. Accompanied by her brother Michael you will traverse beautiful lands, unfamiliar places, and dark forests. Careful your presence has caught the attention of something sinister... Many indie RPGs claim to be a new quirky game, but Away From Home is a mix of many great RPGs. It captures weirdness, difficult decision making, and a beautiful story. The game combines traditional RPG gameplay with rhythm game elements! The characters are full of emotion and let you empathize with them. Don't forget that this world needs you . Imagine if a JRPG and a Rhythm game had a love child. This game plays like Earthbound when it comes to walking and talking in it's overworld, but when it comes to missions and battles it throws in rhythm games related to the event. Characters also have real voices to help create mood and feeling to them. The big highlight of the gameplay is the huge amount of animations. The characters in this world are alive and through your gameplay you will begin to understand. The amount of things to do in locations are never ending. Chocked full of lengthy side missions that unlock you new moves and items as well as random chance based events. The progression of side quests and random town events are based from entertaining games such as Yakuza 0! The world is large and will take you hours to complete everything, not to mention alternate routes that bring replay-ability. Some routes include game changing decisions as well as items and battles you wouldn't be able to do had you made different choices.
row.short_description: A Rhythm based RPG experience. Providing detailed pixel art and expressive animation. Experience a fun world with lots of colorful characters. Come and disrupt their peace!

row.name: 花母·序
row.detailed_description: 马上添加愿望单！ 关注我们 感谢大家的关注，以下是我们微博和QQ群 我们的邮箱是：2914260286@qq.com Esheep玩家qq群：590165236 Esheep微博：@E-SHEEP工作室 About the Game 欢迎来到《花母·序》，《花母·序》呈现的《花母》故事的前1/4的流程，在这部分里，大家会在一个穷乡僻壤的破学校里求学，探索。游戏采用的是传统的文字冒险游戏风格呈现。未来《花母》游戏会呈现出后续更多的冒险和遭遇，并且能够彻底的挖掘出埋藏在这个学校背后千丝万缕的真相。罪恶的根源究竟是谁，它到底是怎么创造出如今的这幅破败。 全校加起来只有你们8个学生，如此冷清的校园不禁让你有一种不详的预感，尽管只有这么几个同学，你也会竭尽所能和大家一同探索这个学校背后的故事。 起初刚来到学校你们就遇到了一个怪人，他的行为举止，他令人生畏的形象，无处不在的怪事都指向了这个盲眼老头，你们最终将如何排除掉这个隐患。 在校园的每一天，你都可以决定选择面对怎样的事件和挑战，其中包含和仅有的几位同学打好关系，探索校园的奇异事件，逐渐抽丝剥茧，找到始作俑者。 你可以通过提升你自身的属性，来面对突如其来的选择与挑战，属性越高，面对挑战的成功率就越高，挑战成功意味着你可以获得同伴的信任，免去伤害的侵扰。 更多地游戏内容，敬请期待2023年冬上线的《花母》游戏

The Blue Men, an ancient race of warriors thought to have been exhiled forever, have made their return, and they want to reclaim their spot at the top of the food chain. Will humans put aside their differences for the greater good? Or will they die by the hands of the Blue Men? This is the story of SKULLFracture! CODEDOOR
row.detailed_description: About This Game Welcome to CODEDOOR, a thrilling survival action experience set in a chilling, abandoned container yard overrun by relentless zombies. Each session throws you into an eerie industrial landscape scattered with locked containers, but only one matches the unique code you're given. Your objective is clear: hunt it down and unlock it to advance to the next wave. Satisfying Combat Arm yourself with powerful weapons, including the precise M1911 and rapid-fire MAC-10, each delivering satisfying feedback with impactful visual effects and immersive sound design. Feel the intensity with every shot and elimination as you fend off waves of aggressive zombies. Ultimate Goal Reach Wave 10 and secure at least 30 kills to unlock the ultimate weapon... The Nuke. Pick it up, launch it, and celebrate a spectacular victory, bringing an explosive end to your nightmare. Key Features Dynamic Container Hunt: Freshly generated codes and containers ensure random and endless replayability, ideal for speedrunning. Impactful Combat: Satisfying weapon handling, impressive kill effects, and immersive audio feedback. Strategic Survival: Test your tactical thinking under constant pressure. Immersive Environment: Detailed, atmospheric container yard designed to keep you on the edge of your seat. Rare and Mysterious Events Be alert! The abandoned yard holds secrets... Will you unlock the secrets and survive the CODEDOOR?
row.short_description: A tense survival action game where you hunt for uniquely coded containers in an abandoned container yard infested with zombies. Survive, strategize, and fight your way to Wave 10 to unleash a decisive, game-ending nuke.

row.detailed_description: Alta's Odyssey is a 2D Platform Adventure. After suffering the loss of his beloved rabbit, Alta travels on one final journey with his companion where together they explore the stages of grief through colorful and mysterious landscapes. Time your jumps right to make it across broken bridges and treacherous obstacles and find pieces of carved stone collectables hidden throughout the levels for a fitting end to a lifelong friendship.

row.name: We're Tethered Together
row.detailed_description: Offered as sacrifice, you play as a character desperately seeking escape from a dark presence lurking within the catacombs. Trapped below, danger lurks in a world frozen by fear. With the help of a mysterious guide, you’re not alone on your journey. To survive this perilous trial, use your wits to platform, swing, and sneak as you endure treacherous forces at every turn. Originally created as a submission for the Brackey’s Game Jam 2022.2 and ranked 14th place, the short and sweet game of 'We’re Tethered Together' has been redeveloped from the ground up. Will you escape... or become another offering?
row.short_description: Cast into an ancient crypt, survive the horrors that dwell below, and ascend from despair with your unexpected companion in this short 2D puzzle platformer. Take risks to evade the petrifying gaze from beyond the dark.

row.name: The InVincible Iron Ivy: Enter the Pretty, Pretty Princess
row.detailed_description: Take to the role of The InVincible Iron Ivy ('Iron Ivy') in this Soulslike 3rd person role-playing game (“RPG”) who has superpowers that harness properties encompassing concepts of science called 'Sci-fi Powers.' Iron Ivy’s powers are labeled as Geokinesis, which provides her with the ability to manipulate and control both the elements of earth and nature. This dynamic includes synthesizing lightning bolts, controlling and manipulating, moisture, and barometric/atmospheric pressure to form, and manipulating gases and liquids to cause chemical reactions. Additionally, she uses this ability to manipulate ivy leaves to make her ivy board that provides her with flight. Finally, Iron Ivy has the ability to transmute plants into humanoid and animaloid ('animal-like') creatures like her A.I. companions Sunny, Snapper, and Lily. You will unlock Iron Ivy's Sci-FI Powers by accumulating experience points (“XP”), deactivating enemy troopers, acquiring items and special attributes, rare tools; and the exploration and completing quests.
row.short_description: This game is a Soulslike Role-playing game that uses a progress system (“leveling system”) for measuring players’ rates of success. This version of the game is a single-player mode-only game.
developers: JCM Design of North Carolina, Incorporated
publishers: JCM Design of North Carolina, Incorporated

row.name: HBD-RPG
row.detailed_description: Explore a world of pixel art fantasy, where every building holds a unique surprise . Help the locals, dance in a side quest, and finish the main quest. But don't forget, it's your birthday at the end of the day! Have FUN ! Lore-heavy: The game focuses on the lore of Cotton Kingdom and does not contain much intense battle mechanics. Male-centric: The game was originally developed to wish the developer's brother on his birthday, so it is male-centric and does not have a gender-change feature. row.detailed_description: Treachery in Beatdown City U.N. Trouble is the exciting prologue to the Brawling Action Tactics game Treachery in Beatdown City. In Treachery in Beatdown City, President Blake Orama was kidnapped during his speech at the U.N. This is your chance to play a fresh look at what led up to the speech. Orama may be a bit stiff and pretty full of himself, but when it comes down to it he can throw down in the streets! In this prologue, play as Orama to explore the area around the U.N. and encounter/fight off a deluge of the WORST people, from obnoxious bicyclists to werewolf loving wannabe politicians. FEATURES: Use the power of the PRESIDENTIAL FIST to throw out fireballs, flying uppercuts, spinning kicks, and more! Use a mix of real time and COMBO MENU based attacks to tackle your foes! Build custom combos from a bunch of fun unique attacks to create strike combos, grapple combos, and strike and grapple-ombos! Fight against class based enemies, each with their own unique attack styles, behavior patterns and looks! Inflict Status Effects such as Stun, Burn and Bleed; but watch out, the enemies can do the same! Nod your head to a timeless score by Inverse Phase, creator of such albums as Pretty Eight Machine and the Chipping of Isaac
row.short_description: Master the art of the Presidential Fist! Play as Blake Orama on his way to the UN. Meet terrible people and beat 'em up with STYLE! FREEZE TIME, build custom combos with fireballs, centrist uppercuts and roundhouse kicks in this quick prologue to Treachery in Beatdown City!

row.name: Knight Speed

As a valiant knight, leap across perilous towers, skillfully shoot down enemies with your trusty bow, and protect your kingdom while racing against the relentless passage of time. row.name: Salvo Shuffle
row.detailed_description: Salvo Shuffle is a turn-based bullet-hell roguelike with combat mechanics similar to Undertale . Enemies can only damage you by spawning individual bullet-hell attacks (aka. salvos ). Defeat the most challenging foe to make your life easier or keep them all alive for a massive combo and coin multiplier . The choice is yours! The salvos might be simple on their own, but because you fight many enemies simultaneously, the actual bullet hell can vary drastically from fight to fight. Ascend the procedurally generated Firework City and collect various augments to assist you in your fights. Manage your coins and health until you make it to the top and defeat the final boss that is waiting for you there. The City is composed of many interconnected spaces. Choose one of up to four spaces at a time until you reach the end, on the 30th space. Plan your route carefully! Some spaces are dangerous fights, while others might give you a temporary buff, some coins, or health, or they might be a shop for you to purchase new augments or to upgrade your items. Between dodging the enemy attacks, you can strike back by using your weapon or the many different augments you collected in Firework City. Focus fire is of the utmost importance. If one threat is giving you more trouble than most, it could be a good idea to focus on killing that enemy first. However, you will also be rewarded for leaving enemies alive for longer. It's high risk, high reward. Augments are the run-defining items of Salvo Shuffle. There are active augments that you can trigger manually and passive augments that either affect a stat or get triggered automatically under certain conditions. Every augment is distinct from the next and changes the gameplay in a significant manner. Applying status effects is one possible effect of augments. They can greatly impact how difficult the next wave of salvos is going to be. Watch out though, most augments also have minor negative effects , so choose carefully! The game offers many unique challenges to increase the difficulty of a run. There are 10 challenges with up to 3 levels of difficulty. Although they make the game overall more difficult, they also grant you more exp and coins. So if you want to use more augments in a run, this is where you'd do it. The game also features an action difficulty slider in the options to slightly decrease or increase the difficulty of salvos with no penalty or guilt attached. Some achievements will also greatly affect your run and will reward you with a player cosmetic to use. And best of all: Salvo Shuffle is completely free to play ! No in-app purchases, ads, or anything. The game also has a public discord server (link on the right).
row.short_description: Salvo Shuffle is a bullet-hell roguelike that mixes turn-based and action-based combat.

row.name: Chess Ultimate
row.detailed_description: Prepare to rethink everything you know about chess! Chess Ultimate is a draft-based strategy game that combines the timeless appeal of chess with dynamic, game-changing twists. Build your dream team by drafting unique characters, each with their own powerful abilities, and face off in battles where no two games are ever the same. Outsmart your opponents with clever strategies, unleash your team, and dominate the board in this exciting reimagining of the classic game. Whether you're a chess enthusiast or a newcomer, Chess Ultimate offers fresh gameplay that keeps you coming back for more. Are you ready to draft, strategize, and conquer?
row.short_description: Chess just got an upgrade! Chess Ultimate, where precision strategy meets colorful chaos. Build your team from a roster of unique, quirky characters to defend your King while plotting your opponent’s downfall. Easy to pick up, endlessly fun to master, and a fresh take on the classic game of wits.

row.name: Echoes Of Steel
row.detailed_description: Millions of years ago, an alien civilization has discovered the secret to a good life. They encapsulated their wisdom in 'important boxes'. In each level, your task is to shoot your way through ranged and melee enemies to reach those boxes and reveal ancient alien wisdom. Features Both Shotgun and Rifle Gunplay Ranged and Melee Enemies You can get the weapons of ranged enemies you've destroyed. Weapon switching during combat Nice ancient quotes Nice views
