row.name: PlayStation®VR2 App
row.detailed_description: Enjoy VR games and apps on Steam with PlayStation VR2! Play VR games and apps on Steam using your PlayStation VR2 VR headset and PlayStation VR2 Sense controllers. Set up your PlayStation VR2 on your PC. Update the firmware for your PlayStation VR2 VR headset and PlayStation VR2 Sense controllers. Adjust settings for your PlayStation VR2 from the SteamVR dashboard, including setting your play area and screen brightness. You'll need the following to get started with PlayStation VR2 App: PlayStation VR2 VR headset PlayStation VR2 Sense controllers PlayStation VR2 PC adapter DisplayPort™1.4 cable (sold separately) Bluetooth® adapter (sold separately, required only if your PC doesn't support Bluetooth®) For details about the required specs for PC, visit the PlayStation VR2 support page, or refer to the 'System Requirements' section below. Using this app When connecting PlayStation VR2 Sense controllers to a PC, connection or tracking problems may occur depending on the condition of the Bluetooth devices being used or the surrounding environment. In such cases, refer to the PlayStation Support page titled 'Bluetooth adapters compatible with PS VR2 on PC' for more information. To play VR games and apps on Steam with PlayStation VR2, PlayStation VR2 App needs to be installed on your PC. Keep the app installed even after initial setup is complete.
row.short_description: Enjoy VR games and apps on Steam with PlayStation VR2! Install PS VR2 App to use PS VR2 on your PC, set up your PS VR devices, and keep the firmware for PS VR2 headset and PS VR2 Sense controllers up to date.

row.name: SCP: Rulebreaker
row.detailed_description: Dive into the heart of horror with this survival game inspired by the mysterious SCP Foundation. [/img] Following the opening of Site Samekh , once a secure bastion of the Foundation, chaos has erupted. All other sites, except for Sites 15 and 19, have been abandoned, converging on the Samekh complex. An unprecedented concentration of anomalies, unleashed during a containment breach, has left the complex in a state of desolation. Take on the role of a Foundation guard, facing the ultimate survival test as the horrors of the anomalies threaten to consume everything. Game Features: Explore an SCP Foundation complex, once safe, now plunged into madness and danger. Follow the radio communications of Tactical Response Officer (TRO) Alex , trapped in the surveillance room, and uncover the secrets of the complex to escape. Face a variety of anomalies , each with unique behaviors and mechanics, making every encounter unpredictable. Use your diverse arsenal to fend off anomalies and switch optics ( ACOG, Red Dot, EOTECH ) to adapt to various combat situations. Deploy grenades to repel entities, and access crucial areas of the complex using access cards. Use  SCPs like SCP-714 or SCP-005 to assist in your survival quest and tackle unique challenges. Walk, run, and aim strategically to evade the dangers of the containment breach. Use  night vision goggles to explore the dark corners of the complex. Discover the game's fascinating story, particularly the key events triggered by the new director. Search the complex's various computers to understand the situation and unravel the mysteries surrounding you. Immerse yourself in a world where the abnormal becomes the norm, and strategic thinking is the key to facing your deepest fears. Dive into the unknown, survive the Samekh complex, and remember: We work in the shadows so you can live in the light. The fate of the complex now rests in your hands. Are you ready to take on the challenge?
row.short_description: After the opening of Site Samekh, only Sites 15 and 19 remain active. Complex Samekh was the most secure, but a new director hastened its downfall. As a guard, surviving the madness of anomalies is vital.Survive and find the way out.
row.notes: The game features intense scenes of blood and gore. The game is intended for mature audiences. We advise individuals who have experienced traumatic events to refrain from playing SCP: Rulebreaker. Our game is a first-person shooter. This means that we depict the use of firearms in situations where they are employed against both human and non-human entities, resulting in lethal outcomes. Warning: The game contains graphic and violent elements, including the depiction of deceased characters. It is recommended for a mature audience.

row.name: Virtuar Z
row.detailed_description: Character & Classes Choose from a diverse of unique character classes, each with their own distinct playstyle, weapons, and abilities. Whether you prefer being a stealthy assasin, an armed tanker, or a versatile healer, there's a class to suit your preferred. Progression & Customization Unlock new character, weapon, and special abilities as you progress in play the game by collecting combat points. Customize your character's appearance and loadout to create a unique playstyle that reflects your personality through in-game purchases. Third-Person Perspective Experience adrenaline-pumping laser fights from a third-person perspective that provides players a wider field of view, allowing for better situational awareness & strategic maneuvering. Engage in fast-paced battles, utilizing a variety of weapons, abilities, and tactics. Competitive Ranking System In Virtuar Z, the competitive ranking system is designed to reflect a player's skill level and provide a matchmaking experience that is balanced and competitive. As you win streak 5 matches, you can progress through the ranks. These tiers represent the skill level and matchmaking ranking of players. Here is a general overview of the tier pool in Virtuar Z. Zenith is the highest tier in Virtuar Z and is reserved for the absolute best players in the game. Futuristic Collection Cards In Virtuar Z, collection cards are a part of the game's progression system that allows players to customize and enhance their gameplay experience. Here are some key points about collection cards: Unlocking and Upgrading - Collection cards can be obtained by earning them through gameplay or by opening crates. Enhancing Abilities - Each collection card provides a specific enhancement or ability to your character or class. Customization - Collection cards allow you to customize your playstyle and tailor your character or class to your preferences. Elemental Weapon System In Virtuar Z, there are a variety of elemental weapon system and their effect that players can use.
row.short_description: Virtuar Z is a sci-fi third-person shooter game set in the future in a city full of conflict. Experience adrenaline-pumping laser combat from a third-person perspective that gives players a wider field of view, allowing for better situational awareness & strategic maneuvers.
row.notes: Players will compete in combat shooting and will see shooting scenes between player vs player or player vs robot, there are no sexual scenes in this game, there are scenes of being killed but they are not made with extreme scenes or animations and all the characters are made using armor costumes or modest costumes

row.name: Dark Odyssey
row.detailed_description: Dark Odyssey German version now available Dark Odyssey German version is now available. Switch the in-game language via Manage-Properties-General-Language. Please note that the English version and the German version do not share the same data. Enjoy your game! About the Game Experience the magic world. Become a hero in epic RPG episode adventure! 【Growth Speed】 Upgrade to full level without lifting a finger! Character level and combat power increase automatically even when offline throughout the day! Get stronger and stronger! 【BOSS Challenge】 Varieties of dungeons and bosses are waiting for you to challenge! The more bosses you hunt, the stronger your power will be! Swing your sword and harvest abundant loots with your buddies, and become the strongest! 【Level up Character】 Learn new combat skills, upgrade your equipment and customize your look with new armor. Find rare weapons and test your skills against other players in the PvP arena. 【Aesthetic Style】 Exquisite outfits of different styles, cute pets, gorgeous wings, and powerful weapons, all the things you could ever get are here! Match your unique look and show your style! 【Make New Ally】 Meet hundreds of other players and work collectively to survive the orc invasion. Find new friends and complete quests together! It is a world of heroes, quests and battles!
row.short_description: Dark Odyssey, an epic online rpg game that features idle playing, dungeon challenges, boss fights, character enhancing and customizations. Get ready to embark on a dark and thrilling journey, increase your power, team up with other players and save the world!

row.name: Hotel VIP
row.detailed_description: You are a guest in this very particular hotel in Angel City. The room has been paid for few days by the company and you have a lot of free time. Take your time to explore the hotel, enjoy the view and meet the other residents but remember, you must not say a word. A swap puzzle game set in a strange hotel Explore, swap images and unlock cards! - Explore the Hotel VIP freely. - Meet the other residents and interact with them without talking. - Solve little swap minigames to unlock images. Is it that easy ? - 18 Clues to collect in total (40 with DLC). - 4 Rooms to discover - 16 pictures to unlock  (80 with DLC) All 3D arts by JUL3D.
row.short_description: Welcome to Hotel VIP, a very particular and secret place in Heaven City. Discover the hotel, meet the residents but don't say a word...

row.name: Magic And Dragons : 4X Battle
row.detailed_description: 🏰🐉 A New 4X FTS Strategy Game! 🐉🏰 Embark on a new adventure as you have been invited to join the *Open Beta* of Magic And Dragon - a 4X strategy game set in a fantasy universe! Be part of the development journey and help shape the game with your valuable feedback. 🔮 Tailored for touchscreen devices but still enjoyable with traditional controls: Enjoy simplified gameplay mechanics (maybe even too much?) and UI, focusing on quicker fun. 🐲 Delve into a World of Fantasy Encounters: Immerse yourself in a realm of monsters, demons, and dragons, where encounters await. ⚔️ Master the Art of Tactical Warfare: Assemble a formidable army with an extensive variety of units, each boasting unique abilities and spellcasting prowess. Engage in epic battles, where tactical brilliance is the key to victory! 🗺️ Explore a Vast and Diverse Map: Dive into a realm of endless possibilities, offering a rich tapestry of strategies and counters. With a plethora of choices and diverse maps, every game promises a fresh and thrilling experience. 😄 A Dash of Humor: Prepare for a smile or two. Or maybe less. 💎 No Pay-to-Win, No Ads: Like the good old times. 🎉 Join the Open Beta Now Download now and set forth on an adventure filled with conquest, magic, and camaraderie. The fate of this game lies in your hands!
row.short_description: Turn-based strategy game in a world filled with magics, demons and dragons! Build, expand, conquer, form alliances and wage wars.

row.name: Super Paul World
row.detailed_description: Dive into an exciting adventure in 'Super Paul World' where you can choose from 6 unique characters and countless cosmetic customization options to make your hero one of a kind. Your mission? Help Baker Tim regain his ability to produce cookies. Experience the thrill of the game in various modes, including the single-player story mode where you'll battle through multiple levels, and the endless mode where you collect points by defeating countless enemies until you run out of lives. You can also team up or compete against friends in the multiplayer mode. Earn experience points (EXP) by defeating enemies or playing the multiplayer mode and level up to unlock a variety of cosmetic items, including knight armor, fox suit, blue jacket, blue cap, crown, and much more. Your skills will be put to the test as you make both big and small jumps in the game world, scale walls, and defeat enemies in melee or ranged combat. Stay alert, as defeated enemies may drop life, helping you stay in the game longer. The story begins when two villains steal the Cookie-Nexus-Core, which gives Baker Tim the ability to produce cookies. Chase the villains through different worlds and embark on an epic adventure to retrieve the Cookie-Nexus-Core and help Baker Tim. Gameplay Features Singleplayer Story Endless Fight Arena Controller Support
row.short_description: Experience a great adventure in 'Super Paul World' where you defeat many enemies while trying to retrieve the Cookie Nexus Core for Baker Tim. Earn experience points (EXP) to acquire various cosmetic items.

row.name: PIXELS
row.detailed_description: Join our Discord community There you can share your pixel art, find a team, report bugs and keep up with all the news! About the Game PIXELS is the new way of pixel battles. Features One world canvas Players from all over the world paint on one scalable canvas. Watch where the players are Press TAB to see all the cursors. And other additional data. SUPER PIXELS The brand-new animated pixels. Not just ONE pixel You get a limit of 100 pixels and 10 super pixels. Cooldown depends on number of players. Quick paint mode Just press SHIFT and create. Community features Teams, users and ratings with leaderboard. Share your art to the world.
row.short_description: PIXELS is the new way of pixel battles. Share your art to the world on a huge canvas. NOW OFFLINE!
row.notes: May contain swearing, coarse language, and implicit scenes of a sexual nature, explicit erotica and nudity.

row.name: Demon Of The Dark
row.detailed_description: SURVIVE Progress through the horrifying hospital, try not to fall prey for the monster who is somewhere in the darkness. Solve puzzles to get a step closer to the exit and making your way out of this nightmare. Your journey will only get more and more twisted, and troubled, as you move on. THE MONSTER The monster goes on a killing spree once it escapes its enclosure, and wreaks havoc, killing countless people. Escaping it is near impossible, due to it's stealth and quick movement. If you see him, RUN. The only option is to run for your dear life, before the monster reaches you and ends your life. PRODUCT DESCRIPTION Demon Of The Dark is a 3D Exploration / Investigation indie horror project, made by a single-developer. The player, Ethan, investigates an abandoned medical research facility, to piece together the possible events that may have taken place. The player will face many obstacles, and will eventually face a mutated organism that kills anything it sees. As the player delves deeper and deeper into the facility, the more twisted it starts to become. STORY You are Ethan Luke, a fairly new police investigator with a knack for solving mysterious cases. You find yourself standing outside an abandoned research facility late at night. There have been numerous reports regarding the missing people lately. None of the people had any past criminal record or history. All investigations so far point out to this building that has been abandoned quite for some time. As part of your job, you are directed to look into the whole area, as there has been a recent report of a fellow cop, Joseph William, a.k.a. Joey, being reported missing while investing the area. No words received from him after he went into this building. You are further advised to look for any clues, such as employee notes or any other hint around this facility to establish a better concept of the possible chain of events happened here. These steps are not mandatory, but you need to check the whole hospital, until you are at the end. The SWAT team is being engaged and will be en route soon. Good Luck. You'll need it.
row.short_description: A 3D Survival Horror Game, in which the player has to investigate an abandoned medical research facility, while looking out for whatever danger that resides in the unknown darkness. An indie game made by a 14 year old student.

row.name: My Douchey Boss Has a Gentle Twin Brother?! - BL Visual Novel
row.detailed_description: When Kyle gets a new job at a fashion company, he meets Vincent Zircon, who happens to be his eccentric boss. Vincent, being quite mischievous, often teases the newcomer, Kyle, causing him to think that his boss is odd. One day, he bumps into his boss after work and is surprised when his superior acts kind and gentle, even offering to buy lunch for him. Kyle starts to wonder if his boss is messing with him again. But after confronting the man about his change in behavior, Kyle realizes that the kind and gentle version of Vincent is actually someone else. Someone named Vernon Zircon, Vincent's twin brother. As Kyle gets closer to the twin brothers, he finds out that they are estranged. The two are very different individuals with different values, making it hard for them to get along. So what will happen when they both start to develop feelings for the same person...? The character you are playing as. Kyle is an average employee who just wants a normal job and a normal life. Vincent is outgoing and playful, but he's serious when it comes to his job. He works hard to maintain his fashion company. He has a bad habit of lashing out at people when he's feeling stressed. Vincent doesn't like relationships within the office. He especially dislikes it if an employee has a crush on him. Due to his busy schedule, he hasn't gotten the time to relax and go out with someone. Vernon is gentle and considerate of others. After his father retired, Vernon took over the business. Although he is talented when it comes to his job, he isn't passionate about it. Since he feel like his life is empty, he tends to visit a café to escape from it all. Being a CEO of a company, Vernon feels as though he doesn't have a genuine connection with anyone. He just wants a real friend. - Around 30K Words (2-3 Hours Playtime) - 3 Endings (Neutral Ending, Vincent's Ending, Vernon's Ending)
row.short_description: Kyle's new boss, Vincent, is mischievous and eccentric. One day, Kyle bumps into his boss after work and is surprised when his superior acts kind. Later, he finds out he'd actually met his boss' twin brother, Vernon. The brothers are estranged, but what happens when they fall for the same person?

row.name: Wacky West
row.detailed_description: Wacky West is a crazy roguelite set in the Wild West! You are the sole survivor in a dangerous post-apocalyptic world. Fight hordes of mutants and zombies, collect materials, and upgrade your equipment to face the toughest bosses. In the sun-scorched Arizona desert, every day is a fight for survival! Craft increasingly powerful weapons, upgrade your gear, and save your cat - your only friend in this unforgiving world! Save the kitten Imagine a world where you have no support except your furry friend. Well... At least your kitten will keep you company. Except that heartless mutants have abducted your pet, and you are its last hope ! Don't give up! Run forward and become stronger with every run. Upgrade your equipment, create new weapons , and never give up! Each run brings new upgrades and materials that will bring you closer to defeating the most dangerous bosses . As is often the case in roguelite games, the further you run, the stronger your survivor becomes. Very Wild West Wacky West is the wildest west on Steam. You'll need a keen eye and quick fingers to take on the toughest bosses. The atmospheric music and desert landscape of the map will provide you with the highest level of immersion. Zombies and mutants won't let you go, but they don't know that justice has looong guns ! Key features: Create weapons: A unique arsenal of weapons, from auto-aiming machine guns to rocket launchers and flamethrowers. Gather resources: Use everything you find along the way - scrap metal, trash, and other materials - to craft tools and weapons. Fight bosses: None of them will go down without a fight. They'll throw grenades, unleash hordes of mutants, and do everything they can to stop you. Traps and power-ups: Avoid dangerous barbed wire, acid puddles, and other traps. Collect useful items—both consumable and functional—that will help you throughout the game. Test different modes: After defeating the final boss, you can continue playing in infinite mode, with greater challenges and double rewards. Grow in strength: Upgrade your equipment, create new weapons, and unlock maps. Each game opens up new possibilities for you.
row.short_description: It's time to grab your revolver! You are the only survivor in a world after a nuclear disaster. Don't wait for high noon. Get moving and fight mutants and zombies to get your cat back! Collect materials, craft weapons, upgrade your gear, and show those freaks they shouldn't mess with the sheriff!

row.name: Virago: Reality New
row.detailed_description: Virago: Reality New invites you to delve into an immersive narrative that follows the tumultuous journey of Willow, a young girl escaping an abusive home only to find herself entangled in a realm of terror and intrigue. This third-person adventure/horror game offers an intense pursuit experience, blurring the lines between reality and nightmare as you strive to outsmart relentless pursuers. Storyline Embark on a haunting odyssey as Willow breaks free from the chains of her troubled past, seeking refuge amidst the enigmatic cityscape. Unforeseen alliances offer fleeting solace, until a sudden abduction compels Willow to ingest a toxic substance. As poison courses through her veins, Willow's reality fractures, plunging her into a surreal realm of hallucination and dread. Gameplay Virago: Reality New promises an adrenaline-charged gameplay experience, where you must navigate a perilous world teeming with danger. Equipped only with a torchlight, skillfully maneuver through dimly lit environments, leveraging the flickering light beams to disorient stalkers and unveil concealed pathways. Survival hinges on your resourceful evasion and mastery of stealth tactics. Features Intense Third-Person Adventure: Immerse yourself in Willow's harrowing journey, racing against relentless stalkers and confronting the horrors born from the depths of her psyche. Eerie Atmosphere: Traverse an atmosphere saturated with suspense, seamlessly blurring the boundary between reality and illusion to maintain an unrelenting tension. Stealth and Survival: Utilize your surroundings to outsmart tireless pursuers, employing strategic cunning to elude danger at every juncture. Torchlight Mechanics: Manipulate the eerie torchlight to your advantage, distorting stalkers' perceptions while illuminating paths toward safety. Mind-Bending Hallucinations: Experience Willow's fragmented reality firsthand, grappling with disorienting hallucinations that twist the very fabric of her environment.
row.short_description: Virago: Reality New invites you to a chilling adventure where you guide Willow, a survivor escaping abuse, through a world of terror. Master the torchlight, outwit relentless stalkers, and navigate between reality and nightmare. Can you ensure Willow's survival in this heart-pounding pursuit?

row.name: Hues of the Void
row.detailed_description: Combining color matching, line defence, and some random puzzle elements, Hues of the Void is a unique and engaging take on the “x-defense” game genre. Within these prismatic lands, you must defend yourself against the advancing knights of an oppressive theocratic order - The Chromacrusade ! Hone Your Minion Mastery Charge your portals and release a spectrum of creatures from the Void against the onslaught of the Chromacrusade. Minions such as Slimes, Skeletons, Shades, Gazeblasters and many more are at your disposal. Once a minion has served it's purpose, dismiss them just a readily! Scheme plots from your Inner Sanctum Customize your load out of Artefacts , Familars and Friends ! Within your Sanctum, fine-tune your menagerie of eldritch horrors and undead monstrosities, and claw your way to victory over the Chromacrusade! With plenty of summonable monsters to unlock, synergies to uncover and experiment with, your journey is uniquely your own. Delve into Forbidden Secrets Follow the trail of the Chromacrusade, right to the very source! Lead your Summoners to victory through Story Mode, following the story of the Prismatic Lands, unlocking more along the way. As your grand pilgrimage through the Story campaign is complete, dive into endless mode! You can test your most clever combinations and skills against ever-increasing waves of unique and challenging enemies. The vibrant and colorful world of Hues of the Void offers uniquely challenging gameplay experience. As a small family team, it's our sincerest hope to provide an entertaining and engrossing game for players of all ages; it will test your skills and keep you engaged throughout many hours of gameplay!
row.short_description: A dark, eldritch defense game, involving color matching and minion management! Can YOU stave off the Chromacrusade?

row.name: Louma
row.detailed_description: Story: The evil never sleeps, it just wants one thing, its power back. Stop it and search in the Dungeon after artefacts. But be aware, it’s getting more dangerous the deeper you get. Procedural generated floors: The World of Louma will be generated procedural. Fight the enemies and find a way to your destination. Search after keys, artefacts and collect resources. Categories: In the beginning there are different categories between you can choose. Each category has its individual abilities. Upgrade your character: You can upgrade your weapon and buy potions to get a better level. Your level defines your life/power.
row.short_description: Louma is a Roguelike Dungeon Crawler. Fight through the procedural generated floors and save the World of Louma.

row.name: Battlesmiths: Blade and Forge
row.detailed_description: OVER 1,500,000 INSTALLS WORLDWIDE – NOW ON STEAM! After two years of forging, countless battles, and thousands of blades created, your turn has come. Battlesmiths: Blade & Forge is the perfect blend of RPG, deep crafting, strategy, and auto-battler — available now on Steam! Build your town, manage your forge, master the blacksmith trade, create legendary weapons and gear, and lead a squad of heroes into PvP and PvE fights. Prove that you are the ultimate swordsmith and strategist in the medieval world. MASTER THE BLACKSMITH’S CRAFT In Battlesmiths , your gear is not a trophy, but the result of your mastery. Weapons, armor, and runes are created by you — they directly change the appearance and battle style of your heroes. Start forging and upgrading swords and armor, and apply powerful enchantments. Every item crafted by your blacksmith affects the tactics of your heroes in battle. A new smithing master mini-game allows you to personally participate in the creation of every blade. Feel like a true bladesmith! Experiment with skills and gear to create builds that your opponent in the PvP arena will not be ready for. Don't forget about trading: your town residents will gladly buy your handcrafted goods and fill your pockets with gold! LEAD YOUR HEROES TO VICTORY IN TACTICAL BATTLES Assemble a brave squad of powerful warriors and mages. Optimize your builds: equipment and runes directly affect your heroes' damage and movement. Your decisions before the fight determine its outcome. The semi-automatic tactical battles encourage thoughtful preparation and precise tactics. No plan is perfect, but your strategy and the right combination of classes and gear will provide you with the best chance for victory. BUILD AND DEVELOP YOUR TOWN Develop your masters, upgrade buildings, acquire valuable resources, and unlock new crafting and building technologies.  Your town is the core of your power. Protect your legacy by crafting the most perfect gear for your heroes. GUILDS, EPIC BOSSES AND EPIC BATTLES Join a clan or create your own. Unite with allies to fight epic bosses, share resources, and receive guild bonuses. All for the sake of victory! EVENTS AND CHALLENGES Participate in challenges with time-limited rewards, complete daily quests, and earn rare resources. Events are regularly updated: a new goal, a new enemy, and new trophies always await you. FULL PC EXPERIENCE Battlesmiths on Steam is the full, uncompromising functionality, optimized for desktop computers. Play and become one of the greatest blacksmiths to forge their legend in the crafty world of Battlesmiths .
row.short_description: Craft. Battle. Grow. Join thousands of players in the ultimate tactical RPG where every piece of gear is forged by you — and every fight tests your strategy.

row.name: AlphaBit
row.detailed_description: When a soul got a robot, it woken up, and there were already bad souls who wanted a revenge. when the right soul got to the right robot, he took the close weapon to him, and start shooting the bad soul until no robot is left. features Stat pill: take it if you want to add or remove values to some stats, that way changing the gameplay to your decision. Items: you can choose it to activate certain abilities, like bigger bullets. A wave is done after certain bots are killed.
row.short_description: When a soul got a robot, it woken up, and there were already bad souls who wanted a revenge. when the right soul got to the right robot, he took the close weapon to him, and start shooting the bad soul until no robot is left.

row.name: My Friend Aki
row.detailed_description: My Friend Aki is a puzzle-based exploration game focusing on the use of improvised tools to make your way through the hallways of an abandoned mall. What remnants were left behind by the building's previous curators? What bright and glowing secrets now lie nestled away? Make use of the game's novel dynamic lighting system to illuminate gloomy corners and dusty hallways as you slowly turn parts of the mall back on. Make your way forward by creatively utilizing what was left behind.
row.short_description: A horror-tinged puzzle and exploration game set in an abandoned mall. Improvise tools, uncover secrets, and stumble upon something strange and bright in the darkness.

row.name: Mirrorscape
row.detailed_description: Mirrorscape: Immersive Tabletop Gaming Redefined Introducing Mirrorscape, the free-to-play app that delivers an immersive and authentic tabletop gaming experience on PC, Mac, iOS and Android. Built for Dungeon Masters (DMs) and players alike, Mirrorscape offers an intuitive and easy-to-use, authentic 3D environment for building and playing your favorite tabletop role-playing and war games. 'Mirrorscape uses AR to create what might be the best D&D virtual tabletop yet' - GamesRadar+ 'It's easy to get excited about the augmented tabletop, for how it might further revitalize tabletop gaming.” - Wired 'The promise of living characters and armies battling on the tables before us, across atmospheric and immersive worlds, is arguably too cool to second guess.' - Wargamer Free Starter Set and Trial Mirrorscape is free-to-play, and every player receives a Free Starter Set of terrain, miniatures, and dice from renowned brands in the tabletop world, including Dwarven Forge, Reaper Minis, Fat Dragon Games, TitanCraft Custom Minis and Hero Forge. Claim a bonus of 5 free Hero Forge minis when you link your Hero Forge account. Additionally, to enhance your creativity and world-building abilities Mirrorscape offers a 30-Day Free Trial of everything in the Mirrorscape Store. Intuitive World-Building Building has never been easier thanks to Mirrorscapes’s intuitive drag-and-drop stacking, snap points, copy, paste and group functionality and use of clipping planes for multi-level construction of mighty castles, simple taverns and deep, dark dungeons. Bring light to your creations with lit terrain and prop lights. DMs and GMs can easily create intricately detailed adventure maps to be shared with their players and streamed on platforms like Twitch and YouTube. Or, for the “Lazy GM”, grab a pre-built map made by our vibrant user community that fits your campaign or share your own creations on the Mirrorscape Hub! Authentic Digital Twins for Terrain, Minis, Props and Dice From Famous Tabletop Brands To create the adventure map of your dreams Mirrorscape boasts a vast collection of fully painted digital twins of terrain, miniatures, props, and dice from famous brands you already know and love including Fat Dragon Games, Dwarven Forge, Reaper Minis, and Norse Foundry. Each item is meticulously crafted to be an authentic replica of the original physical item for an unparalleled level of realism. Digital replicas of real-world dice bounce in the virtual world just like they do on your table. Dungeon Master Tools to Share and Manage the Adventure Mirrorscape equips DMs with a comprehensive suite of Dungeon Master Tools to manage game night and craft unforgettable gaming experiences. Once your world is complete, share it with your players for free, then use features like hide and reveal for “fog of war” effects, ambient lighting to set the mood, beacons to draw player’s attention, and line of sight and measurement tools to ensure a seamless and engaging gameplay experience. The built-in Mirrorscape HUB streamlines game scheduling, keeping your adventures organized and accessible while helping players find games and Games Masters find players. Immersive Player Experience with Character Point-Of-View Players of role-playing tabletop games and tabletop wargames can choose from a deep collection of beautifully painted miniatures to represent their characters and immerse themselves in their virtual worlds by dropping into their character’s point-of-view. Connect your Hero Forge account and drop your custom minis on the table for even more options! Roll digital dice, inhabit the world from a first-person perspective, check line of sight and bring your adventure to life like never before! Grow Your Collection With Mirrorscape you never pay for the same piece twice and with our ‘top off’ system you can buy ready-to-play maps, terrain, and mini bundles from our amazing partners, and only pay for the pieces you don’t already own. Grow your collection and unleash your imagination for an unbeatable value. And remember, anything you buy you share for FREE with your players! Play Together Anywhere, On Any Device Cross-play together whether around the table or around the world using your PC or Mac via Steam or our iOS or Android mobile versions for phones and tablets. Design on desktop, tweak on tablets, and have your players join in on their phones. Most features are cross-platform so use the screen and device that works for you! Explore in Augmented Reality on Mobile Watch your games come alive with our cutting-edge AR tech on mobile versions for iOS and Android! Drop your maps on your table in authentic, lifelike 3D as if they were real. Roll digital dice that bounce off your actual tabletop! Enter life-scale mode and literally walk through your creations. Players can view the environment through their character’s eyes while it’s being described for an unforgettable experience! Join the Mirrorscape community today and elevate your tabletop gaming experience!
row.short_description: Mirrorscape is bringing the table back to virtual tabletops! Build and play around the table or around the world using authentic 3D terrain, miniatures, and dice from top companies you know and love. Cross-play on iOS and Android devices using the magic of augmented reality!

row.name: Fallen
row.detailed_description: Eson is an angel who is punished with the curse of mortality when they steal the Sky God's Amulet. Now they have to help people in Havoton, a Halloween-obsessed town, in order to survive and atone for their crime. Play through many different and unique minigames as you help the residents of the town prepare for their Halloween festivities and other daily menial tasks. However, with the help of the Goddess of Balance, you can make some of these minigames easier! No strings attached! Experience the game's story and customize your experiences by helping different people out and completing all of the minigames. There are multiple endings, try and collect them all!
row.short_description: A minigame collection game where you help people in the town of Havoton to regain your angelic status!

row.name: Squaretrail: Lines of The Frame
row.detailed_description: Squaretrail: Lines of The Frame is a puzzle and adventure game where you progress by rotating square-shaped worlds. Your main character is a cube and you have to overcome different challenges in each level. You can control your cube with the 'WASD' keys and rotate the world with 'E' and 'Q'. As you complete the chapters, you can unlock new worlds. Squaretrail: Lines of The Frame offers a fun and immersive gaming experience that requires both intelligence and skill. In-Game Features Rotating the World Teleporting Platforms Challenging Maps
row.short_description: Squaretrail: Lines of The Frame is a puzzle and adventure game where you progress by rotating square-shaped worlds. Your main character is a cube and you have to overcome different challenges in each level.

row.name: CHUTNEY: Space Survivor
row.detailed_description: CHUTNEY: Space Survivor is a third person hoard-shooting deck builder that mixes the distinctive look of 1960's retrofuturism with comic book themes and a pastel toon-shaded palette. Face off against hordes of aliens with an auto-shooting hand of ‘cartridges’ - weapons and abilities - that you build and synergise throughout each run. Unlock new cartridges, skills, and original backing tracks through achievements and meta-progression so that you enter each run stronger than before: more weapons, more skills, more XP, more aliens, more groove! Level Up! Grow your power with stat increases as you gain experience and level up Build your Deck! Clear stages to earn rewards, and buy new cartridges to up your arsenal Defeat your Enemies! Use your new power to slay swathes of aliens Repeat!
row.short_description: CHUTNEY: Space Survivor is a third person, hoard-shooting deck builder where you play as Chutney, shooting down hordes of enemies with his Omni-gun. Alter your attacks by collecting different cartridges and create unique synergies!

row.name: Shadowverse: Worlds Beyond
row.detailed_description: Shadowverse: Worlds Beyond is a brand-new strategy card game from the popular Shadowverse CCG. With the newly added super-evolution mechanic and Shadowverse Park, among other brand-new content, there is lots to enjoy for both seasoned and brand-new players. Card Battles The rules of Shadowverse are simple, yet offer limitless ways to strategize and win. Use different card combinations to create unique synergies and strategies in battles against players all around the world. Dive into the game and enjoy strategic card battles with breathtaking graphics and effects. Free Card Pack Every Day Log in to open a free card pack every day! Collect cards for the new compendium feature! Enjoy battling and collecting! New Game Mechanic: Super-Evolution Each of your followers (unit cards you play on the field) can now super-evolve! Followers that have super-evolved are stronger and can knock opposing followers out with powerful attacks and deal damage straight to their leader!  Super-evolve your followers and enjoy exhilarating card battles like never before! Class Choose from 7 unique classes that match your playstyle and create custom decks. Tailor your deck to match your strategy and style, then dive into epic card battles! Story Experience a brand new Shadowverse story where characters are brought to l ife with full voice acting! Follow spectacular stories centered around seven unique characters, each bringing their own personality to the adventure. New Feature: Shadowverse Park Step into the Shadowverse CCG community where players can connect and interact! Show off your avatar with customizable outfits and emotes, bond with others, and grow stronger together!
row.short_description: Shadowverse: Worlds Beyond is a brand-new strategy card game from the popular Shadowverse CCG. With the newly added super-evolution mechanic and Shadowverse Park, among other brand-new content, there is lots to enjoy for both seasoned and brand-new players.

row.name: BLOKI
row.detailed_description: BLOKI is an educational game about residential architecture from the Soviet era. It aims to make people aware of the important function of the colors of buildings, as well as to encourage reflection on the spaces around us. The game also allows you to signal your own needs related to the aesthetics and functioning of these estates while showing the consequences of their implementation. Work plan at the estate: 1. Prepare a facade design for two residential buildings. Use the color palette and available geometric patterns. Follow the instructions to earn as many aesthetic points as possible. 2. Get to know the elements of the surroundings available in the Służew nad Dolinką estate. Choose environmentally friendly, look after social initiatives, and the necessary elements of small architecture. Earn points for aesthetics, sustainability, and functionality. 3. Share your vision with us - share your design on Instagram with #BLOKIgame.
row.short_description: BLOKI is an educational game in which you'll transform into a designer of residential building facades from the Soviet era. Using the available set of tools and guidance from the moderator, you'll design facades and develop the nearby area.

row.name: Kitchen Quest
row.detailed_description: Become the best chef in the world! In Kitchen Quest you can prepare over 50 delicious dishes - in your own fully equipped dream kitchen! From frying pans to deep fryers, everything a real chef needs is included. And don't forget: Your restaurant should be just as impressive as your food - otherwise guests will leave before you can even serve them. Everything a chef's heart desires Your kitchen has more than 50 different ingredients for you to get creative with. Cook, fry, bake and surprise your guests with a varied menu that leaves nothing to be desired. Watch out, the kitchen may catch fire! But be warned: in the hustle and bustle of a real professional kitchen, things can quickly go wrong. A steak on the grill for too long? You've got a problem! In Kitchen Quest, every second counts - and your guests have little patience. Critical guests, real challenges Customers are merciless in their judgement. A late order or a dish that doesn't meet their expectations will have an immediate impact on your rating. Some never give you a second chance, others remain silent - but don't come back. Learn to deal with pressure and keep improving your restaurant. The critics are coming! Invite up to 7 different restaurant critics to take your restaurant to the next level. If they like your food, they'll share their secret favourite recipes with you - which you can then sell yourself. Fancy cooking without the stress? Then sandbox mode is just the thing. All recipes are unlocked immediately, you can take your time to embellish your restaurant - and annoying guests who run away because of every little thing stay outside. Perfect for creative, relaxed play.
row.short_description: Become the best chef in the world! Cook more than 50 dishes in your own kitchen with everything a chef needs. Automate your own restaurant with the help of employees and leave all the annoying tasks behind!

row.name: Ruins To Fortress
row.detailed_description: Ruins To Fortress - A 2D survival game focusing on base building and PvP/PvE gameplay. Welcome to Ruins To Fortress, a thrilling 2D survival game currently in development that puts you in a world of base-building and intense PVP combat. Prepare to embark on a journey as you navigate a harsh, abandoned island teeming with danger and opportunity. Gather resources, construct shelters, cultivate plants, and forge tools and weapons to survive. Feel free to install the separate dedicated server or host the game yourself. Help us stress test the servers as we raise the maximum capacities during Early Access. Gameplay Survival Mechanics : Players start naked, armed only with a club on an island, and must gather basic resources like wood, stone, and food to survive. Unlike other survival games, food is not strictly necessary for survival but provides health benefits. Crafting : Ruins To Fortress offers an extensive crafting system, allowing players to create a wide range of items, from simple tools and weapons to advanced technologies. Resources like metal, cloth, and animal hides are used to craft equipment that facilitates survival. Base Building : Base building is a central aspect of the game. Players can construct shelters to protect themselves from other players, NPCs, and animals. These bases can be attacked and looted by other players, making the game particularly exciting and competitive. Raiding : Another characteristic element of Ruins To Fortress is the raiding of other players' bases. By using explosives and other tools, players can breach enemy bases to steal resources and equipment. PvP (Player vs. Player) : Ruins To Fortress is known for its intense PvP elements. Players can attack each other at any time, making the game a constant challenge. Alliances and rivalries between players or clans strongly shape the gameplay experience. PvE (Player vs. Environment) : Ruins To Fortress already includes numerous PvE elements to offer a non-competitive gaming experience. These PvE elements are planned to be significantly expanded and enhanced over the course of Early Access.
row.short_description: Explore a post-apocalyptic island, craft, build, tear down enemy bases, defend and nuke your rivals! Life's about surviving in this multiplayer game, no matter what it takes!
row.notes: The developer states that the game contains mature content, including unclothed characters without visible genitalia and pixel art blood effects that appear when the player is hit by NPCs or other players.

row.name: English Is Hard_
row.detailed_description: Keeping a cow farm is hard enough, but now there's aliens coming for your bovine buddies! Use your barn cannon to shoot down the aggressive extraterrestrials and protect your cows from being carried off to an untimely demise. If your cannon is too weak, brush up on your typing skills to empower it and wreak havoc on those angry aliens! Wave after wave of diverse aliens will come for your cattle. Use your barn bannon, type power-up words, and destroy cataclysmic meteors so that your animal friends can live for as long as possible. You're only competing against yourself; see if you can manage to get the high score! If you want to protect your cows, you'll need to master your aim, as well as your typing talent. With skill and a little bit of luck, you can set the new high score! At the end of the day, English ain't that hard! A mouse-aimed cannon that gets stronger the more you type Endless, randomized waves with a variety of enemy types Powerups to give you the upper hand against the alien onslaught A high score that you can beat and replace with your own This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: An arcade style typing game that evokes the nostalgia of Missile Command. Defend your cows, shoot aliens, and go for the high score!

row.name: Paper Planes
row.detailed_description: Fly, shoot, and even nuke your friends in Paper Planes! This 2D arcade style shooter is played with up to four players, control a plane or maybe even a wizard all while trying to eliminate each other from out of the sky. Powerups can be found which will give you an edge on the competition, just be sure to avoid any hazards throughout the sky. Come fly with your friends in Paper Planes and crown yourself the victor. Local multiplayer PvP combat. Various types of planes with different abilities. Different maps with unique obstacles. This game was developed as a student project at DigiPen Institute of Technology and was created for educational purposes only. Please check out our publisher page for more information.
row.short_description: Fly, shoot, and even nuke your friends in Paper Planes! This 2D arcade style shooter is played with up to four players, control a plane or maybe even a wizard all while trying to eliminate each other from out of the sky. Come fly with your friends and crown yourself the victor.

row.name: Degradation: Kyomu's Fury - 劣化：キョムの怒り
row.detailed_description: WARNING: this game may potentially trigger seizures for people with photosensitive epilepsy. Viewer discretion is advised. Summary: Degradation: Kyomu's Fury - 劣化：キョムの怒り is a 3D bullet-hell/FPS game in which you explore a strange, seemingly abandoned island while discovering its hidden, vast virtual network. Fight viruses, survive insane waves of rays and bullets, and find out more about the inhabitants of the Network. Some overall primary features: Up to thirteen chapters and three possible endings. A variety of locations, alternating between short exploration and boss battles. 6 difficulty modes, including a practice mode, and a 'MEGA' mode with unique enemy attack patterns, best suited for a second playthrough. A light story about AI, viruses, and making new virtual friends! Gameplay considerations The game can be played with a controller, but a keyboard and mouse setup is recommended. DLSS is available. Realtime ray/path tracing is necessary for some of the effects used in the game. Thus, a GPU capable of handling this type of rendering is required. Bonus content: A game not previously released on Steam, titled World Annihilation Operations: Space Manipulation. It showcases various sci-fi and surreal environments in which space seems unstable. From impossible objects, to teleportation portals, or multiple depths of reflections, explore 5 levels of weird visuals while occasionally solving environmental puzzles. A second much smaller game, never released anywhere, developed in the context of a game prototype design class a few years ago. It is a simple platformer game set in a long tunnel where gravity works in mysterious ways. A music player, letting you listen to the music found within the main game, at your own leisure. This content can be unlocked through specific in-game challenges, or immediately, as gifts for buying one of my DLCs (essentially donations). Academic context: This game (as well as the first bonus game) is done in the context of a PhD research on the integration of logical contradictions in video game fiction. It is expected that more games emerge from this research. Following the publication of these works, the operations developed through the creation process should lead to the development of one much larger adventure game in the coming years. This game is entirely free. If you would like to support the developer, please consider purchasing one of the DLCs (they do not add any content not accessible within the game!).
row.short_description: Fight viruses, survive insane waves of rays and bullets, and find out more about the inhabitants of the Network in this mix of exploration and 3D bullet-hell/FPS game.

row.name: Filled to the Limit
row.detailed_description: A newspaper ad inspires a girl to become a test subject for some quick cash. She is hired to test her limits with a tube-feeding machine, and must reach her full capacity! HOW TO PLAY You have two minutes to fill her up! You control the tube-feeding machine and must make sure there is enough pressure to fill her up fast enough, but not enough pressure for it to blow up. FEATURES A cute girl who gains weight. Fun and replayable. One button controls... A gallery to revisit how far you pushed her limits! Developed for the Weight Gaming's 'Push the Limits' Lo-Cal Gain Jam! Have fun!
row.short_description: ​A newspaper ad inspires a girl to become a test subject for a tube-feeding machine, and must reach her full capacity!
row.notes: Contains expansive female nudity and fetishes.

row.name: Flynt Buckler Wakes the Sleepy Castle Playtest
Bug Bash
row.detailed_description: Dive deeper into the bug-bashing frenzy with Bug Bash! This fast-paced, interactive game now offers 20 unique levels, each presenting its own set of challenges and a variety of bugs to bash. Protect different food items as you progress, adding a strategic twist to your exterminating adventures. On top of the regular critters, keep an eye out for rare bugs – bashing them earns you bonus points! Whether you're a veteran gamer or just looking for some engaging entertainment, Bug Bash’s blend of action and strategy will keep you engaged. Join the fun and discover how adept you are at protecting your feast while bashing those pesky bugs! Bash bugs to accumulate points and advance to the next level. Beware, as missed hits and bugs that escape will deduct points from your score. Guard the food against bugs within the set time limit to earn bonus points. Successfully protecting the food boosts your score. Birds are your allies, helping to eat bugs, while bees quell the bugs' hunger. However, be cautious: accidentally bashing birds or bees will result in a significant point penalty.
row.short_description: Unleash your inner exterminator in Bug Bash! Wield a virtual flipflop to squash bugs, protect your food, and navigate the challenge of sparing birds and bees in this thrilling, interactive game.

row.name: Death Lease
row.detailed_description: Your brother is missing! Your only clue is the last message you received from him while he was checking in on your most recent lessees. Its now up to you to get in and get him out without getting gotten yourself. Travel through the house while avoiding the spirits of the previous inhabitants. This can be done by listening and watching out for them and using the house against them. If you are caught, you are dead. So don't not get caught. Use The House To Survive Close doors and use lights to keep the enemies at bay while finding the items needed to save your brother. Or just sit down for a bit, because that actually really does help. This game features this revolutionary list of new and excited player actions: Use Pick Up Put Down By using your wits and skills, you can avoid the spirits and save your brother and continue being the best realtors in the business! Alternatively Do none of that and just sacrifice your entire head to him. He really likes them.
row.short_description: You will die.
row.notes: Many scenes of gore, suicide, death, and torture are found throughout the level. Some very violent scenes occur when you are killed such as stabbing, drowning, and bodily dismemberment. No actual nudity is shown, but some revealing areas are shown, similar to something seen at beach.

row.name: MINDFIELD
row.detailed_description: Warning: Some scenes contain violence and death, and may not be suitable for all viewers. Viewer discretion advised. As long as the scars remain unhealed, the fight isn't over. After returning from his latest mission abroad, John undergoes a profound transformation. Haunted by the trauma of his recent experience, he finds that he is no longer the person he once was, and this change is evident not only to him but also to those in his life. Though he has developed techniques to bury these painful memories deep within, they persistently resurface, threatening to consume him. In order to break free from this torment, John is compelled to confront the ghosts of his past and make a pivotal decision. Will he find the strength to make the correct choice? VR EXPERIENCE Abstractly exploring and depicting the invisible impacts of altered mental health, MINDFIELD is an immersive experience focuses on how John, an army veteran, has his life altered by his post-traumatic stress disorder. The audience will delve inside his memories, transported to the core of the emotional rift he experienced during a more chaotic time of war. Will John be able to open up about his past to a loved one, freeing himself partially from the burden he bears? Or will he remain stuck in this loop of hopelessness? The person that can determine John's fate... is you! ADDRESSING POST-TRAUMATIC STRESS DISORDER The film's objective is to sensitize the viewer towards how PTSD can influence the experience of daily life, making them a witness of imagery depicting the character's inner state of turmoil, as well as exposing them to a painful memory of trauma. The film searches to evoke empathy, but also to provoke a questioning towards traumatic experiences, their impacts and the healing process.
row.short_description: Experience the powerful VR short film, Mindfield, delving deep into the world of PTSD. Immerse yourself in this thought-provoking journey and witness the invisible scars of war in a whole new way.

row.name: GroOove
row.detailed_description: GroOove is an asymmetric co-op game. Incarnate the two friends and try to cross various challenging rooms. While the first player finds a way to get their friend back, the second is stuck in the basement with various instruments to play and some to unlock. To be able to get out of it, there is only one way, the power of music ! Escape the Mansion Try escaping the Haunted Mansion without being caught by the ghosts Cross between 23 and 27 level, depending on the path you choose to take End the adventure with an epic final BOSS fight Play Together Play as a team Be careful where you walk Play in rhythm or risk losing your partner When you die the roles are reversed Multiple Instruments Unlock up to 5 different instruments With randomly generated music scores at each level Discover their unique sounds Understand what effects they have on the mansion
row.short_description: GroOove is a fun asyncronous music game, where two players help eachother to get out of a haunted mansion with the power of music !When you die the roles are reversed. Try to adventure through all the levels until the epic final BOSS fight !

row.name: Neon Marble Rust
row.detailed_description: Work of solo-developer Harry T, Neon Marble Rust is a Classic-style RTS that leans into the challenging aspects of beloved strategy games from the 90s. Build bases, manage resources, scout, strategize, tech-up, produce and control hordes of arena-bots. Play online or play a variety of single-player modes. - 3 Factions - What started as friendly competitions between engineers eventually grew into a massive spectator sport. Originally, it was just duels, one custom-built robot fighting against another one. The spectacle grew as teams of arena-bots were pitted against each other, and it grew further when the robots became able to replicate. Custom-designed robots were replaced with strict paradigms, and by the turn of the 22nd century society was controlled by 3 cultish Houses: Neon, Marble, and Rust. Emerged from the underground and established the first House. They were nearly ripped apart by a long-standing internal rivalry. Modern designs & ancient inspirations. To achieve success their commanders must be proactive and dynamic. Old machines from the forgotten age of consciousness. Their resourcefulness makes up for their inefficiencies. - Classic RTS - Base Building: Your bases will need resource drop-offs, army production, and static defense. Construct and defend additional expansions. Each faction has a different technology-tree and a fully unique roster. Manage Resources: Just mining resources isn't enough, you'll need specialized buildings to make advanced resources. Each faction has additional exotic resources, which define their technology-tree. Scout & Strategize: NMR is a Classic-RTS, which means your build-order is a big part of your strategy. Monitor your opponent so you can know when to expand, defend, or attack. Control hordes of Arena-Bots: Units are produced in batches, typically of size 3 to 5, so you can make big armies. Some Arena-Bots can teleport, some fire skill-shots, others can install computer-viruses on enemy Arena-Bots. - Dominate the Competition - These arena-bots don't battle to conquer territory, they're here to win in the arena. Matches are 20 minutes long, and are decided by a Score. Each player's central buildings are their Cores, these are where players make their worker units. Destroy an enemy Core to earn 1 point. - Variety of Game Modes - Online Multiplayer: Play Quick-Match or make a Custom Room and invite your friends. Matches are all 1v1, but you can watch as an observer. Skirmish/Sandbox: Play a match against the AI, can enable cheats. Practice: 6 different modes, each simplifies the game dramatically. Completing the challenges earns stars and unlocks other units. Replays: You can save replays of your matches in the basic game modes (online, sandbox, skirmish) Custom Maps: NYI
row.short_description: Build bases, manage resources, scout, strategize, tech-up, produce and control hordes of arena-bots. Neon, Marble, and Rust are the 3 factions, each has a unique economy and roster. Play online or choose from a variety of single-player modes. Classic-style RTS before a stadium crowd.

row.name: BARA Labs
row.detailed_description: BARA Labs is a short collection of experimental prototype games made by our team. We will decide whether or not to make a full-length game out of the shorts based on how the prototypes are received by the players. Prototypr - Spoiled Red Riding Hood Little Red was a boy who had a loving family, living with his father, mother, and grandmother. However, for some reason, his grandfather lived separately in the depths of the forest. Little Red Riding Hood had a strong bond with his grandfather, and he always wore the red hooded cape that his grandfather had given him. He often ventured alone to visit his grandfather, and he would often encounter a kind hunter. The hunter seemed to take care of his grandfather, and their relationship appeared to be quite good. Little Red Riding Hood also had a secret crush on the hunter. However, for some reason, his grandmother despised the hunter. On the day after Little Red Riding Hood turned 18, he and his family had spent a joyful birthday celebration at home. Wanting to share his happiness with his grandfather and hoping to see the hunter he secretly admired, Little Red Riding Hood carefully packed his birthday cake and embarked on his journey to visit his grandfather...
row.short_description: BARA Labs is a short collection of experimental prototype games made by our team. We will decide whether or not to make a full-length game out of the shorts based on how the prototypes are received by the players.

row.name: Starheim
row.detailed_description: Starheim is a free to play spaceship piloting looter shooter MMO with ship progression set in a universe based on Norse mythology in early access for PC and Android (Google Play). Combat: The game focuses heavily on ship to ship combat, allowing players to blow up NPC ships en mass and collect the loot they drop, or fight other players. The main idea is to simplify the spaceship piloting mechanic seen in other big space titles like Eve or Elite Dangerous by locking ships and bullets so everything is on a flat plane. Not having to deal with anything moving up and down makes it possible to control a very fast moving ship, dodge bullets, and warp around like not usually seen in MMO space games. A major decision was made early in development to not feature any kind of 'Heat seeking missile' type weapons, meaning you have to actually point your ship at a target to hit them. I've never really cared for the 'Locking on and firing a missile and waiting to see if it hits' type of space combat, even if it is more realistic. Boss fights are designed to be taken on by a party of at least 2 players, and party members share EXP, encouraging team play. Physics: Ships are all driven by real physics, meaning when you push the forward button, your ship gets pushed forward with realistic thrust, and momentum is maintained until you press back to activate the reverse thrusters to slow down. This can be challenging to get the hang of, but it does make for a more realistic spaceship pilioting experience, and opens up ways for players to play around with the physics. Slamming into another player will effect their movement or send them spinning off, instead of you ship just bouncing off. Asteroids are driven by real physics too, allowing you to shoot them to launch them at people or NPC enemies. All ships come equiped with a Tractor Beam, which creates a gravity well in front of the ship that attracts asteroids and NPC ships, allowing you to 'grab' an asteroid and carry it around with you and shoot it to launch it at someone on demand. Open PvP: While fun combat is always important, the primary goal with the game was to create a sandbox where players can interact with eachother. A lot of inspiration was taken from oldschool MMOs where you could just get on and mess around with random people in an open PvP enviroment, and the mechanics are as open as possible to allow players the freedom to play however they like. Most of the world is Open PvP, with the ability to set it to 'Peace' or 'PK' mode. Enforcer ships protect high traffic areas like upgrade centers, and will attack PKers on sight. Death isn't super punishing unless you haven't put stuff in the bank, so it's all in good fun. PKers (Player Killers) get 10 PKPoints when they kill another player, and getting 30+ PKPoints makes a player redname, where they can drop their equipped modules if they die, upping the stakes for attacking other players. Factions: The game has a Faction system that allows peoples to create or join a faction with other players. Later the faction system will be used for a faction vs faction PvP event, pitting the followers of dark gods like Loki against the gods of order like Thor. Making the strongest ship you can: Players can build ships of several different classes including: Fighters (Speed Focus) Destroyers (Damage Focus) Frigates (Survivability Focus) Artillery Cruisers (Heavy Weapon Focus, think big railgun) Dreadnought (Good damage and survivability but slower and a bigger target) Modules to add additional offensive or defensive capabilities can also be bought or looted and equipped to ships to increase their stats. Ships and Modules have an upgrade system similar to land-based MMORPGs, with stats that go up to Legendary, +9, 2 Sockets. Since it's based on Norse mythology, we had to make the objects that go into sockets Viking Runes. These runes grant various stat inceases or effects like boosting EXP gained. Elements: The game is heavily element based, each weapon being able to change between 8 different elements, changing the visual of the projectile and changing the type of damage it does. Nearly every ship has an element based energy shield that needs to be taken down before damage can be dealt to the ship's Hull HP. Hitting a shield with an element that counters it does 50% more damage, for example hitting an Ice shield with Fire element. Hitting a shield that counters the weapon deals reduced damage, for example hitting an Earth shield with a Lightning bullet. Countering NPC shields with an opposing element increases their drop rates by 50%. The game can be played with a Mouse and Keyboard, Touch Screen, and partially with a Controller (Mouse and Keyboard still needed to navigate the UI, Controller to control the ship). It runs well on Steam Deck even in the early access version, and has an input mode specifically tailored to Steam Deck, but some functionality may always require the touch screen such as dragging items from one inventory to another. Steam Deck is kind of the perfect type of device to play it on since it's the kind of casual experience Steam Deck was built for, so good Steam Deck compatibility is high priority.
row.short_description: Starheim is a free to play spaceship piloting MMO set in a universe based on Norse mythology. Materials collected by destroying AI ships, other players, and mining asteroids can be used to upgrade your ship, with dozens of models to choose from on your journey from a small fighter to a dreadnought.

row.name: Wurmus
row.detailed_description: Wurmus is a non-traditional snake-like which rewards creative movement, spatial awareness, and risk management. It's best experienced with a gamepad and headphones. A different breed of Snake Outrun, outsmart, and eat your opponents. Move backwards, strafe sideways, and turn freely. Collect power-ups which taunt, instill fear, and grant stability. Improve your high score Earn points for captures and longevity. Purposely lose encounters—and manage the ensuing chaos—to pad your highest score yet. An accessible experience Wurmus provides high visual contrast, binaural audio cues, and screen reader support. Its graphics can be toggled off to be enjoyed with audio alone.
row.short_description: Join a snake-like game of tag. Chase and dodge, collect power-ups, and manage chaos to become the longest worm on the playground.

row.name: Fishyphus
row.detailed_description: Fishyphus is a horror fishing roguelite which rewards careful navigation, quick reflexes, and persistence. It's best experienced with a gamepad and headphones. Sail the waves Take command of a fishing vessel with momentum-based physics controls. Sail endlessly in any direction across abstract, colorful, and relaxing ocean waves. Catch the fish Track fish by their mesmerizing songs. Drop anchor and fish with a single button. The reflex-based fishing minigame is easy to learn—yet hard to perfect. Battle the reaper Beware the certain death which lurks beneath! Catch fish to awaken it, stun it, and strengthen its resolve. Only through death will you survive longer. An accessible experience Fishyphus provides a tutorial, high visual contrast, binaural audio cues, haptic feedback, adjustable difficulty settings, and screen reader support. Its graphics can be toggled off to be enjoyed with audio alone.
row.short_description: Traverse an impressionistic sea, listening for predator and prey. Cast a lure and feel their cues to reel them in. The reaper slowly tracks your movements, who you must outmaneuver to survive.

row.name: Budget Backrooms
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Budget Backrooms , a free-to-play game set in the classic Backrooms creepy pasta, this time keeping it low-budget. You find yourself in a mysterious place, somehow you noclipped into the Backrooms, you get up, pick up your flashlight and start exploring the corners of the so-called 'Level 0' best known as 'The Lobby'. Levels The levels in this game have a unique and linear layout, you will find plenty of content to explore, easter-eggs and 'Sub-Levels'. Immersive Atmosphere Budget Backrooms tries its best to deliver a constant and immersive Backrooms experience throughout the gameplay, from sound effects to modest graphics quality. The game uses binaural audio so playing with headphones is strongly recommended. Entities There are currently 3 Entities in this game, but the ones that stand out are The Howler which will chase you if you get too close, and The Smiler killing you if you shine light in his area. Community Driven If you want to contribute to the game you can do so by joining the active Discord Server or by contributing to the source code on GitHub.
row.short_description: Free single-player Backrooms game developed on a low budget.

row.name: D.V. Ex Agent (Episode 1)
row.detailed_description: D.V. Ex Agent - is a short narrative game with horror elements. The plot of the game is intriguing, and the gameplay conveys a sense of gradual decomposition of the subconscious. The game also contains many jokes and references. 'Do you know what can ruin a person's life? There can be many reasons. One such reason was the events that happened to the main character.' Citizen Drankov was a respected man and worked in a secret government organization. He was trusted by the leadership, which ultimately played a cruel joke on him. You will have to go through the key moments of our hero's life. Waking up on the street near garbage cans, Drankov realizes that he remembers nothing and tries to figure out what happened. His tormented mind begins to play cruel tricks on him, and the skeletons in his closet decide to perform their sinister dance. Game Features: - Main genre: walking simulator. - Gameplay recreates the realities of a person suffering from delirium. - The feeling of being in a parallel world, or rather in the world inside the subconscious at the terminal stage of delirium. - Atmospheric sound and visual design creating a tense and mystical atmosphere. - Some puzzles will really make you 'rack your brains,' they are not easy. - A sad and dramatic plot filled with emotional content. - And what's a game without jump scares? Average playthrough time: 60 minutes .
row.short_description: 'D.V. Ex Agent' is a narrative game with elements of horror, telling the dramatic story of the main character. You will have to come face to face with skeletons in the closet along with him. The events unfold in the post-Soviet era.
row.notes: The game contains images of violent scenes, which may have a negative impact on the psyche. Please also be aware that the game contains hints of alcohol consumption and smoking. Some content elements may not be suitable for certain age categories. A reasonable limitation of the game's audience is recommended.

row.name: Love x Debut
row.detailed_description: Have you ever dreamed of being an idol manager? The time has come to embark on that journey! After a car accident, you suddenly find yourself isekai’d in the universe of a popular video game that you were playing. Here, you have to create your very own talent agency and find success in the exciting music industry. This epic isekai idol business simulator features spectacular music and a builder-style gameplay. Build your agency, guide the babes towards celebrity, complete quests and unlock exclusive rewards. Recruit the girls and make sure these sexy aspiring stars get everything they need on the path to popularity. The trainees are super talented and eager to become real idols, but they need you for that! You’ll not only be in charge of leading the company and managing careers but also of seducing the hotties. row.name: SERAPH : In the Darkness
row.detailed_description: Authentic Dark style, classic ARPG combat mode, allowing multiplayer to have a great time. Its features include a magnificent 'Hack & Slash' combat system, billions of rich equipment, combined with distinctive skills, which can be combined into ever-changing class builds (BUILD), enabling you to fully enjoy the refreshing grinding experience and reap the rewards of exciting drops. The minimalist operation mode, like lively musical notes, strikes up the prelude to combat; the precise combat commands, like sharp sword blades, point the way to victory; the powerful action performance, like brilliant fireworks, blooms with the splendor of combat. Together, they create an unparalleled sense of combat impact. The rich combat skills, like magnificent paintings, showcase the colorful combat styles; the diverse builds, like a brilliant starry sky, present numerous different visual feasts. The billions of pieces of equipment and distinctive skills can be cleverly combined to form countless class builds. You are the master of the N + 10086th way to defeat the bosses. Seamless switching, free and as you like, you can shoot from a distance, hack and slash up close, or go 'biubiubiu'~ The way to play is entirely up to you, do whatever you want! Free! Free! Free! It's important, so I'll say it three times! You read it right. All equipment, affixes, crafting materials, and attribute upgrades are based on loot drops and do not need to be obtained through payment. Build your own exclusive combat build. Rarer equipment and loot can only be obtained through continuous looting. You can also use the trading post to verify the value of the loot you've obtained. The original Diablo style, but not retro, enjoy high-definition graphics. 1）Endless Play The real fun of the game can only be officially experienced starting from level 60. The game operates on a seasonal basis, and each season will offer new fun, new goals, and new rewards. 2）Endless Challenge In the world of SERAPH, there are endless ways to become stronger. Players can verify their abilities by challenging such as the Void Otherworld, Chaos Dungeons, and Ladder Trials, and obtain various equipment, and personalize their combat abilities to the limit. 3）Endless Pursuit The pursuit of the types and affixes of various equipment and items is never-ending. Most importantly, one needs to find the items and the combination of affixes that match their own playing style and chosen class among countless item types and affixes to obtain diverse experiences and the fun of rewards. 4）Endless Surprise In the mysterious SERAPH world, players will constantly encounter various unexpected events and challenges during the exploration process, and upon completion, they will obtain unexpectedly powerful equipment or precious items.
row.short_description: SERAPH : In the Darkness is a classic dark fantasy. It's an action role-playing game (ARPG) with hack-and-slash combat mechanics, allowing for item customization tailored to your playstyle. Experience new thrills in the world of SERAPH, where aesthetics of darkness and fear combine

When your attack succeeds, you’ll fly forward and speed up. You can use attacks right after each other after successful hits, so find opportunities to keep chaining combos as much as you can! ○Race at all kinds of resorts from all over the world! From high-speed water slides and desert pyramids to exploring massive waterfalls in the jungle, or even up in the clouds—you are invited to take a 10-minute tour of up to four courses from a variety of options. Penguins are obsessed with these amazing and chaotic races! 🐧 GAME SYSTEM ◯Intuitive and exciting action Become a boost master by attacking opponents! Skid past your rivals via shortcuts! Hunt Sardine Cans and turn the tide with the Ultimate Ride! The race has begun! Get hyped in chaotic races filled with challenging rivals and obstacles! ◯Survive the party in this knockout action race! The top points earner is our winner—time to grab your win and maybe a mackerel on the way out! ◯You have a bit of time to spare. What will you do? I’ll be on vacation with friends! Play alone? Dive in with friends? Or huddle a big group for a party? In “Faaast Penguin,” you can enjoy any situation. Solo play, up to 4-player party play, and custom matches for up to 40 penguins. With cross-platform compatibility, anyone can splash their way in! 🐧 Abundant penguin customization Customize your outfits, Rides, Ultimate Rides, and emotes to stand out!
