Unleash attacks! Hop on ULTIMATE RIDES! Use shortcuts! Pass your rivals and reach the finish line first!

row.name: The Windows Are Gone
row.detailed_description: Haunted by grief and guilt after a tragic accident, you start seeing a house in your dreams. No matter what you do, you can't get its image out of your mind. You feel it calling for you, so you answer it. The Windows Are Gone is a short, psychological horror game made by Scary Cube. It focuses on creating an immersive and disturbing atmosphere through the manipulation of narrative and audiovisual elements. This game should take 40 minutes to 1 hour to complete. FEATURES - Psychological horror: Immerse yourself in an unsettling narrative that blurs the line between reality and the subconscious. - Retro Aesthetic: Nostalgic PS1/PS2 visuals with a mix of old and modern. - Atmospheric Gameplay: Experience an immersive atmosphere created through the manipulation of the audiovisual elements. - Moving in: Bring the boxes inside and decorate the house to your liking: it's your new home, afterall. - Exploration: Explore the scenary, find secrets and piece together the clues left by the previous owner of this mysterious house. - Multiple Endings: Choose the destiny of the protagonist.
row.short_description: Haunted by grief and guilt after a tragic accident, you start seeing a house in your dreams. No matter what you do, you can't get its image out of your mind. You feel it calling for you, so you answer it.

row.name: Explaining every string
row.detailed_description: This is a game I wanted to create when I was eight. This is a game many of you wanted to create when you was eight. No online, no services, no DLCs, no open-world, no rogulike, no roguelite, no depression metaphors, no metroidvania, no backtracking. Can't say 'no god' cause god participate in one of boss fights. Not on your side. It's just straight line from start to finish. And skill required to get through it. And timer if this is not enough. Party like 1989. This is fully functional and completed game created live, during streams. Viewers of youtube channel 'Explaining Every String' seen creation of this game from very first line. You can see it too (in Russian, unfortunately). Or read on github. First is was educational project but at some point it turned into something close to Andy Warhol movies. Alone man creating videogame while time passes. But I did it (almost, soft is never complete). 400+ streams and here we are. We're dealing with twin-stick shooter. These game features 15 levels in 5 'bioms' + 6 boss fights (god I love boss fights). There are 15 mini-bosses in 15 ordinary levels. You have some arsenal with golden classic like shotgun or rocket launcher and dash to correct your mistake or turn around your luck. Unfortunately, I'm not an artist at all so I gone full retro. Recreated vibes of overcoming 1983 crisis. Colors of NES, sounds of some ancient machine, music a-la 'Mozart meets NintendoCore' and simplistic graphic. Also it includes some simple cut-scenes with story. You can even try to figure out what it means. Special entertainment for whose who loves soulsbourne games. If you think you can do better do it. Code licensed under MIT. Assets under Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International. Fork it and perfect it if you dare.

Not on your side. It's just straight line from start to finish. And skill required to get through it. Party like 1989.

Embark on cute adventures under the starry sky, heal your soul, become a one-of-a-kind adventurer, journey with familiar companions into a new chapter, explore the beautiful starry world freely, and shape your destiny to create legends! 【Explore the Astral Realm, Forge Adventures】 Embark on a journey of free exploration in a vast fantasy world, uncover hidden treasures, immerse yourself in adventures and legends unknown, and join hands with your fellow adventurers as you head towards the horizons of the sky and the sea! 【Freedom to Change Class, Your Mastery at the Helm】 Switch between multiple Class at will, allowing your mood or tactical needs to change roles whenever necessary. row.name: Swords & Crystals Online
row.detailed_description: Current State & Development Swords & Crystals is currently in Beta Phase 1. This indie game has been in active development for over six years, with more than 7500 hours of work poured into it, entirely unpaid and driven purely by passion. Every dollar the game earns will be fully reinvested into development, including improved PvP , 5-player dungeons , a player-driven economy with trading and  marketplace system , more bosses / quests / items / zones  and full class/race/character customization . For exact details on planned features and expected release timelines, visit the official Swords & Crystals website . In this early beta stage, the game offers a substantial, stable, and fully playable experience : 200+ items & 100+ quests 10 skills to train & 1 major boss encounter Stable servers with a small but steadily growing community More updates, features, and content polls will continue to roll out as the world evolves. Easy & Accessible Gameplay Enjoy straightforward and simple game mechanics that are easy to pick up. There is no overwhelming user interface, complex calculations, or confusing numbers to figure out which items are best. The game provides very clear overviews of what can be achieved, what the goals are, where to find specific items, which enemies you’ll face, and their item drop rates. Quests follow a clear and consistent design. Objectives are short and easy to understand, without long dialogue or story monologues to skip. All quests use the same familiar system, rather than wildly different mechanics like in OSRS. Expect classic, WoW-style tasks such as slaying enemies, capturing towers, collecting items, reaching locations, or hunting rare drops. You always know exactly what to do. Crafting armor or brewing potions is made effortless, without complicated windows or pop-ups. Everything is designed to be clear, understandable, and accessible, making it enjoyable for players of all experience levels. If you’re looking for modern, highly polished gameplay with streamlined systems, this is not that kind of game. Instead, Swords & Crystals features less polished but high-quality old-school controls and mechanics , offering a classic, nostalgic experience with substance over flash Embark on a Grand Adventure Explore a sprawling 2D top-down MMORPG inspired by Old School RuneScape, Classic World of Warcraft, and Zelda. Swords & Crystals blends real-time action combat inspired by Hyper Light Drifter with challenging, skill-based boss battles reminiscent of Titan Souls and Warcraft. Venture through an enchanted medieval world full of secrets, danger, and discovery, where your journey is shaped by your skill, dedication, and achievements. This indie MMO sets itself apart with a seamless open world, unique art style, online multiplayer, deep RPG systems, and a massive interconnected map with no loading screens . Its 2D world uses detailed physics and animation to create the feel and depth of 3D. KEY FEATURES: Stunning Visuals Travel through lush forests, glowing deserts, enchanted lakes, and shadowy ravines. Dynamic lighting, day/night cycles, floating leaves, and reflective waters bring the world to life. Immersive Soundscapes Atmospheric music and ambient sound design elevate every moment, from calm exploration to intense battles. Interactive Multiplayer Team up, trade, compete, or simply explore with players from around the world. Some monsters and events require strategy and cooperation to overcome. Massive Open World A vast, seamless landscape with no loading screens—filled with secrets, hidden paths, puzzles, and mythical creatures waiting to be discovered. Leveling & Questing Grow stronger by defeating enemies and completing quests. Rise from a beginner to a legendary hero through consistent effort and mastery. Skill Mastery Train 10 distinct skills , including melee, mining, smithing, herbalism, and alchemy. Higher skill levels unlock better tools, stronger weapons, more valuable resources, and crucial advantages in dangerous areas. Collect & Upgrade Gear Explore ruins, caves, and dungeons to uncover rare loot. Earn gold, gather resources, defeat bosses for tokens, and upgrade your equipment through shops and rare drops. Epic Boss Battles Take on colossal bosses alone or with allies. Plan, strategize, equip the right gear, and earn rare treasures for your victories. Puzzles & Secrets Solve magical puzzles, reveal hidden chambers, and uncover secret routes woven throughout the world. Badges & Achievements Showcase your dedication through achievements earned by conquering challenges and discovering hidden locations. Also unlock rare items with can be unlocked by having certain amount of achievement points.  Leaderboards & Records Compete with other players for highest level or skills, top times in boss fights, PvP, and skill challenges. Break records, rise through the ranks, and earn prestige rewards. Constant Evolution Expect regular updates, expansions, events, and continuous improvements—delivered carefully and thoughtfully to ensure your progress, achievements, and items are never devalued. Unlike many modern games, updates are designed not to break or ruin existing systems , so your hard-earned accomplishments remain meaningful as the world grows.
row.short_description: A huge open-world old-school 2D top-down MMORPG packed with monsters, quests, puzzles, and challenging bosses. Explore vast lands, train skills, level up, team up, flaunt rare gear, climb leaderboards, and dive into a satisfying long-form grind. Now in Beta Phase 1 with major updates on the way

row.name: Wind Ryder

Meet the stunning and fearless huntress, Anabelle Wind , whose arrows never miss their mark! With her sharp aim and even sharper wit, she'll keep you entertained while taking down enemies! Fast, turn-based battle system. No grinding needed. Custom anime art. Breathtaking soundtrack. Attraction system to build bond with heroines. Quest journal to guide you. Together, this dynamic quartet will battle through treacherous dungeons, face hordes of monstrous foes, and unravel the secrets of the astral goddess! But be prepared for more than just saving the world! With hilarious banter, playful rivalries, and unexpected romances , this game is guaranteed to keep you laughing and swooning! As an indie studio passionate about creating something extraordinary, we're excited to build this game alongside our community. Your feedback and support will help us deliver the competitive soccer experience of your dreams. See you on the pitch!   Run Games
row.short_description: Football Heroes League is a high-octane multiplayer soccer game where superhuman abilities meet precise controls.

row.name: Color Collar
row.detailed_description: Easy to Pick Up and Play: Color Collar is a free and simple game playable for all ages. Lighthearted And Colorful: Enjoy a simple story unfold about a robot dog and his scientist. Multiple Worlds to Explore: Enjoy the many levels Color Collar has to offer. Challenge Yourself: Unlock rewards by beating levels with the perfect solution.
row.short_description: Color Collar is a free to play lighthearted puzzle game for all ages. Play as Aaron the robot dog and fix up the machines of John the scientist in order to open up the mysterious pandora’s lunchbox.

row.name: Harmonic Depths
row.detailed_description: Overview Embark on a relaxing journey in an underwater realm. Glide through captivating environments, embracing the tranquility of exploration and survival found in these Harmonic Depths. Play in Survival Mode, managing your health, which gradually decreases over time, and replenishing it by feasting on the abundant fish that surround you, or immerse yourself in Casual Mode, exploring the ocean at your own leisure. Controls To move up, press the W key, or use the up arrow key. To move down, use the S key, or the down arrow key. For left turns, press A or the left arrow key, and for right turns, use D or the right arrow key. Hold down Left Click to boost. You can pause the game anytime by pressing the Escape Key. Press the Enter Key to return to the main menu.
row.short_description: Embark on a relaxing journey in an underwater realm. Glide through captivating environments, embracing the tranquility of exploration and survival found in these Harmonic Depths.

row.name: Project N3T
row.detailed_description: You play as a test subject working for the company Quanti. You have been tasked with testing out a new device called the EMFR that functions as a very powerful magnet. Your mission is to complete a series of tests all designed around magnets. You'll be faced with platform challenges and other puzzles in this short single-player experience. Features: You'll be equipped with a very powerful magnet capable of pulling and pushing metal objects. With this, you can move large objects out of the way and pull giant metal balls into holes to progress. Your magnet also functions as a grappling hook, allowing you to pull yourself to high places or push yourself up in the air. As you progress through the tests, the Overseer will observe your performance and talk to you as you play. You'll get to know him, and hear the struggles he faces while working at the facility.
row.short_description: Take control of a test subject tasked with testing out a new device that functions as a powerful magnet. Complete a few tests by moving metal objects and using the magnet as a grappling hook in this short single-player experience.

row.name: Devil Seeds
row.detailed_description: Devil Seeds is a game that mixes horror and RPG. The story takes place on a ghost island, where the player must survive and uncover the mysteries of the place through battles, exploration and solving puzzles. On the journey, the protagonist duo will acquire new skills, meet scary (or friendly) creatures and discover more about that terrible place and even worse, about themselves. What to expect? - Survival Horror mechanics such as exploration, puzzle solving and file investigation. - RPG mechanics, such as turn-based battles, character progression, level and resource farming. — Rewarding exploration, where the player can interact and investigate almost everything around them. — Two funny protagonists — Rich and enigmatic plot. - 3 cute cats. (or not.) The game will be divided into chapters, which will be released as they are ready.
row.short_description: Explore a ghost island dominated by mystical creatures. This game offers an experience that mixes horror and RPG, allowing you to explore every dark corner, solving puzzles, finding files and meeting strange characters.

row.name: Taora : Beginning
row.detailed_description: Taora is an island that is infested with zombies and hold many places to explore and loot. You can build your base, craft and upgrade your gear, explore many unique places, loot materials or gears. You can upgrade your vehicle to suit your needs. Upgrade you characters` skills to fit different conditions like hacking electronics, reapiring broken things, healing the wounded or fighting with zombies. Looting: Loot materials needed for crafting, base building etc. Vehicles: There are many vehicles for you to use on Taora. Crafting: You can craft and upgrade your gears, vehicles, weapons, armors that make you a real survivor. Open World: You can hop on your vehicle and explore unique places on Taora. Survive: Shoot and kill as many zombies as you can to survive. Base Building: It is important to build your base to survive on Taora. You can store your loot and weapons on your base, build various tools or tables that help you to improve your weapons, vehicles and survivors. Skills: Skill up your character on different aspects, they can be a soldier to kill hordes of zombies, or a mechanic that can craft tools, disarm traps, unlock safes.
row.short_description: Taora : Beginning offers the limited introduction experience to Taora : Survival, an open world survival game with unique character building and crafting. Build and upgrade your base, and survive the zombie apocalypse!

row.name: Pirates Of Gensokyo
row.detailed_description: A fangame for Touhou Project by ZUN A short visual novel about 4 girls, one of whom will discover who they are. Marisa rounds up a most unlikely crew, in search of adventure, and of course, treasure! Interpersonal conflict ensues among the crew, but in the end, their stark differences bring clarity to their personal lives. The real treasure is the one you find within yourself! Featuring: Marisa, Sanae, Alice, and Satori. But there will be a few more extra characters we meet along the way! With 1 hidden character! A story that features comedy, drama, romance, and heartfelt expressions of fear, shame, self-doubt, and love. Every route starts with warmth and humor and ends with something deeper and more intimate.
row.short_description: Marisa rounds up a most unlikely crew, in search of adventure, and of course, treasure! Interpersonal conflict ensues among the crew, but in the end, their stark differences bring clarity to their personal lives. The real treasure is the one you find within yourself!

row.name: Signal
row.detailed_description: Game Summary: Signal is a third-person adventure game featuring nuclear post-apocalyptic, quantum entanglement and time travel. Filled with unknowns and dangers, the player takes on the role of a father searching for his daughter and explores the story of multiple worlds by traveling the path. Rise to the challenge of finding clues and unlocking puzzles for a chance to survive as you face extreme life and death decisions. Style description: fight various monsters in a fantasy worldview with modern guns. Gameplay: the game contains elements of collection, exploration, shooting, decryption, etc., in the open map to collect firearms and other resources to explore the mission points, and eliminate the monsters and other enemies on the way, in the communication with a variety of post-apocalyptic survivors continue to explore the truth.
row.short_description: Signal is a third-person adventure game full of unknowns and dangers, where the player takes on the role of a father searching for his daughter, facing extreme life and death decisions, the player must rise to the challenge of finding clues and solving puzzles in order to have a chance of survival.

row.name: Final Hour
row.detailed_description: Final Hour is a 2D adventure RPG in which the player explores a world that is moments away from being destroyed by an exploding star. In response to the impending tragedy, the player must make one last attempt to connect with their neighbors before their tragic death… if it ever comes. On this adventure the player will encounter • 21 unique characters to interact with • Different interactions based on progression in the story • Many items to collect to assist the player on their journey
row.short_description: In a world on its deathbed, explore and connect with your neighbors for one last day.

row.name: self-indulgence
row.detailed_description: “When you’re finally there for yourself… will you be able to shoulder it?” Self-Indulgence is a PSX-style psychological horror game that drags you deep into a decaying world where memories rot and truth is a shifting shadow. Guided only by fading memories and desperation, a father searches for his missing child—only to uncover something far more disturbing than he ever imagined. What begins as a rescue turns into a descent into the unknown. 🔸 Retro survival horror, reimagined – tank controls, fixed camera angles, gritty textures 🔸 A story-driven nightmare – every clue pulls you deeper 🔸 2 major free updates coming post-launch 🔸 No jumpscares. Just dread. If you loved the eerie silence of Silent Hill , the tension of Resident Evil , and the mystery of Lost , you’re going to feel right at home—and very, very uncomfortable. Are you ready to remember what you’ve tried to forget?
row.short_description: A PSX-style psychological horror game. Search for your missing child in a decaying world of memories and dread. No jumpscares. Just a slow descent into something far worse.
row.notes: There is a gun in the game, which character can shoot enemies. There is also blood.

row.name: Ride Hailing Simulator
row.detailed_description: Come and experience the feeling of a ride hailing driver, listening to orders, running orders, and charging new energy vehicles! Complete the task list, look at the speedometer, listen to music, and enjoy leisure time! If you are not very bored, please do not open the demo developed by Kuo Kuo when you are bored!
row.short_description: Come and experience the feeling of a ride hailing driver, listening to orders, running orders, and charging new energy vehicles! Complete the task list, look at the speedometer, listen to music, and enjoy leisure time!

row.name: Forgotten Symphony
row.detailed_description: Achtung: Dieses Spiel ist aktuell nur auf Deutsch verfügbar! Attention: This game is currently only available in German! Geschichte In der Zukunft hat man es sicherlich nicht einfach, oder? Der Klimawandel, Konzerne, welche die Politik des Landes lenken, totale Überwachung und dämliche Gesetze so weit das Auge blicken lässt. Also herzlich willkommen im Jahr 2234. Ellie versucht ein ganz normales und langweiliges Leben zu führen. Videospiele, Pizza futtern und wenn keiner hinschaut hier und da mal gegen das Gesetz verstoßen. Doch ihr stumpfes und monotones Leben ändert sich schlagartig, als sich ein ihr unbekannter Hacker unerlaubt Zutritt zu dem Computerchip in ihrem Hirn verschafft und anfängt ihren Körper zu übernehmen. Um das Drama noch perfekt zu machen, behauptet der Fremde auch noch aus dem Jahr 2244 zu stammen. Weitere Informationen gibt sein Gedächtnis aber leider nicht mehr her. Eine skurrile Geschichte über Freundschaft, Zusammenhalt, Verlust und Zukunftsängste. Gameplay ein wohl eher untypisches 'Visual Novel' mit ein wenig Bewegungsfreiheit kleine Minispiele und Rätsel als Kontrast zum Lesen der Geschichte Die wichtigste Sidequest seit Erfindung der Videospiele! Entscheidungen, die das Ende der Geschichte beeinflussen Features mehr eine interaktive Geschichte, als ein Spiel mit viel Gameplay ca. 4-5 Stunden Spielzeit abwechslungsreicher Soundtrack mit einzigartigen Liedern skurrile Mischung aus eigenartigen Ereignissen und einer beängstigenden Zukunft
row.short_description: In der Zukunft hat man es sicherlich nicht einfach, oder? Der Klimawandel, übermächtige Konzerne, totale Überwachung... Ellie versucht ein ganz normales Leben zu führen, als sich ein ihr unbekannter Hacker Zutritt zu ihrem Hirnchip verschafft und anfängt ihren Körper zu übernehmen.

row.name: Testimony of HELP
row.detailed_description: DISCOVER THE HEROIC SPIRIT OF THE ULMA FAMILY DURING THE CHAOS OF WAR AND EXPERIENCE THEIR EMOTIONAL JOURNEY Testimony of Help is an evocative short film in virtual reality (VR) that tells the story of the courageous actions of the Ulma family from Markowa, who selflessly aided Jews during World War II. The project immerses viewers in the atmosphere of the Podkarpackie region in the 1940s, meticulously recreated using archival photographs taken by Józef Ulma. Through the detailed portrayal of this historical context, users embark on an emotional virtual journey through time. The film is narrated by six-year-old Basia, the daughter of Wiktoria and Józef Ulma, who shares her family’s heroic experiences from her innocent childhood perspective. She reflects on life in the village and the changes that transpired after the arrival of new residents. This intimate narration deepens the viewer's understanding of the heart-wrenching events that unfolded in Markowa during World War II. Key Features: A story set in the 1940s, depicting the dramatic fate of the Ulm family as they risked their lives to help Jews during World War II. An interactive Virtual Reality short film that allows viewers to fully immerse themselves in historical events Meticulously recreated historical details based on archival photographs and documents that capture the essence of rural life in the Podkarpackie region at that time. An educational project aimed at fostering reflection on humanitarian values and historical awareness.
row.short_description: 'Testimony of Help' is an immersive short film in virtual reality (VR) that tells the heroic story of the Ulm family from Markowa - who provided aid to Jews during World War II. The project transports users to the realities of a village in the Podkarpackie region in the 1940s.
row.notes: One of the scenes depicts the murder of the Ulm family through artistic interpretation. We represent the death of the Ulm family symbolically by fading their characters on the screen. During the projection, the viewer may experience fear and unease created by the narrative and music, and there are also scenes with visible weapons.

row.name: PentaZorg
row.detailed_description: PentaZorg is an intense arcade bullet hell that is quite difficult to describe in a single sentence. Hit songs from Gunk The Janitor and THE RAT! 5 Unique visual aesthetics to play with the vibe you want! 300+ danger patterns! You are the grey square, red squares will kill you, black squares let you know where the danger will be, going over one side of the screen will bring you to the opposite side of the screen, pressing space will bring forth the next frame of danger, CHASE THE HIGHEST SCORE!
row.short_description: PentaZorg is an intense arcade bullet hell that is quite difficult to describe in a single sentence.

row.name: Stronghold Siege
row.detailed_description: Overview Command your army against a relentless demon horde in this intense real-time strategy game. Master strategy and resource management to conquer the enemy's stronghold while defending your own in the ultimate battle for survival. As you progress through the game, you'll unlock new troops, each with unique abilities and strengths. Refine your strategy by leveraging your troops' strengths to exploit your enemy's weaknesses. Experiment with different unit compositions and tactics to discover the most effective ways to conquer the enemy. As you adapt and evolve your strategy, you'll find new and exciting ways to outwit your foes and claim victory in the heat of battle. Game Modes Choose your path to victory by playing in Siege Mode or Blitz Mode. In Siege Mode, begin with basic troops and gradually unlock more powerful units as you survive waves of increasingly challenging enemies. Test your endurance and strategic prowess as you build your forces from the ground up. In Blitz Mode, start with all troops at your disposal and race against time to conquer the enemy castle as quickly as possible, making split-second decisions to outmaneuver your opponents. Whether you prefer to manage the battle from a commanding view above the battlefield or dive into the heart of the action in third-person mode, Stronghold Siege offers an immersive experience that puts you in full control of your army's destiny. Lead your forces, devise cunning strategies, and claim victory in a world where every decision could be the difference between triumph and defeat.
row.short_description: Command your army against a relentless demon horde in this intense real-time strategy game. Master strategy and resource management to conquer the enemy's stronghold while defending your own in the ultimate battle for survival.

row.name: Stagelands – eternal defense
row.detailed_description: Defend your kingdom and conquer the lands of your enemies! From the magical portals comes a horde of enemies. Orcs, undead, and brigands want to tear apart your kingdom piece by piece. You have several different biomes (floors) to defend simultaneously, hire fighters for defense, to build towers, turrets, traps and various modules for reliable protection. Use their abilities and skills, and create your own tactics to successfully push back the enemy's army. Gameplay: You can play offline anywhere in the world; Convenient and simple controls, easy to understand and start playing right off. Have fun and get stronger; Unite into clans to crush the enemy – interact with each other; Grow your kingdom and improve your defenses. Invent your own tactics, use different skills and abilities; Offense is the best defense. Seize enemy lands, replenishing your supplies. Variety: Hundreds of different waves, each one unique, making you feel like a new game with different mechanics; Different modes, capturing castles and other lands, defending caravans, raiding resource islands; Different types and classes of enemies. No time to be bored: everyone needs a different approach; A wide variety of worlds-biomes to defend. From winter mountains to warm seashores: each location is unique and exciting; Each level is a unique biome with its own strong abilities for defense; Mages, knights, archers, dragons, towers, defense towers, defense modules – collect them all! Fight back your enemies on all levels. Build an impregnable fortress.
row.short_description: Defend your lands from crowds of enemies! Create a unique multi-floor defense of your kingdom! Arrange your troops wisely, use ancient magic, repel the onslaught of the enemy!

row.name: Freestyle Ice Skater
row.detailed_description: The original idea behind the game was to resurrect our old ice rink that was closed in 2011 and is still missed by local people. Freestyle Ice Skater is a casual action/sports game that takes place in real and fictional locations. Your goal is to join the local freestyle ice skaters - Nagyerdei Korisok - master your tricks and beat the rival team in an epic freestyle battle. Key Features: -Single player story mode where you progress by learning new tricks (mapped to keypress combos) / or solving puzzles. -Free skate mode on the maps with a couple of extra elements. -Fish game mode (a kind of a tag game, optionally with powerups) -Achievements -Basic character skill / stat progression
row.short_description: Freestyle Ice Skater is a casual action/sports game. Your goal is to join the local group of freestyle ice skaters, master your tricks and beat the rival team in an epic freestyle battle at the old Nagyerdei ice rink. The old ice rink was a real life location until it was shut down permanently.

row.name: Foxhaven
row.detailed_description: Foxhaven is an online multiplayer game designed for 3 vs 1 3D action multi-player game. In this game, 4 players participate, with 1 player assuming the role of THE FOX. The objective is for the villagers to escape from the village without falling victim to THE FOX's schemes. To do so, they must find 6 keys scattered throughout the village. The central conflict revolves around the villagers' goal to identify who among them is THE FOX and to share this crucial information with their fellow players. Meanwhile, THE FOX aims to eliminate all the villagers before they can escape. Effective communication is pivotal for the villagers as they must swiftly discern the identity of THE FOX and disseminate this information to all players. Conversely, THE FOX endeavors to maintain a covert identity while discreetly eliminating villagers one by one. Can you escape from Foxhaven Village?
row.short_description: Foxhaven is a gripping 3 vs 1 3D action multiplayer game. Among the four villagers, one is an Impostor, THE FOX. To avoid getting killed, the villagers must find six keys and escape from the village!

row.name: No Recollection
row.detailed_description: About the story: You’ve awoken in a strange bedroom - a bedroom that is certainly not your own, located in a building you’ve never been inside of before. An equally strange building, with 10 different floors, all lacking windows of any kind. Upon further inspection, you come to the realization you are trapped in this mysterious building. You have no recollection of where this is or why you’re here. Actually, there seems to be a mysterious gap in your memory from the past few weeks. And so, a slew of questions flood your mind. “Where am I? Why am I here?” And most importantly: “how do I escape?” And you’re not alone here. Far from it. Meet a small but colorful cast of characters in your journey to answer the questions plaguing your mind. A unique group of people, whose thoughts seem to contradict your own. Interrogate them. Hang out with them. Explore this place with them. Uncover the truth with them. And most importantly, escape with them! About the gameplay: No Recollection is a full length visual novel that is completely free . Over 155,000 words within the game’s main story. Over 25,000 words of optional content (mostly consisting of alternate endings.) There are 6 different bad endings and 1 main ending. The game is mostly linear, focusing on one story; your choices can alter the order in which some events play out, and can occasionally result in a bad ending, but there is only one route. About the development: This game is a passion project I worked on for almost 3 years. It is the first novel I’ve ever written, as well as the first full game I’ve ever made. I also created the entire thing myself, so it may not be the epitome of quality. But even so, this game means a lot to me, regardless of how it turned out.
row.short_description: A mystery visual novel following a boy who awoke in a strange building, with no recollection of where he is, how he arrived, why he’s here, or how to leave. Discover the answers to these mysteries as you search for a way out. Meet a small but colorful cast in your journey, and escape together!
row.notes: Killing, blood, dead bodies, mild profanity/crude language, implication of sexual violence, one instance of a nude person (genitalia and nipples are covered)

row.name: PNGTuber Plus
row.detailed_description: Welcome to PNGTuber Plus! PNGTuber Plus is a piece of software that allows more customization for 2D png vtubers while maintaining simplicity and approachability for beginners. Features: Add any .png image that you'd like Allow sprites to move via sine waves Allow sprites to attach to other sprites Allow sprites to drag behind movement, both positionally and rotationally Allow sprites to bounce and jiggle! Set individual sprites to appear/disappear based on speaking/blinking Replace sprite images at any time Lightweight and easy to use Save avatars and share them with others More to come in the future! I'd recommend reading my tutorial to get started with using PNGTuber Plus.
row.short_description: A simple, artist friendly way to make pngtubers that are more fun and lively!

row.name: Kaizo Block
row.detailed_description: Kaizo Block is a precision 2D platformer with a retro pixel-art artstyle. It's tough, and only gets tougher, but it's also designed so that even inexperienced platforming gamers can pick it up. But for those true sadists and god-gamers among us, there is an even more brutal challenge in the form of time trials. Make use of momentum, jumps, air dashes, ground boosts, jump-orbs, and a multitude of movement techniques to overcome the game's 8 levels. Checkpoints are frequent, but hazards even more so. Spikes and giant saws will block your path, but if you are dexterous, you can weave through them in no time! Do you have what it takes to overcome the world of Kaizo Block?
row.short_description: A tough, 2D, pixel-art platformer. Overcome 8 progressively more difficult Kaizo-style levels, or try and see how fast you can finish an already completed level. On this journey, momentum, jumps, air dashes, and frequent checkpoints are your friends. The world is your enemy.

row.name: Quiz Game Night
row.detailed_description: Quiz Game Night is a multiplayer trivia game for up to 10 players. Download question packs from the workshop or create your own. Invite your friends for an evening of thought-provoking questions and friendly rivalry. Become the quizmaster and host your own Quiz Game Night – where friendship and clever questions combine for a memorable multiplayer experience like no other.
row.short_description: Quiz Game Night is a multiplayer trivia game for up to 10 players. Grab your friends, get any player-created pack from workshop and have a great game night!

row.name: Blood Kiss
row.detailed_description: [Story] 'You, there's something sweet... and delicious about your scent.' In a twist of fate far from an inheritance, 'you' find yourself burdened with sudden debt. Just when all seems lost, an opportunity arises that could turn your life around. The catch? You must survive a detention center where vampires that have lost all control are imprisoned... In the vampire's lair, will 'your' future be fraught with danger, or could there possibly be a chance for romance? [Character] The dangerously sexy head vampire of noble lineage, 'Dayn' The kind-hearted half-vampire who sees himself as a monster, 'Gray' The vampire with a complex about his origins, mysteriously adorable, 'Ruel' Dayn's right-hand man, a loyal vampire, 'Eden' - Embark on a genuine otome romance simulation game where 'your' choices determine the ending. - Dive into a female-oriented visual novel where your decisions unfold unique storylines with four men. - In BloodKiss, you are the protagonist. Craft your own love story. - With over 200 choices, explore each character's ending, special illustrations, and hidden finales. - Begin your perilous yet romantic dates with these four men today.
row.short_description: The job I barely managed to get is in a dungeon filled with vampires? What would you do, if you had to work together with dangerous and mysterious vampires who hate humans? Experience the secret romance in interactive otome game with these ikemen vampires, in Blood Kiss!
row.notes: The game contains fantasy representations of violence against humans. Sexual content may rarely feature revealing clothing. There are also references to sexual acts without any explicit depiction.

row.name: SpaceDRG
row.detailed_description: SpaceDRG is a high-octane, motion sickness inducing action game featuring cute pixel art graphics. Fight against the letters D, R & G in a space themed 1980s retro arcade environment. Compete with friends for the top spot on online leader boards, master the art of space navigation and collect power ups to even the odds. SpaceDRG features a unique psychedelic color system which is a feast for the eyes and senses. Become a Master of Self Control SpaceDRG features a revolutionary convention breaking keyboard layout that encourages players to regulate emotions, resist impulsivity, and stay focused on long-term goals. Self-awareness, discipline, and aligning choices with personal values are key to success in the game. Use Power Responsibly SpaceDRG encourages the responsible use of in-game power. Wield power responsibly to navigate challenges. Misuse can lead to negative consequences. Recognizing the responsibility that accompanies power is essential for fostering a harmonious balance between authority and accountability. Compete In Online Leader Boards SpaceDRG contributes to overall societal progress by encouraging competition via online leader boards. This method has been proven to motivate players to improve continuously by using their creativity, efficiency, and resilience, while also cultivating essential skills and work ethics.
row.short_description: SpaceDRG is a high-octane, motion sickness inducing action game featuring cute pixel art graphics. Fight against the letters D, R & G in a space themed 1980s retro arcade environment.

row.name: Rusty Ride
row.detailed_description: Embark on an exhilarating adventure as a rugged veteran in the driver's seat of a battle-worn vehicle that's seen better days, yet harbors a heart of steel. This isn't just any decrepit car — it's a roaring beast equipped with a formidable tank cannon and a high-powered jetpack, ready to defy both age and gravity. Journey through a procedurally generated world that unfurls new challenges and vistas with each play through. Unleash chaos as you obliterate obstacles in your path, transforming your once humble vehicle into a powerhouse of destruction with a plethora of upgrades awaiting to be discovered. Flex your strategic muscles as you decide whether to obliterate your enemies in a rain of cannon fire or soar to new heights to reach previously inaccessible areas. Since Unity is now fucked up, I decided to semi cancel this game. Now it will be completely free, so they don't make any money from it. But now the game will be only 1 level long. I might continue the project and 100% complete it if I don't have anything better to do with my life, but now I'll probably start a new game on UE5 or Godot
row.short_description: Take the wheel as a gritty veteran in a jetpack-equipped car with a tank cannon. Traverse dynamic, procedurally generated landscapes, obliterate obstacles, and unlock explosive upgrades. A thrilling, action-packed adventure awaits!

row.name: Ultimus
row.detailed_description: Introducing Ultimus: A Vision of First-Person Shooters, circa 1965. Step into a world where the past meets the future, where cool and unique graphics blend seamlessly with heart-pounding 1v1 duels in both single-player and multiplayer modes. Ultimus isn't just a game; it's the ultimate embodiment of competitive action in the world of first-person shooters. Get ready to experience the game that redefines the genre and propels you into a new era of gaming excitement.
row.short_description: Introducing Ultimus: A Vision of First-Person Shooters, circa 1965.

row.name: Project Adder (Prologue)
row.detailed_description: ABOUT Project Adder is a 2D, rogue-lite, zombie shooting, platformer sandbox. Adder challenges players to manage random weapons, ammo, and abilities while fighting through hordes of zombies on procedurally generated levels. The map resets once the player dies, bringing a new experience with randomized elements to each run. FEATURES Procedurally Generated Levels: Every death brings a new map and a novel set of challenges. Randomized Gameplay: Navigate through levels with randomized weapons, ammo, and abilities. Unyielding Zombie Hordes: Employ strategic thinking to survive against relentless zombie waves. Dive deeper into the gameplay with the developer console (toggle with the tilde key `).
row.short_description: Project Adder is a run-and-gun, zombie-killing, rogue-lite sandbox game with dynamic gameplay that offers a unique experience in every play-through.
row.notes: Cartoon depiction of zombie blood, gore, dismemberment

row.name: ColorCoordination
row.detailed_description: MEET COCO Meet your assigned AI companion, CoCo! This charming assistant is very curious and talkative . This AI partner will help you navigate the software but will also bring up several topics ranging from your experience with the puzzles to the value of life. As you progress, you'll also uncover a mystery surrounding CoCo and the company that created it. COORDINATE THE COLORS Match blocks and spaces of the same color by shifting entire rows or columns of them in unison! Careful though, as the blocks will respect the empty spaces in between! Even if one block in the group can't move, none of them will move ; they work as a whole! COLORBLINDNESS ACCESIBILITY On top of being color-coded, all blocks and spaces are marked by clearly distinguishable symbols! FEATURES Accesibility options for colorblindness! 50+ brain scratching puzzles! Fun interactions with CoCo! Philosophical reflection of AI and artificial life. Unravel a mystery and its hidden lore! Two unique endings! Optional post-game content! Challenging achievements!
row.short_description: ColorCoordination is a puzzle game where you match colored blocks and spaces by moving them in unison. Explore deep, philosophical topics with your AI Assistant 'CoCo' and discover more about its purpose - all while solving a myriad of colorful brainteasers!
row.notes: This game contains conversations about the value of life, death, philosophy and religion.

row.detailed_description: STORY Going down to get to heaven has never been easy. You are the Fallen, a believer in a higher power who only wanted to enter Paradise. But when you're sent to the depths of Hell, you can only do one thing: travel through the Nine Circles and state your case of innocence to Satan. Everyone has been kind to you so far. Too kind, maybe. Especially the Keeper of Heresy, the Sixth Circle. In the confines of his space while an ash storm rages outside, the two of you pry each other open. But he might break you first. FEATURES Loosely based on real world religions and Dante's Inferno , 10:16 is a story about possessiveness, melancholy, and unfamiliar ash. Over 8,000 words Lo-fi and grunge visuals, combining photography with hand-drawn illustrations 6 endings, all of which decide your fate in the Circle of Heresy Steam achievements Full voice acting in English, done by the lovely Zack Valence.
row.short_description: To get to heaven, you must climb the Nine Circles of Hell. But you might never make it to the depths.
row.notes: 10:16 contains themes of violence, possessiveness, and religious trauma. Please proceed at your own cost.

row.name: Armchair Commander
row.detailed_description: Relive history! This is the only game out there with an unlimited number of missions you can play — there are thousands of them, many created by committed players! Play or create your own missions in World War 2 and all the way through the Cold War. Learn to master the skill of the commander and conquer every enemy! Wargame & Turn-based Simulation From the Battle of Stalingrad to the Normandy landings, it’s got the vast majority of WW2 covered. Play as Germany, the Soviet Union, Republic of China, United States, Great Britain, or any of the 100+ countries with additional customization possible. Attack enemy strongholds and defend your cities with 20+ land, naval, and air units. Even the same unit has special functionalities differing by country! Campaigns & Conquests There are currently about 30 or so missions and conquest maps. The missions can be played through the story line, and the conquests (you get to choose your country) feature 1939-1950 Europe and 1937-1950 Asia. All the campaign maps can be downloaded and modified at your own will, as seen in the following section... Sandbox & Custom Maps Like I said, you can create your own maps; you can even upload them for the world to see! The map editor is readily available for use inside the base game. Every aspect of a mission is customizable: a country’s alliance, resources, cities, airports, troops, veterency, troop attack distance, winning conditions, and even which troops have generals can be customized. Simulated Politics From custom events to war declarations, this recent addition allows dynamic games of multiple alliances and betrayals; custom events can also be made to reflect historical events with different types of consequences (changes to resources, alliances, unit experience). Aid can also be given to allies like Lend Lease in the real WW2. Historical Generals Hundreds of generals — with more coming by each update — from various countries around the world. Generals are not tied to specific units; they can be sacked from a unit on the spot and be replaced at any time. Mobile Crossplay Yes, this is also a mobile game. But it's a lot nicer to edit maps on the PC client, and there are no advertisements or micro-transactions here — you will be given $5 worth of coins upfront. You can also crossplay with mobile users in the multiplayer system and paste your user progress from your mobile apps. About Me I’m an indie student developer, so this app is very flexible in terms of update content. Please feel free to contact me if you want to make suggestions or collaborate to make the game better. Game Engine: Unity (C# + Python)
row.short_description: A turn-based strategy game where you can experience WWII campaigns and explore alternate history scenarios made by the community.

row.name: Oh Baby Kart
row.detailed_description: WISHLIST NOW! About the Game Oh Baby! It's time for racing! Welcome to OH BABY! KART , racing like you have never seen before! Innovative drift boost and ultimate abilities! Select your driver, customize your kart and get ready to race! Drifting Ultimate Abilities Drifting gives you powers, ULTIMATE powers! Speed boost? Rockets? Freezing bams and booms? Pick your style and play! Collect them all? Collect them all! Whales, Butters and fast cars! There's karts for everyone! Decorate them with ornaments to show off your achievements or plain 'whaat?', we got chopsticks, umbrellas or even pets for those long rides! The possibilities are endless! INTENSE MULTIPLAYER ACTION Go against competitors all over the world! Party up or go solo and get that position on the global leaderboards! More into fun play? Setup a custom lobby with your friends! You can show your mastery of the tracks or how you use your ultimates everywhere! CHALLENGE MODE We got more! Go on the adventure maps! A fusion of skill-based trials, daring obstacle courses and unique competitive scenarios you can put your skills to the test! Oh Baby!
row.short_description: Kart Racing. Ultimate abilities. Over 100+ Karts. 100+ Challenges. Unique racing modes including Race Royale and Grand Prix Duo.

row.name: Dynasty
row.detailed_description: Your king father is dead, and you are now alone. A day ago he stood strong and proud. The royal advisors found cause and means to open your king father's chest to voice their dissent against his rule. 'Trust no one,' were his dying words. You do not know why they killed him, or how they killed him, but there is no denying that they succeeded. The mandate of heaven falls to you. You must prolong the Dynasty . Dynasty is a social deduction roguelike in which you must rule your kingdom through your advisors, who you are unsure whether you can trust. Your advisors hold the keys to power. You must please them enough to keep them loyal and grant them the power to administrate your kingdom. But beware-- the more power you grant them, the more they may use that power against you. You must survive 30 turns without being assassinated. If you have not been assassinated by your advisors by turn 30, you win. Features: Play a social deduction roguelike in which you must avoid assassination by your advisors as you administer your kingdom. 200 programs 30 turns 15 abilities 6 advisors 1 monarch There are six primary advisors: Seneschal Belmin : The majordomo of your palace. Through him you can curry the loyalty of your other advisors. He can help you expand your palace and staff, and with enough power can learn the true loyalty of your other advisors. Captain Niri : The Captain of your Crownguard. She will help you discover and foil assassination plots. If you suspect another advisor of plotting against you, you can have her arrest them, to be replaced by another hopefully more loyal second. Treasurer Chaddik : Of the Royal Treasury. He safeguards your income and manages your coffers and expenses. Through him you can purchase the loyalty of other advisors. Magistrate Elenda : Of the Ministry of the Commons. She represents the will of your subjects. Without her resourceful solutions to the problems your kingdom faces, there would surely be unrest and revolts. Unitary Alesanvi : The highest religious officiant. The piety of other advisors only offers her more power, though she tells you that her power comes only from the heavens. General Higan : The commander of the Royal Army. Through his military might you can command fear and obedience. Beware that you do not turn your kingdom into a military dictatorship.
row.short_description: Dynasty is a singleplayer social deduction roguelike in which you must rule your kingdom through your untrustworthy advisors. Earn your advisors loyalty and grant them the power to administrate, but beware: the more power you grant them, the more they may use that power against you.

row.name: EarthKart: Google Maps Driving Simulator
row.detailed_description: You can Drive on Google Maps! Discover the thrill of racing through the world's most iconic locations right from your device! EarthKart is a real world driving simulator that combines the speed and excitement of kart racing with the revolutionary integration of Google Maps. Experience the ultimate Google Earth driving simulator as you traverse through the urban jungles of New York, glide along the Great Wall of China, or speed through the winding alleys of Marrakech. The entire Earth is your racetrack in this drive on Google Maps Driving Game!
row.short_description: 3D Google Earth Driving Simulator

row.name: Cube Battlefield: 2048
row.detailed_description: Cube Battlefield: 2048 is a rogue-like top-down shooting game with infinitely generated levels. In this game, you will shoot down your enemies with various bullets, also leveling up your troop from a single cube to an army of cubes with different abilities. With the coins you collect from the battlefield, you can strengthen your cube abilities and thus beat more levels. Unleash the Power of Cubes 8 different cubes with various abilities are waiting for you to unlock! Cube 8 can use a rifle gun, Cube 16 can freeze enemies, and what Cube 64 can do will impress you. You can control all these cubes simply by point-and-click, and they will destroy the cube enemies into pieces! Leveling up Your Army Only a single tiny cube in the beginning? No worries! You can expand your armed forces by collecting coins from beating your enemies. The more coins you collect, the more cubes you will have! All these cubes will align nicely together waiting for your command to initiate their attack! Enemies are also Cubes Most of the cube enemies can be broken down into smaller cubes! Each of them owns a special ability. Some cubes can slow you down, and some cubes can shoot poisonous bubbles. Would you be able to eliminate all of them and survive? Infinite Levels All the levels are generated on the fly, and you have infinite levels to beat! However, you will always start from Room 1 after you lose all your cubes. How far can you reach? Let's test it out! Upgrading Cubes with Coins A plethora of cube abilities are upgradable! Use coins to boost your cube to a higher level! How about making the rifle shoot 15 bullets at a time? Or shooting a bullet that can reach the furthest enemy? You can only get more powerful each time you are reborn.
row.short_description: A rogue-like top-down shooting game with infinitely generated levels. Grow a army of cubes with different abilities to break down enemies into smaller units. Make your cube army more powerful each time you are reborn.

row.name: Zarie: The Story of Sin
row.detailed_description: A story of sin and 'the girl'. You find yourself in a world of monochrome, alone, until you meet Zarie, a girl with white hair, red eyes, and black clothes. She tells you she is a deity of death, this is Hell, and that you are a sinner. Guided by Zaire, you travel to meet Emma, Hell's Judgement, to be tried. What awaits you at the end of this short, yet arduous journey? Features ・A short visual novel with minimal text, backgrounds, and CG. ・Dynamic story choices change how Zarie answers. ・Enjoy the story's four CGs in 'CG Mode'. ・Supports both Japanese and English playback.
row.short_description: What kind of conversation will you have with the Shinigami girl? How will you conclude your story? The choice is yours in this tale of sin and 'the girl'.
row.notes: This game contains mild, text-based sexual references as well as descriptions of violence.

row.name: Reapers
row.detailed_description: Reapers is an online trading card game set in a dystopian future. Collect cards and packs, build custom decks, and win games against other players. All current season cards are shared so you can jump right into the action. Get rewarded for winning games and grow your own private collection. Currently in the Beta Season, cards and packs are limited, so gather them now, boost their visuals for added value and trade them later! I originally wanted to create a table top card game for my kids, but figured out it would be easier to make a computer sandbox. The project eventually turned into a fully online game, packed with features and interesting mechanics. The first release of the game with 300+ Alpha Season cards came out in January 2022. The Beta Season cards were released in September 2022. Looking forward to create the Third Season cards with the help of the community! Looking forward to challenge you on the battlefield!
row.short_description: An online battle trading card game set in a dystopian universe, focused on deck building, resource management and trading.

row.name: Please, Touch The Artwork 2
row.detailed_description: Disclaimer: This is a short game made in 6 months . It's 100% FREE  (no ads, no IAP), made by a solo dev in honour of James Ensor’s 75 year remembrance. Touch the artwork and help a lost skeleton artist find its way home in a surreal, hand-painted universe. Collect hidden objects for its quirky inhabitants, solve casual puzzles, and restore cracks in the fabric of the paintings. This slow paced relaxing adventure was carefully crafted from works by James Ensor, a Belgian pioneer in the world of Modern Art. Features: Hidden object adventure 5 unique worlds Hints when stuck Casual point & click gameplay Zoom-in for extra details Real hand-painted art Atmospheric relaxing sound Silly and quirky Slow-paced & relaxing Fit for ages 12-99 The game was created with the support of the Flemish Government on the occasion of the Belgian EU Presidency 2024.
row.short_description: A handpainted cozy hidden object adventure. Explore a surreal world. Collect items for its quirky inhabitants. Fix damaged paintings and solve casual puzzles. Help a lost skeleton painter find his way home. This game is short but 100% FREE (no ads, no IAP).
row.reviews: “A master-piece in itself” 5/5 – Het Nieuwsblad “It’s gorgeous. It’s trippy. It’s free” Gaming-Age “This exploration of a surrealist painter’s works is a small piece of art in its own right” The Gamer
row.notes: Insinuated consumption of alcohol and alcohol abuse. Portraying of skeletons and characters with masks.

row.name: Mortgage nightmares
row.detailed_description: A slice-of-life visual novel with an unusual plot. Befriend your new neighbors and try to get along with them! Lena is an ordinary freelance designer who finally decides to move out of her parents' house into a mortgage-bought apartment. However, as soon as she crosses the threshold, strange things start happening – mysterious reflections in the mirror, groceries ending up in the trash... It seems there's more to it than meets the eye. But what exactly is happening? You'll need to figure it out quickly before you run out of money for replacing all the broken light bulbs... Series format - each episode can be played in chronological order or individually; Interactive elements - interact with objects and move around the apartment; Real-life helper - the journal helps you deal with adult life challenges like paying utilities, obtaining necessary documents, and other grown-up problems; Numerous plot illustrations for every amusing (and not so amusing) situation; Russian amateur voice acting by people passionate about the project; And, of course, jokes about the mortgage!
row.short_description: Your very own apartment, even if it's a 20-year mortgage – what could be better? Maybe the fact that Lena isn’t the only one living in this apartment? Or maybe they're not exactly people...

row.name: Vanity
row.detailed_description: Created by a single developer passionate about video games. Vanity is a fast-paced third-person shooter (TPS) multiplayer game that throws you into intense battles where every move matters. Whether you enjoy PvP player showdowns or prefer teaming up against waves of enemies in PvE, Vanity delivers a dynamic and varied gameplay experience. With more than 10 unique maps and 9 game modes, there’s always a new challenge waiting for you whether you play solo or with a team. Key Features: PvP & PvE Modes : Battle other players in intense fights or team up to take down waves of enemies in PvE. Over 10 Maps : Explore diverse environments where each map requires different strategies. 9 Game Modes : Whether you love team matches, deathmatch, objective capture, or more original modes, Vanity has something for you. Diverse Arsenal : Wield an arsenal of over 10 different weapons. Grenades & Abilities : Gain the upper hand with multiple grenade types and unique abilities. Powerful Ultimates : Unleash spectacular ultimate abilities to turn the tide of battle. Challenges & Free Rewards : Complete challenges to unlock free rewards and enhance your gaming experience. Free Rewards : Earn free rewards simply by playing! These are frequently updated, giving you fresh items and surprises regularly. In Vanity , every victory brings you one step closer to glory. Show your strategy, agility, and speed to outplay your opponents! 📺 YouTube: TheLittleGames 💬 Discord: TheLittleGames
row.short_description: Created by a single developer with a passion for video games, Vanity immerses you in a world of frenetic action, whether in PvP or PvE, with over 10 maps, 9 game modes, over 10 weapons, abilities and ultimates. powerful.

row.name: Special Forces War - Zombie Attack
row.detailed_description: There are many scenes with zombies everywhere. Constantly challenge, accumulate experience and improve shooting accuracy; Need to shoot and kill various zombies in dangerous battlefields; Unlock levels of different difficulty to challenge, so that the battle will be more exciting. Exciting game levels, constant challenges, exciting adventures, and more rewards. There are many soldiers with different combat skills. Cleverly combined, the team will be stronger. There are many kinds of zombies. They will attack in groups. You can't let zombies break through your defenses. You must use flexible strategies to build your own defenses during combat. The classic tower defense combat mode in the game makes the game more interesting.
row.short_description: 'Special Forces War - Zombie Attack' is a very fun and interesting casual strategy tower defense game. In the game, you can control your own soldiers to start a battle with zombies. The game content is rich and exciting, full of fun, and can bring a relaxing and enjoyable game experience.

row.name: SAMUZA
row.detailed_description: Welcome to the world of SAMUZA! In this time attack obstacle course game, you play as one of the 'SAMUZA' series of robots who tries to restore the lost world by finding it's allies. Story The year is 299X. Humanity has perished, and the world is ruled by a runaway artificial intelligence. Foreseeing the end, the last Engineer made 9 keys, each with a piece of code, to be used when all else failed to restore the world to it's prevous state. You are Humanity's last hope, the robot series 'Samuza-L800'. You must find the 9 special robots scattered around the world and collect their keys. The ruling AI will surely interfere. You must overcome it's traps, collect the keys and use their combined code to reset the world. I wish you luck! Gameplay Compete in several game modes with different levels from the game's story and the community. Each level has a track you must complete while avoiding a series of obstacles. Story Mode The game's story campaign. Complete a series of premade levels and unlock new blocks to use in your creations. Endless Mode Complete random community made levels. Be careful not to fall off the course, as you will lose one life each time you reset. See how far you can go! Search Mode Use this to find community made levels. Use a code to find specific levels or follow other creators to easilly find their levels. 2P Versus Mode Play with your friends in split screen local multiplayer. You will get random levels from the community. In this mode there are no lives, have fun with your friends any way you want to. 2P Search Mode Play any specific level with a friend in split screen local multiplayer. Here you can search and play community made levels. You can play against your friends on the levels you created! Prepare a difficult course and compete against your friends! Creator Mode Make your own content! You can create your own original levels in the Creator Mode! Here you can choose from a collection of blocks and combine them to make your unique levels. Unlock new blocks by playing the Story Campaign and Endless Modes! Build at your pace Take your time in the creator mode. Test your progress at any time inside the Creator. Save your progress locally or to your account. Once complete, you can upload your levels and share them with your friends and the community! Let everyone around the world play in your original levels!
row.short_description: Welcome to the world of SAMUZA! In this time attack obstacle course game, you play as one of the 'SAMUZA' series of robots who tries to restore the lost world by finding it's allies.

row.name: Protoplanet Express
row.detailed_description: Embark on an exciting journey to explore distant star systems and witness the captivating process of planet formation in this immersive video game. You'll have the opportunity to delve into real protoplanetary systems, all meticulously recreated through simulations by professional astronomers. Climb aboard the Protoplanet Express, your reliable spacecraft for this adventure, and navigate through the vastness of space. Discover a multitude of viewpoints within these simulations, each offering a fresh perspective on every system. As you progress, you'll encounter different astronomers who will share insights into what makes each system truly unique. In some systems, you'll not only find stars but also planets and multiple stars. These celestial bodies wield gravitational forces like cosmic artists, sculpting dust and gas into mesmerizing features such as spirals, rings, and gaps – all ready for you to explore in these celestial realms. Each system you explore is painstakingly crafted, with hundreds of thousands of particles arranged precisely to match astrophysical simulations. This ensures that you won't miss a single visual detail throughout your cosmic odyssey.
row.short_description: Embark on an exciting journey to explore distant star systems and witness the fascinating process of planet formation. In this immersive video game, you'll have the chance to learn about real protoplanetary systems based on simulations crafted by professional astronomers.

row.name: Etelä-Pohjanmaa Experience
row.detailed_description: Etelä-Pohjanmaa Experience (South Ostrobothnia Experience) takes you directly to the heart of South Ostrobothnia. Jump in to immersive 3D environments that you navigate with the turn of your head. Experience 360 videos of various nature sites and events in carefully modeled environments through South Ostrobothnia. This experience offers you the opportunity to get to know South Ostrobothnia at your own leisure, whenever you want with a VR-headset. The application has been implemented as part of Seinäjoki University of Applied Sciences' 'XR technologies as part of the traveler's customer journey' project. The project is financed from the appropriations of the REACT-EU instrument, as part of the measures taken by the European Union in response to the COVID-19 pandemic.
row.short_description: Explore South Ostrobothnia at your own leisure with the help of virtual reality - experience 360 videos and carefully modeled environments that take you straight to the heart of the region.

row.name: Elemental Mage Defense
row.detailed_description: Master three potent spells: Earth , Fire , and Water . Engage in strategic battles against invading monsters of opposing elemental types: Fire, Earth, and Water. Earth Spell (Geomancy): Unleash the earthen energies to counter the relentless waves of WaterMonsters , turning their tides into mere puddles. Fire Spell (Pyromancy): Call upon the fiery heavens to scorch the advancing EarthMonsters , turning their solid resolve into ashes. Water Spell (Hydromancy): Conjure torrents of water to douse the flaming assault of the FireMonsters , quelling their fiery onslaught with a splash of reality. Evolve your strategies, and rotate your spells to defend your station and in turn survive. Elemental Mage Defense beckons you to immerse yourself in a vibrant and dynamic world brimming with elemental magic and untold perils. In this groundbreaking shoot 'em up adventure, you take on the role of a valiant mage caught amidst an unforeseen invasion that threatens to engulf your homeland. With the weight of your kingdom on your shoulders, you embark on a legendary journey, from defending tranquil villages to safeguarding the mighty fortress that stands as the last beacon of hope against the advancing dark forces. In this journey of magic and heroism, strategy meets action at every turn. Harness the powers of Earth, Fire, and Water to protect your realm from the elemental beasts hell-bent on chaos and destruction. With a dynamic rock-paper-scissors battle system, every encounter calls for strategic planning and quick reflexes. An Engrossing Journey: Start in the scenic plains, defending peaceful villages from the impending doom. Work your way back to your castle, the heart of your kingdom, preparing for a grand showdown. Experience a rich narrative filled with twists and monumental battles. Visually Stunning Environments: Traverse through a vivid world crafted with breathtaking detail. From idyllic villages to grandiose castles, each setting offers a unique backdrop for battle. Bonus Game Modes: Dimensional Shift : Switch gears with a 3D FPS shooter mode, adding a fresh perspective to your adventure. Dodgeball : Take a break from battle with a high-speed asteroid dodging game, testing your agility and precision. Wall of Death : Face wave after wave of enemies in an ultimate test of endurance and might. Danger Room : load up an endless environment tracking Time Survived, Monsters Killed, and Score. A World Ever-Growing Dive into a continuously evolving landscape, teeming with potential and opportunities for further exploration and challenges. As we steer Elemental Mage Defense into the future, anticipate periodic expansions and add-ons that promise to enrich the lore, introduce new terrains and adversaries, and expand the gameplay dynamics. Your adventure is bound to grow, offering fresh narratives and challenges, marking an unending journey in a world that grows with the community's passion and enthusiasm. Elemental Mage Defense is more than a game; it's an expedition into a world where your wits are your greatest weapon, and your courage is tested at every corner. Prepare to immerse yourself in a tale where every decision carves your legacy. Prepare to embrace your destiny as the elemental mage in Elemental Mage Defense, where adventure beckons the brave. Add to your wishlist now, and be the first to step into a world where magic is your mightiest ally.
row.short_description: Step into 'Elemental Mage Defense', a dynamic realm where magic meets valiant heroism. As a mage, you'll defend your homeland through strategic battles, unfolding narratives, and thrilling expansions. Every choice carves your legacy.

row.name: schoolLife 东洋中学之异闻录

Playing this game, you will experience Guo Zhiyuan's helplessness in doing all kinds of bizarre behaviors, the last roar of a depressed patient, the player interacts with objects or people by walking around, thereby promoting the development of the plot, this game can be said to be a galgame without love elements, or it can be said that a junior high school student recalls his school life boring work. row.name: 별을 좇는 까마귀(To The Star)

Be a crow and break the code in the witch's hut and escape! How to play the game: This game is a cryptographic escape room game! If you write down the wrong password, the cat will be warned, which is allowed up to 3 times!

developers: Lee Jimin, Na Dan, Lee Uihwan, Rhee Inyoung

row.name: Krashimals
row.detailed_description: Krashimals is a fast-paced, chaotic racing game where you and your friends crash, dash, and boost your way to victory! Pick your favorite wacky animal driver, customize your look, and speed through vibrant tracks filled with boost pads, tricky shortcuts, and hidden secrets. Welcome to Krashimals! Now featuring customization , you can personalize your Krashimal with unique hats, characters, and vehicles ! Want to race as a wizard-hat-wearing frog on a flying carpet ? Or maybe a snail rocking a Spartan helmet in a bathtub ? The choice is yours! With fun options like a traffic cone , cardboard box , and even a shopping 'kart' , there’s no shortage of ways to express your style. Use powerful abilities to outmaneuver your rivals—zip past them with a speed boost, send them flying with a well-timed impact, or find secret paths that give you the ultimate edge. Every race is unpredictable, with creative map designs that reward skill, exploration, and a little bit of mayhem. Features: 🚀 Fast & Fun Racing – Use boost pads, abilities, and clever shortcuts to speed past your competition. 🏁 Exciting Tracks – Race across colorful, unique maps filled with surprises and hidden areas. 🐾 Crazy Animal Drivers – Play as a cat, snail, elephant, frog, or duck ! 🎩 Customize Your Look – Choose from hats like a Spartan helmet, wizard hat, or traffic cone . 🚗 Wild Vehicles – Ride in a carpet, bathtub, shopping 'kart', or cardboard box ! ⚡ Abilities & Power-ups – Master 8 different abilities to gain the upper hand. 🎉 Multiplayer Madness – Compete against friends for the ultimate racing glory! Get ready to crash, customize, and compete in Krashimals ! 🚀 Developer Note: I'm a solo developer , and I’ve put Krashimals into Early Access because I want to keep improving the game with your help! I’m actively working on new features, polish, and content, and your feedback is incredibly important in shaping the future of Krashimals . Whether it’s ideas for new maps, customization options, or gameplay tweaks, I’d love to hear from you as the game continues to evolve!
row.short_description: Krashimals is a fast-paced multiplayer kart racing game where up to 4 players race through wacky tracks like Mushy Mountains and Gnome Garden. Collect coins, animal-powered abilities, customize your racer with hats, karts, and wheels, and race to victory in chaotic, fun-filled challenges!

row.name: Underground Waifus TCG
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Underground Waifus: Dive into the Future of TCG multiplayer with PVP Battles. Play for free this CCG and battler card game and compete, achieve quests and earn free rewards! The universe of Underground Waifus takes place in the future, corrupted by the scarcity of materials, money: stardust, and the desire for power. An eternal war between different races and more than 9 factions. The gameplay merges several themes: cyberpunk and manga, anime waifus cards based in a post-apocalyptic future. Underground Waifus is more than just a TCG, CCG, or JJC. It's the dawn of a new era of TCG gaming. That JJC trading card game is focused on a competitive side, with an easy PVP (player vs player) battles game with no barriers to entry and hybrid F2P for all players! FEATURES of an awesome CCG game based on a TCG game: TCG and CCG Fusion: Enjoy the flavor of the card battles both Trading Card Games and Collectible Card Games with an awesome deck builder. Deck building Dynamics: Conquer all factions, strategy and deck builder here is that fun but with cards! Join us in crafting a tale of strategy, card battles, trading and prosperity in the ever expanding cosmos of Underground Waifus TCG (Trading Card Game). 2023 and 2024 Underground Waifus TCG it is a trademark or registered Jurval Corp (Warlands Corp and Nexxyo company)
row.short_description: Underground Waifus it's a CCG, Deck Builder TCG with PVP Card Battler F2P Game

row.name: Shell's Kitchen
