row.name: AGO BRISTOL 1775: From Warship to Prison Hulk
row.detailed_description: Key Features - Learn from curators and conservators from around the world - Experience life aboard a prison hulk during the Napoleonic Wars - Choose between a guided tour and free roaming on your own - Experience state-of-the-art VR environments powered by Unreal Engine 5's Nanite and Lumen technologies. - Explore our models, captured via Computed Tomography and Photogrammetry, rendered in hundreds of millions of polygons with 20k textures. - Navigate using a VR headset preferably, confirmed users can switch to 2D mode with a mouse and keyboard. - Best enjoyed in VR on a high-end PC for optimal performance. - Choose between exploring solo or in a group of up to 6 attendees. - Free to download on Steam for Windows 10 and beyond Technology and Museums This VR experience is possible because of the following critical technological aspects: Scanning Technology - Photogrammetry is a technology that converts multiple high-resolution photographs into highly detailed 3D models. By capturing images of a subject from various angles and then analyzing them with specialized software, photogrammetry constructs a mesh of polygons that closely mimics the object's surface. The original textures are then mapped onto this 3D mesh, delivering a digital model that boasts an unparalleled level of detail and realism. - Computed Tomography (CT) scans offer another avenue for creating detailed 3D models, particularly useful for intricate objects like ship models. Unlike traditional X-rays that provide a 2D view, a CT scan rotates around the object, capturing multiple images from different angles. These images are then processed by software to create cross-sectional slices of the object, which are stacked to form a comprehensive 3D model. The result is an incredibly accurate representation, capturing even the inner complexities that are often missed by other scanning methods. Unreal Engine 5 Technology - Nanite is Unreal Engine 5's virtualized geometry system which uses a new internal mesh format and rendering technology to render pixel scale detail and high object counts. It intelligently does work on only the detail that can be perceived and no more. It offers multiple orders of magnitude increase in geometry complexity, higher triangle, and object counts than have been possible before in real-time The Photogrammetry and CT Scan museum assets used in this experience were imported without loss of quality, at the staggering resolutions of 50 to 90 million polygon assets. - Lumen is Unreal Engine 5's fully dynamic global illumination and reflections system that is designed for next-generation consoles and the latest PCs. Lumen Global Illumination solves indirect lighting. For example, light bouncing off a surface picks up the color of that surface and reflects the colored light onto other nearby surfaces in large, detailed environments at scales ranging from millimeters to kilometers. Project Team Aimed at defining what a historical artifact exhibit would be like in Virtual Reality, this special project was created by Priam Gvord Studio and the Art Gallery of Ontario (Toronto, Canada), working in cooperation. - Priam Givord, Project Director & Conceptor - VR Interactive Designer, Priam Givord Studio inc. - Gillian McIntyre, Project Lead - Interpretive Planner, Art Gallery of Ontario - Adam Harris Levine - Associate Curator, European Art, Art Gallery of Ontario - Sherry Phillips - Conservator, contemporary art and ship models (retired) research and content development - Matthew Scott - Media Producer, Art Gallery of Ontario - Simon Stephens - Curator of Ship Model and Boat Collections, National Maritime Museum, Greenwich, London. - Hans Biorn-Lian - Digital Programming and Partnerships Lead, National Maritime Museum - Catherine Thomson - Manager, Digital Projects, Art Gallery of Ontario - Sean Guadron - Lead Developer at letscreatesomethingamazing - Pyramid Attack & Tyler Dillman - 3D Design - Karen Vanderborght - Interface Design, KRAK Fractured Media - Candice Dan, Art Collision - Project submission & Synopsis About the Game AGO BRISTOL 1775 is an advanced VR immersive application aiming to establish a high-quality standard in the field of Museum Virtual Reality exhibitions. This groundbreaking project was co-produced by Priam Givord Studio and the Art Gallery of Ontario (Toronto, Canada) to explore the potential of virtual reality to exhibit and interpret historical artifacts. This free application will serve as the first-in-the-world multiplayer VR museum visit system with a live guide from the AGO (up to 6 visitors from anywhere around the world). The VR experience is focused on an original ship model of the Bristol, a warship and later a hulk that held prisoners from the Napoleonic Wars (1793-1815). The model belongs to the Thomson Collection of Ship Models, on exhibit at the Art Gallery of Ontario, unique in Canada and one of the finest ship model collections in the world.
row.short_description: AGO BRISTOL 1775 is a ground-breaking collaboration between VR developers and a museum, transforming a British warship model made in 1775 into an immersive experience. Users can explore freely or follow a narrative aboard the Bristol when it served as a floating prison for captured enemy soldiers.

row.name: The Path to Memento Mori
row.detailed_description: The Path to Memento Mori plunges you into the depths of the haunted Sullivan estate, where something dark and forgotten stirs beneath the surface. After the death of his grandfather, Daniel returns to his childhood home only to be drawn into a web of hidden catacombs, twisted mazes, and a sinister mystery left behind by his late custodian. Daniel must confront a past he’s repressed, solving puzzles and navigating through nightmarish challenges to uncover a secret buried deep within the estate. In this 1-4 player cooperative horror puzzle game, you'll need to work together to survive the relentless monsters lurking in the catacombs while deciphering intricate puzzles designed to keep the estate’s secrets locked away. As you explore the dark, atmospheric environments, a haunting soundtrack heightens the tension, immersing you in a chilling experience that grows more intense with every step. Key Features: Co-op Multiplayer: Team up with up to four players to tackle the estate's mysteries, with teamwork being your key to survival. Puzzles and Mazes: Test your wits and unravel the twisted puzzles that stand between you and the truth. Horror Atmosphere: Explore eerie environments drenched in a haunting, immersive atmosphere that will send shivers down your spine. Relentless Enemies: Evade and outsmart the relentless monsters that stalk the catacombs, ready to trap you in the shadows of the past. Progressive Difficulty: As you delve deeper into the estate’s secrets, the mazes and puzzles become increasingly complex and dangerous. Will you and your team uncover the truth behind Daniel’s past, or will you succumb to the darkness that lurks within the Sullivan estate?
row.short_description: In The Path to Memento Mori, players navigate eerie mazes in a co-op multiplayer horror puzzle game, solving complex puzzles and evading relentless monsters. Work together to uncover buried family secrets and unravel the chilling mystery that lies at the heart of the estate.

row.name: 挂机工厂 AFK Industarry
row.detailed_description: 探索一个奇妙的星球，发掘各样的材料，建造各式的建筑，建立自己的家园！ 攀升科技，登上自己研发的火箭 我们的终极目标是把浆果丛种满整个宇宙！ 《挂机工厂》是一款像素风流水线建设游戏，在游戏中你将扮演一位坠机到蓝星的工程师，通过自己勤劳的双手，从原始时代开始，建立新的文明。 虽然是流水线游戏，但是《挂机工厂》。 当你修好自己的火箭后，就可以前往其他星系探索，在广袤银河中的每一个星球留下你的工厂吧！ 游戏特色 从原始时代到宇宙时代，体量虽小但很耐玩，至少10小时+的游戏体验 支持离线运行, 即使关闭了游戏, 工厂仍然在运转, 宇宙也在变化 5种不同地貌的星球：海洋/冰霜/熔岩/干旱/类地 唯一的任务就是修理火箭，这是个和平的世界，打开一首音乐，你可以尽情慢慢享受建造流水线的时光 重要Tips 锤子快捷键：Q 磁吸快捷键：E 注意： 只有同时将资源吸入建筑的时候，建筑才会运作
row.short_description: 从钻木取火，到飞向银河！《挂机工厂》是一款麻雀虽小，五脏俱全的流水线建设游戏。种田→畜牧→冶金→工业革命→开辟航线→电子芯片→改造星球→探索宇宙，用你的双手创造这一切！

row.name: A Park Full of Cats
row.detailed_description: Welcome to 'A Park Full of Cats,' a hidden object game that invites you to revel in the enchanting world of amusement parks! Experience the thrill and excitement of the rides and give those cats the fun they truly deserve! At the center of the park, Fofiño takes the stage! Search for the cats that'll join him in making this an unforgettable show! Explore every nook and cranny, from the Roller Coasters to the Bumper Cars and the towering Ferris Wheels, to find these playful cats! 'A Park Full of Cats' features: One Enormous Scenario: Immerse yourself in a vast, single-screen scenario, brimming with hidden cats. It's the largest and most intricately designed setting we've created, ensuring you have plenty to explore. Fun and Games: Experience the amusement park like never before as you locate hidden cats and unlock new achievements. The thrill of the rides is just a click away! Free Admission: 'A Park Full of Cats' is not only an amusement park for cats but also for players. The ticket to this adventure is absolutely FREE, giving everyone a chance to have fun and find all the cats without any cost. Countless Cats: As you delve into the world of amusement, you'll encounter a plethora of playful feline companions, each with their unique charm. Can you find them all? So, grab your virtual ticket, hop on the rides, and embark on an unforgettable adventure at 'A Park Full of Cats.'. Get ready to enjoy a day at the amusement park and discover the magic that happens when cats have their own playground!
row.short_description: Welcome to 'A Park Full of Cats,' a hidden object game that invites you to revel in the enchanting world of amusement parks! Experience the thrill and excitement of the rides and give those cats the fun they truly deserve!

row.name: The Finnish War x Sotidrokhima: Finlandsaga
row.detailed_description: An adventure that wasn't meant to be - it's here The Finnish War x Sotidrokhima: Finlandsaga is an epic follow-up to two previous games by AcroGames - The Finnish War (2022) and Sotidrokhima (2022). Finlandsaga is a hybrid hack-n-slash/real-time strategy game, mixing both gameplay and story elements from the two last-mentioned games. It combines the hack-n-slash action of Sotidrokhima with the calculative strategy gameplay of The Finnish War. The story centers around the Finnish national epic Kalevala , and connects its events to modern day, as well as with characters from the Finnish War and Sotidrokhima. The game can however be enjoyed by anyone, even those new to the two preceding titles - or Finnish mythology. Finlandsaga is well self-aware of its odd premise, and takes it all the way. Blood will fly, gore will spurt, and a rocking soundtrack sends our heroes off on their epic quest to save Finland. Features combined hack n' slash and RTS action blood and gore galore! rocking original soundtrack mow down hundreds of enemies with effective special moves
row.short_description: The heroes of Finland's past must come together to save the land from oblivion in the hands of the sorcerer, Louhi. The game is a non-canonical sequel to The Finnish War and Sotidrokhima, combining hack-n-slash and real-time strategy gameplay from the two titles.

row.name: The Big Lez Video Game Playtest
Panda & Crow: A Paraglide Adventure Playtest
Critical Failure
row.detailed_description: Full throttle zombie wave-based survival. The world's first VIDEO GAME CONTROLLED LIVE ACTION ZOMBIE SERIES. Your actions make an impact on the show named the same title. We plan on taking you through a story telling experience as you have fun with friends and family killing hordes of zombies. There is a faction war happening between four factions known as, WITCH'S, BIKER'S, MARAUDER'S, AND HACKER'S. Upon starting your first game you will be asked what faction you plan on fighting for, but no worries, if you grow tired of one faction than you can switch to another whenever you may like. Through the faction war you will be at war with the other three factions as you push waves of zombie hordes away from your home , 'NO MAN'S LAND'. There will be Suprise live events as well as pvp game modes added to spice things up a bit between factions. We hope you enjoy the growing community of CRITICAL FAILURE.
row.short_description: This is a simple wave-based zombie survival game. The world's first VIDEO GAME CONTROLLED LIVE ACTION SERIES. Be prepared to directly influence the world of CRITICAL FAILURE.
row.notes: This content is not meant to be sexual but can be takin however the person wants.

row.name: WACKY WONDERLAND WOLLOP: A 3D PLATFORMER FOR THE AGES GAME OF THE YEAR GREATEST GAME OF ALL TIME : THE GAME  Playtest
MY DAUGHTER IS A CULTIST! SE Playtest
Zoo Simulator: Prologue
row.detailed_description: The Prologue is only part of the full game and is completely free. Every player will be able to play it and see what awaits them in the full version of the game. Renovate your Zoo! In Zoo Simulator: Prologue, one of your first tasks will be to restore the zoo. You will have to put a lot of effort into cleaning neglected alleys and damaged places for your future animals. To do this, you will be using a lot of tools such as welders and water washers. Remember - hard work can result in a crowd of delighted visitors! Various species of animals There is no Zoo without the animals living in it, right? In our game, you decide which of them will live in your facility. Remember that the more interesting the specimens live in your zoo, the more people will want to see them, which means more income for your business. Sit down to the computer and choose from the most exotic and amazing animals from around the world! Arrange runs for animals Animals from the farthest corners of the world will appear in your zoo, they will also require appropriate living conditions - so you must take care of lairs, hiding places, and plants that will make them happy. There will be a lot of different elements in the game, which you will be able to freely move, position and rotate, thus creating unique zones for animals. Look after them In Zoo Simulator: Prologue, you also need to take care of the well-being of your animals, which in return will repay you with peace, good health, and activity in their animal run. Feed them, look after them and pay special attention to their safety - animals love to nibble their nose wherever they have a chance to fit it! Thanks to this, animals will be more likely to show themselves to visitors and win their sympathy. Develop your Zoo As you run your business, you will need to develop it as well. There will be more visitors, which means more attractions that will be able to make their time more pleasant. Take care of the right number of public toilets and sanitary facilities, and eating places where they will be able to eat! Also, don't forget to buy interesting new animals. It is extremely important that guests do not want to leave your zoo and will invite their friends.
row.short_description: The Prologue is just part of the gameplay that awaits you in the full version. In Zoo Simulator: Prologue, your main task is to run and manage your own zoo. Renew it and take care of all the animals' needs, ensuring them a peaceful life! Will you attract crowds of visitors? Create your own zoo!

row.name: Retro Combat
row.detailed_description: Retro Combat is the ultimate first person shooter for the casual gamer. No logins or rankings — Just open the game and play online. You can also play with up to a hundred computers and simulate a battlefield with tanks, machine guns, and airplanes! [10 New Maps] Each map has different features, and some have tanks, static machine guns, and airplanes. Play intense matches on small maps or drive vehicles around in the desert! [25+ Weapons] Weapons range from assault rifles, shotguns, snipers, submachine guns, and pistols that fall into three modes: full auto, semi auto, and three-round bursts. Weapons also can have attachments like a red dot sight, ACOG scope, or a suppressor. Skins like desert and snow camouflage are also available. [Online Multiplayer] Press play and join a server like it’s 2008! Play on any server you want with strangers or friends in team deathmatch, free for all, and survival mode. [Survival Mode] Tired of finding targets? In survival mode, you fight against endless waves of computers, by yourself or with friends! [Single Player] On an airplane? No problem, play with up to 100 computers in any map! The AI can also drive tanks and airplanes.
row.short_description: Casual FPS, no microtransactions. Play online or with bots with machine guns, tanks, and planes.

row.name: PRIN-C1
row.detailed_description: An Endless runner with a twist! Play as a dog named PRIN-C1 who can walk, trot and run but cannot stop. Go Slow. Go Fast. Speed is your choice Switch views seamlessly Collect treats. If not.. steal them Smash them or get punched Unlock fun costumes by completing score challenges
row.short_description: An endless runner where you can control your speed. Run, trot and jump as you collect treats while avoiding speed blockers, pits and enemies. Or use your wits and turns those blockers against enemies. Unlock fun costumes by completing score challenges.

row.name: Fintube
row.detailed_description: Welcome to Fintube! This software tool, much like Veadotube, is incredibly simple and user-friendly, designed specifically for PNGTubers. With FinTube, you can effortlessly bring your characters to life, making your content engaging for your audience. What can Fintube do? Fintube comes with all amazing feature but also incredibly simple and user-friendly. We designed it with primary focus on PNGTubers beginner. Future development of Fintube will focus on simplifying the content creation process for PNGTubers. Some of the current feature of Fintube: Easy to use and straightforward Doesn't require much from your computer to work Supports import of JPG, JPEG, PNG, GIF (Experimental) image file formats Streamer mode for streaming Expresive UI to spice up the experience Avatar movement based on voice input from microphone A slider to set db state limits Thumbnail preview of the imported image Streamer Mode can now use 'Allow Transparency' in Source>Game Capture>OBS Properties by accessing the button Multiple Expression Keys (Hotkeys) for changing between each mode/layer using keyboard More to come in the future! We will update you about our progress on the monthly Follow our devlog for more detail. Also don't forget to follow us for our weekly freebies. We understand that this is still an early stage of development, and there may be some bugs or issues that need to be addressed. We appreciate your input, as it will greatly assist us in improving our next update. If you have a suggestion for a feature for the app just write a comment below. This project is still under development, if you like the project, please wishlist us on here! Feel free to direct message me for inquiries regarding questions.
row.short_description: Fintube: Elevate your PNGTuber experience! Easily import images, animate avatars with voice input, and enhance engagement with streamer mode and expressive UI. Stay updated, enjoy weekly freebies, and shape our development with your feedback. Wishlist for an evolving PNGTubing journey!

row.name: Cat Fred Evil Pet
row.detailed_description: Get yourself a cute cat Fred and take proper care of him: provide your pet with tasty food and fresh water, entertain him regularly, and buy a cozy mattress for him, so Fred can sleep well. Do not think that your pet will always be good and sweet. It is better to start preparing for the escape from the evil cat in advance: open all accessible doors, find a craft book, and provide the pet with maximum care. The puzzles prepared by the evil cat Fred are quite difficult. Solving them is a true quest. This is what is waiting for you in the Cat Fred Evil Pet game: craft items to complete quests; 4 days of the cat’s transformation from a cute creature into an evil monster; tons of quests, puzzles, screamers, and fun moments. In the Cat Fred Evil Pet game, we have tried to break from the traditional concept of horror games to ensure every player enjoys lots of new emotions from a brand-new gameplay and exciting story in the game. The game contains both scary elements (screamers) and fun, humorous moments.
row.short_description: Care for a cute cat Fred. If the pet is displeased, a horror game will start!

row.name: Quiet is the Eyes
row.detailed_description: Quiet is the Eyes is a 2D side-scrolling puzzle horror game where you play as a researcher who finds herself at the center of a twisted mystery. All your coworkers are gone and the halls are quiet, except for the pitter-patter of rain on the window. Explore a desolate laboratory as a creature stalks you, always watching. Run and hide as you solve puzzles and learn more about what happened to the facility and its secrets. Don’t Get Caught! Beware: the creature outside the window is always near. You can run and hide as the monster stalks you at every moment, but within the laboratory’s walls, no place is truly safe. Uniquely themed puzzles Warning: the laboratory has entered lockdown. Put on your lab coat as you explore the different wings of the laboratory, solving mind-bending puzzles to open doors and escape. Don’t forget, the monster is always watching. Uncover the mysteries Unauthorized Access: Figure out what's really been going on in the lab and the mysterious experiments they have been conducting. Will you discover the truth or succumb to the thing that lurks in the halls? Quiet is the Eyes was created by Ally Guo and Rachel Perry as part of the University of Southern California’s Games program. It was made in collaboration with students at the Berklee College of Music: Ali Tahir, Xiaohe Zhao, and Sophia Drozd. The game aims to explore themes of unpredictability and the unknown—how they evoke apprehension yet bring forth a sense of relief amidst uncertainty.
row.short_description: All your coworkers are gone and the halls are quiet, except for the pitter-patter of rain on the window. Explore a desolate laboratory as a creature stalks you, always watching. Run and hide as you solve puzzles and learn more about what happened to the facility and its secrets.

row.name: Tale of Time: Bagua
row.detailed_description: Tale of Time takes players on an extraordinary journey through time and space, enveloping them in a mesmerizing puzzle adventure. As a Chinese teenager on a journey to uncover his family's secrets, you'll wield the mystical power of the BaGua mirrors to travel back in time to the same location, delving into an enigmatic world filled with puzzles, mysteries, and the allure of forgotten lineage. This indie-developed, non-euclidean top-down puzzle game invites you to embark on an emotional odyssey where your decisions shape a compelling story of heritage, sacrifice, and self-discovery. Time and Space Manipulation Utilize the unique power of the BaGua mirrors to transcend conventional time and space, solving intricate puzzles and unraveling hidden secrets. Non-Euclidean Puzzle Solving Engage with mind-bending puzzles set in non-euclidean spaces, challenging your intellect and creativity as you navigate through complex, interdimensional mazes. Low-Poly, Minimalistic Art Style Experience the captivating world of Tale of Time through a visually stunning low-poly, minimalistic art style that enhances the game's atmosphere and emphasizes the purity of the storytelling. Tale of Time is a labor of love crafted by a dedicated indie development team Offseason Studio, passionate about creating unique and engaging gaming experiences. The non-euclidean gameplay mechanics were meticulously designed to challenge players while keeping them engrossed in the storyline. Every aspect of Tale of Time was carefully curated to ensure players embark on an unforgettable adventure, exploring the depths of one's family history, the complexities of time, and the boundless dimensions of human emotions.
row.short_description: Stack BaGua spells and travel through space and time! Tale of Time is a mind-bending top-down puzzle adventure where you guide a Chinese teenager on a quest to recover his family's lost treasure, the BaGua mirrors. Overcome obstacles along the way to unveil the secrets of his ancient lineage.

row.name: LOVEY ♡ DOVEY
row.detailed_description: LOVEY ♡ DOVEY You've always been super into toilets. You use them so many times a day that you could be considered a #1 toilet fan. That's why you decide to visit an abandoned toilet factory. Legend has it that there are golden toilets there - and obviously , you want them all! However, Lovey Dovey (the toilet factory's mascot) is on the loose. Sadly, the only thing you brought is a rocket launcher. Hopefully it can come in handy somehow. Collect all the golden toilets and escape - but can you evade the infamous and hairy-legged Lovey Dovey ? KEY ♡ FEATURES ♥ Average playtime of 20 minutes ♥ Collect the golden toilets of which the legends have spoken ♥ Use your nifty rocket launcher ♥ Escape Lovey Dovey & the toilet factory Elevate your horror game experience and try Lovey Dovey today! This very high-quality comedy horror game will not flush your expectations down the drain!
row.short_description: As the #1 toilet fan, you visit an abandoned toilet factory in search of the legendary golden toilets. However, you're ambushed by the factory's friendly mascot, Lovey Dovey. You're at an extreme disadvantage since the only thing you brought is a rocket launcher. Collect all the toilets then escape!

row.name: Virtu-Pilot
row.detailed_description: A Letter from The Developers To the next generation of aviators, We hope this experience encourages and helps you to embark on your first lesson, grit through ground school, feel the joy of your first solo flight and pass your check ride. And if piloting isn't quite your cup of tea, there is a plethora of aviation careers out there. Yours, Aries VR - a squadron of aerospace enthusiasts, trainee pilots and licensed pilots sharing their first person experiences of their training journeys Overview Virtu-Pilot was originally tailored for the Meta Quest 2 to equip aspiring pilots with a cost-effective and engaging VR training tool, empowering them to gain confidence and master aviation skills at their own pace. For the most immersive experience, we recommend using VR, allowing you to step into the pilot's shoes and perform checks and procedures using your virtual hands as if you were in real life. Be prepared to crouch, chuck obstructions, check for ice, open doors, flick lights on and remove tie downs. NOTE: We excited to bring Early Access to the aviation community, but please remember, this is an early access experience, and your input is invaluable in shaping the future of aviation training. The Windows desktop mode adaptation is quite limited and compatibility with non Meta Quest VR headsets is unknown. Levels Available Start Screen Briefing Room Hangar, Lesson 1 - Preliminary interior and walk around checks Key VR Controls Move - left joystick Teleport - right joystick Grab - hold front or side triggers, release to drop items Open Checklist book - look at the left palm in a lesson Demo Locked Levels Lesson 2 - Exterior checks (surface movements, fuel, undercarriage exploded view) Lesson 3 - Engine Start Up Exciting Planned Features JSBSim Flight Simulation Taxing Take-off End of lesson quizzes Follow along animated Instructors AI instructors Multiplayer capabilities Radio communications training
row.short_description: Get ready for take-off, cadet! Enter an immersive UE5 experience that will elevate your light aircraft procedure skills. Master preliminary checks, interior/exterior startup checks, and gain the confidence to soar. Planned features: AI instructors, multiplayer and radio communications training.

row.name: Cureocity
row.detailed_description: JOIN US! Feel free to join our official Discord to share your ideas with us. X: @qiyudixiacheng About the Game We are 'Bread On Board,' a collective of independent game developers spread across four countries, united by our passion and meeting during a GameJam. Our game demo was born in the 'BOOOM CHALLENGE', a GameJam by GCORES. With only 21 days, we created a game based on a given theme. After the competition, we even won the 'Most Popular Game' award at an Online Game Trial Event. The full playthrough of our game will take about an hour. We hope to give you a short, but super heartwarming and loving adventure❤️. A rookie adventurer fresh on the scene and a former mercenary who was transferred into an adventurer due to injury. Two protagonists with contrasting personalities will embark on an adventure of fantasy and healing together. In the mysterious ruins of an underground dungeon that lies in the depth of a jungle, what awaits them will be... According to the tavern's adventurer logs, the team heading into the dungeon features a rookie adventurer and an ex-mercenary who is now working as a healer. The adventurer looks as charming as a doll, and the enthusiasm never disappears; the healer is cool and a bit traditional, acting as a guiding figure for their adventure. What stories have unfolded between these two contrasting characters, and what challenges will they face together in this adventure? The continuation of this adventurous story is yours to discover. 'People think battles need powerful weapons, but strategy at hand is key.' In 'Cureocity,' the power of your strategy is materialized as the numerical values of your hands in combat. You can swap different weapons or items held in your left and right hands to alter your character's attack and defense stats. You may also change 'gestures' to focus attacks or land heavy blows on specific enemies.As you delve deeper into the dungeon, you will take the unique traits of monsters into consideration and discuss strategies with your allies. In this adventure, you'll discover not only the secrets hidden within the dungeon, but also the truths about the world and the characters themselves. When faced with contaminated monsters, you can choose to either fight them or attempt to purify them. Of course, you also have the option to let things take their own course. With each decision,the fate of the protagonists may change. The end of this adventure... is yours to decide. About the Publisher GCORES PUBLISHING is an independent game publishing venture formed by GCORES, committed to bringing you more outstanding indie games from the BOOOM CHALLENGE. Feel free to follow our publisher webpage for future updates.
row.short_description: “People think battles need powerful weapons, but strategy at hand is key.'The story follows a rookie adventurer and a new healer in a dungeon quest, with the core gameplay involving hand-picked methods using weapons and items. Fight or purify? Heal or alter? The choice is in your hands.

row.name: LAN Party
row.detailed_description: Experience a LAN party like never before! LAN Party is designed to be the perfect compliment to your gaming group. Whether you're playing the latest FPS cooperatively, competing against each other in an RTS, or playing different games entirely, LAN Party makes communicating and sharing gameplay so much easier. Fully customize your unique gaming room and gaming setup, select your avatar, and invite your friends to hang out and play games or have a watch party in your virtual space. Welcome to the next era of online gaming, where the excitement, energy, and camaraderie of a LAN party meets the freedom of the virtual world. Stream Gameplay Experience the excitement of the game together through seamless in-room gameplay streaming. Open your friend's gameplay stream to cheer them on and broadcast your stream to a virtual screen so you can all watch together. Watch Content With Friends Use a shared video screen and have a watch party with your friends. Our streaming infrastructure ensures that videos are always synced between viewers. Have Full Control Over Your Avatar Express yourself exactly as you want with full control over your avatar. Find the perfect avatar on our marketplace or easily upload your own design. We give you the freedom to fully customize all aspects of your avatar including its scale, animations, and emotes. Create A Unique Gaming Environment Fully customize your unique gaming environment. We encourage creativity by allowing you to choose your room layout, lighting, furniture, and much more. Make your virtual space as unique as the gamers who visit it. Marketplace Our in-app marketplace allows our community to share its creations. Easily download avatars, furniture, decor, and other items to design your perfect space, or upload your creations to share with others.
row.short_description: Experience in-person gaming, online! LAN Party is designed to be the perfect compliment to your gaming group. Whether you're playing the same game competitively, cooperatively, or playing different games entirely, LAN Party makes communicating and sharing gameplay so much easier.

row.name: Drift.Wav
row.detailed_description: This is a game all about relaxing and hitting some cool drifts. Try the different modes and drift your way to the top of leaderboard, if you can... Drift or drive to earn cash and save up for one of the 15 cars to choose from—one of them being a little more unique than usual. Also, there are several built-in playlists that you can select and drift to in any mode! Please note this game is still a work in progress and I do update constantly. As a solo dev I love any and all feedback in attempts to improve and truly make this a better game for everyone < 3 Special Controls ( Not essential but a whole lotta fun ) Super Jump: Hold 'L SHIFT' to activate slo-motion then hold 'SPACE' or 'F' to super jump ;) Flip Mid-Air: While high up in the air. Hold S to bring speed below 50 then hold 'E' to start flipping Custom Playlists In addition, there is a custom playlist feature that allows you to drift to any playlist you want while watching the visual waveforms of the song move around you! This feature works with .Wav and .Mp3 from what I have tested.
row.short_description: Drift.Wav is a casual drifting game with a synthwave inspired aesthetic. This game is not meant to replicate / simulate actual drift mechanics, but more serve as a fun & relaxing game where you can slide in a synthwave inspired world. See if you can drift your way to the top of the leaderboard!

row.name: BattleCore Arena
row.detailed_description: In BattleCore Arena, compete in fast-paced, peer-to-peer battles with your friends using responsive controls that mix shooting, platforming, physics mastery, and team strategy! Team up to dash, jump, and use your trusted weapons and abilities to eject your opponents from the arena. Enjoy two exciting game modes with friends for short yet epic matches! Download and play for free now! MASTER PHYSICS Physics will be your greatest ally or your worst enemy! Perform mind-blowing aerial maneuvers and mix the jump, double jump, directional dash, and gravity to gain the upper hand! DOMINATE THE ARENA Experience two unique battle modes to fight with your team or roll against them: - BACKUP: Be the last team standing in this 3v3 Team Death Match where you share lives with your teammates. - Q-BALL: Catch and keep the Q-Ball to lead your team to victory. Teamwork will be key in this highly competitive mode. BUILD YOUR OWN CORE Personalize your Core’s appearance! Choose your Armor, customize your Lights, Banner, and Elimination Explosion to impose your style. Unlock over a hundred cosmetics as you progress. Rely on unique weapons and abilities to be the most powerful Core of the arena. Gear up for upcoming battles and create your own playstyle by selecting a ranged weapon and other game-changer perks! ROLL WITH OR AGAINST YOUR FRIENDS Download the game for free and host your own play sessions with your friends in peer-to-peer matches!
row.short_description: BattleCore Arena is a free-to-play, peer-to-peer platform shooter where gravity mastery is the key to victory. Compete in quick PvP battles, using weapons and abilities to eject your opponents out of the arena.

row.name: Lampy
row.detailed_description: Step into a whimsical world where shadows play with light and join Lampy, the adorable little cube, on his quest to find his way home in the game simply called 'Lampy.' As you guide Lampy through each level, his warm glow will light up your screen, revealing secrets and surprises along the way. With stunning visuals and a soundtrack that'll tug at your heartstrings, you'll be totally immersed in Lampy's enchanting universe. 'Lampy' isn't just a game; it's an emotional rollercoaster that players of all ages will adore. So, grab your controller and be the hero Lampy needs to navigate through the darkness and find his way home. Oh, and here's the twist: 'Lampy' has tons of levels to conquer! Each one is a new adventure waiting to be explored. But hey, if you ever need a break, don't worry – just remember where you left off, and Lampy will be right there waiting for you to continue the fun. Get ready to light up your gaming world and embark on an unforgettable journey with Lampy! 🌟🎮
row.short_description: Embark on an enchanting journey with 'Lampy,' a mesmerizing puzzle-platformer that promises universal appeal. Navigate captivating levels, overcome obstacles, and immerse yourself in a world of wonder. Guide Lampy through intricately designed challenges and discover the magic around every corner.

row.name: Wizarre
row.detailed_description: Enter the world of Wizarre, where strategy, spells, and teamwork are crucial to your journey. Are you ready to rise through the ranks, claim your rightful place at the pinnacle of the global leaderboard, and unleash the full potential of your inner Wizard? The adventure begins now, and the only limits are the ones you set for yourself. Assemble a formidable team of three Wizards, each with unique statistics, strengths, and abilities. The power of choice lies in your hands as you carefully select your team members, considering which combination of over 100 spells suits your tactical approach best. Will you choose a balanced mix of offensive, defensive, and ultimate spells or specialize in a specific magic school? The choice is yours. And, to add a touch of personal flair, customize your Wizards' appearance with an array of skins that you can unlock by levelling up your account and opening Lootballs. Duel your way to greatness in epic battles that pit your team of three mighty Wizards against opponents from across the globe. The action is turn-based, with each round lasting just 45 seconds. During your turn, you'll need to manage your Wizards' time and mana wisely. With a limited mana pool, every spell you cast matters, and choosing the right combination is crucial to victory. However, be cautious, for the more your Wizards fly, the faster your timer drops. This creates a dynamic balance between strategic aerial manoeuvres and conserving your precious time. With seven themed gameplay maps, each with unconventional challenges, Wizarre ensures endless excitement and strategic depth. Wizarre offers a truly magical experience with crossplay support, allowing you to take your outstanding adventures from PC to mobile devices and back. Whether on the go or seated at your gaming desk, you can engage in exciting battles against enemies worldwide. Challenge your friends or make new allies through the Play with Friend mode, where your skills are tested against opponents on various platforms. It's a world of endless possibilities where the magic never ends.
row.short_description: Wizarre is a turn-based multiplayer game. Build and customize your team of Wizards, select from over 100 different spells, and manage your time and mana. Play with friends, compete against other players, and climb the global leaderboard across devices with crossplay support.

row.name: Blue Ribbon Bake Off
row.detailed_description: The county fair is up and running, which means that it is time for the Blue Ribbon Bake Off. Players are contestants at the fair vying for blue ribbons, using time tested recipes. To win a blue ribbon, contestants must be the first to gather ingredients needed to complete a recipe. Beware though, while players are gathering ingredients competitors are using every trick in the cookbook to try to stop them, including swiping ingredients, and even submarining recipes. In the high-stakes world of competitive cooking nothing is off the table. Object of the game: Collect ingredients needed to complete a recipe, while trying to stop other players from doing the same. The first player to successfully gather the needed supplies for a recipe is awarded a blue ribbon. Collect enough blue ribbons to be named the County's Best Baker. This version is single player, against three computer players.
row.short_description: Blue Ribbon Bake Off is a new, original playing card game. Players work to gather ingredients to complete a recipe and win a blue ribbon at the county fair. Competitors use every trick in the cookbook to stop them. Who will be named the County's Best Baker?

row.name: Infrared
row.detailed_description: You find yourself lost in the middle of nowhere. The only way to leave is to refuel your car. But to do so, you'll have to venture into this desolate forest to find a way to unlock the gas station. But, every bit of flesh in your body screams that you are not alone... As you embark on your journey into the forest, you will be equipped with both a flashlight and a camera. The latter is indispensable for your expedition, as it can capture infrared light, revealing hidden entities beyond the reach of your naked eye. However, amidst these extraordinary phenomena, a malevolent entity lurks. This entity becomes increasingly hostile as you draw closer to discovering the way into his church. Unfortunately, your only chance of survival lies within his church. Therefore, the closer you get to opening the church's door, the more cautious you must become. Nonetheless, there are ways to slow down this entity, and furthermore, there are ways to eliminate it. It all depends on your determination and courage to discover them. INFRARED is a survival horror first-person game with a PSX/PS1 style. The game doesn't save progress, which means you only have one chance to complete it, or you will have to restart from the beginning. The game features three endings: a good ending, a bad ending, and a secret ending. We recommend setting aside one hour for each playthrough to achieve each of the endings and fully experience the entire game. This game also adjusts certain graphical settings (frames per second) during gameplay to create a specific atmosphere.
row.short_description: You find yourself lost in the middle of nowhere. The only way to leave is to fuel up your car. But to do so, you'll have to venture into this desolate forest to find a way to unlock the gas station. But, every bit of flesh in your body screams that you are not alone...
row.notes: Occasional appearance of low-poly blood in specific areas.

row.name: 迷宮のドールポリス
row.detailed_description: Let's conquer the 30-story labyrinth! This is a random dungeon action game where the main character has to strengthen his abilities and conquer a mysterious labyrinth that changes shape every time he enters. The main character 'Rose Doll' can use three techniques: 'Ball Attack' where she transforms into a ball and slams into her body, 'Bullet' where she shoots a bullet forward, and 'Shield' which protects herself from enemies. Use these skills to quickly defeat the many enemies that infest the labyrinth. When you defeat half of the many enemies, a 'gate' will open that allows you to proceed to the next level. Let's rush into the gate before the time limit runs out. Once you enter the gate, you can 'enhance' your Rose Doll by shopping with tokens. You may be able to improve your ball attack and bullet attack power, or learn new skills. Let's aim for the top floor of the labyrinth while repeating defeating enemies and strengthening Rose Doll! The boss is waiting on the 30th floor, the top floor. It usually takes about 20 to 30 minutes to go around the labyrinth. Feel free to play quickly and repeatedly.
row.short_description: It's an action game where you advance through a mysterious dungeon whose shape changes every time you enter, while strengthening the functions of your aircraft.
